title: Operations Integrator / Manager
description:
Operations Integrator / Operations Manager

Location: Remote

Type: part-time (hours est 15-20 hours per week with room to grow)

Reports to: COO



About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Integrator to sit between our COO and support team and keep the backend of our fast-paced Australian business running smoothly.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role for someone who can take priorities, solve problems, improve systems and automations, and get things done.



You’ll oversee day-to-day operations, optimise processes, manage technology and automation, and work closely with the COO and support team to keep the business moving. At times, some people management responsibilities of our support team will be required. 



Core Responsibilities

- Own the day-to-day | Work with our support team to deliver across programs, events, products and services

- Process Optimisation | Build, document and improve SOPs and workflows with an automation, human-first mindset

- Technology & Automation | Manage platforms, build automations and funnels, and develop practical tech solutions. You will own our tech stack

- Problem Solving | Identify issues, think critically and implement solutions alongside the COO, without needing step-by-step direction

- Execution | Turn priorities into action quickly, efficiently and with strong attention to detail

- Communication | Communicate clearly and proactively across the CEO, COO, and wider business

- Continuous Improvement | Constantly identify opportunities to make the business more efficient, scalable and effective



What This Role Is

Essentially, you’re an Integrator.

> You’ll take high-level priorities from the COO and turn them into execution. You’ll execute on tasks, solve problems, improve systems and make sure things actually happen.

> You’ll have the autonomy to work out how something should be done, rather than simply being given a list of steps to follow.



 We’re looking for someone who is:

 > Systems and process driven

 > Highly organised and detail-oriented

> Tech-savvy and comfortable with automations, funnels and backend systems

> Experienced building automated flows in native systems, but also with connectors (
 etc)

> Solutions-focused and proactive

> A strong communicator

> Comfortable working independently

> Fast-moving and adaptable



What This Role Is NOT

>This is not an EA or general support role.

>We don’t need someone who simply follows SOPs or waits for instructions. You won’t need to manage calendars or triage inboxes (we have good people handling this), but you will need to be comfortable moving through a variety of tasks.



What Success Looks Like aka You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

> The COO can delegate a priority and trust you to run with it

> The support team has clarity and things get done

> Problems are identified and resolved quickly

> Processes are continually becoming simpler and more efficient

> Manual work is being automated wherever possible

> Technology and systems run smoothly behind the scenes

> The business is becoming easier to operate and scale



If you think you're a good fit, but don't meet 100% of the skills listed, we encourage you to still apply. Tell us what your zone of genius is and how you'll grow into the role.

title: Home Care Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Remote Home Care Scheduling Coordinator



We are a growing U.S.-based home care agency in California looking for an experienced Home Care Scheduling Coordinator to join our team remotely.



For this position, we are specifically looking for someone who already understands home care scheduling, caregiver staffing, open-shift management, call-outs, client needs, caregiver availability and schedule changes.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. Prior home care, healthcare staffing, caregiver scheduling or similar scheduling experience is strongly preferred.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



• Manage and maintain caregiver and client schedules

• Fill new and open caregiver shifts quickly and accurately

• Match caregivers with clients based on location, availability, experience, skills and level of care required

• Handle caregiver call-outs and find replacement coverage

• Contact caregivers by phone, text and
 regarding available shifts

• Confirm caregiver availability and shift acceptance

• Follow up on unfilled shifts until coverage is secured

• Monitor upcoming schedules and proactively identify potential coverage problems

• Communicate schedule changes with caregivers, clients and the internal team

• Maintain accurate caregiver availability and client information

• Update caregiver and client profiles in our home care scheduling system

• Coordinate scheduling for recurring, overnight and longer-hour shifts

• Assist with onboarding newly hired caregivers into the scheduling process

• Work closely with recruiting when additional caregivers are needed for difficult-to-fill shifts



Home Care Scheduling Knowledge We’re Looking For



You should understand concepts such as:



• Caregiver availability and preferred schedules

• Recurring versus one-time shifts

• Client/caregiver matching

• Personal care versus companionship needs

• Mobility and transfer assistance

• Dementia and memory care assignments

• Transportation requirements

• Caregiver call-outs and last-minute replacements

• Overtime considerations when assigning caregivers

• Geographic proximity when matching caregivers to clients

• Avoiding scheduling conflicts and double-booking

• Maintaining continuity of care whenever possible



Preferred Qualifications



• Previous home care scheduling experience is strongly preferred

• Experience working with a U.S. home care agency is highly desirable

• Experience scheduling caregivers, CNAs, HHAs or similar healthcare workers

• Experience with home care software such as AxisCare, WellSky, ClearCare, AlayaCare, HHAeXchange or similar systems is a major plus

• Strong spoken and written English

• Comfortable communicating with caregivers and clients by phone

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Highly organized and detail-oriented

• Able to manage multiple open shifts at the same time

• Comfortable working under pressure when last-minute changes occur

• Reliable and able to work consistently during U.S. Pacific Time hours



The Person We Want



A strong scheduler does more than enter shifts into a system.



We want someone who sees that a caregiver has called out and immediately starts thinking:



Who is available? Who lives nearby? Who has worked with this client before? Who has the right skills? Will assigning this caregiver create overtime somewhere else?



You should be comfortable making those decisions and proactively solving scheduling problems.

title: Architectural Assistant / Planning Intelligence Coordinator – UK Construction
description:
About the Role



RCB Design & Build is looking for a technically minded and organised Junior Architectural Assistant / Planning Intelligence Coordinator to support and gradually take ownership of our Planning Intelligence process.



This role combines:



architectural drawing review + construction understanding + planning application research + client communication + CRM management + AI and automation tools.



This is not a general VA or data-entry role.



The successful candidate must be comfortable reading architectural drawings and understanding residential construction projects. We will provide training on our UK Planning Intelligence process, systems, workflows and procedures.



What You Will Be Doing



You will help manage residential planning opportunities identified from UK local council planning applications.



Your responsibilities will include:



Reviewing UK residential planning applications

Reading and comparing existing and proposed architectural drawings

Reviewing floor plans, elevations, sections, roof plans and site plans

Understanding what the homeowner is proposing to build

Identifying works such as:

rear extensions

side extensions

wraparound extensions

loft conversions

dormers

internal alterations

structural changes

refurbishments

Summarising proposed works clearly

Helping determine whether a project is suitable for RCB

Checking applicant, property and planning information for accuracy

Reviewing and quality-checking AI-generated project summaries and correspondence

Preparing personalised letters and project communication

Managing daily postal campaigns through Stannp

Supporting
 outreach to homeowners, architects and consultants

Communicating with prospective clients where required

Helping qualify project enquiries

Maintaining accurate CRM records

Scheduling follow-ups

Supporting consultation and site survey arrangements

Coordinating with RCB’s estimating, design and management teams

Helping improve our Planning Intelligence workflow

Using AI and automation tools to reduce repetitive manual work

What the Process Looks Like



You will be working across a structured workflow similar to:



Planning application identified → drawings reviewed → project understood → opportunity qualified → personalised letter/email prepared → quality checked → sent through Stannp → follow-up → homeowner/architect communication → qualified project → consultation/site survey → estimating/design team



Some tasks will be automated.



Your role is to provide the human technical judgement, checking, organisation and communication needed to make sure the process remains accurate and professional.



Essential Requirements



You should have a background in one or more of the following:



Architecture

Architectural Technology

Architectural Design

Civil Engineering

Structural Engineering

Quantity Surveying

Construction

Estimating

Building Technology



You must be able to:



Read and understand architectural drawings

Compare existing and proposed plans

Understand basic residential construction

Explain technical information clearly

Communicate confidently in spoken and written English

Work accurately with detailed information

Follow processes consistently

Work independently

Learn new systems quickly

Use AI and digital tools comfortably

UK Experience



Direct UK planning experience is not required.



Training will be provided on:



UK planning applications

Local council planning portals

Planning drawings and documents

RCB project qualification

Planning Intelligence workflow

CRM procedures

Stannp mailing process

Client communication standards



We are more interested in someone who already has a good technical foundation and can learn quickly.



Technology



Experience with any of the following is useful:



AutoCAD

Revit

Bluebeam

Procore

PlanSwift

Estimating software

CRM systems

Zapier

Make

n8n

ChatGPT / AI tools

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office



Experience using automation or AI in construction, architecture or project administration is an advantage.



Client Communication



This role may involve communicating with UK homeowners, architects and construction professionals.



You therefore need to be comfortable speaking professionally in English and asking clear project-related questions.



You do not need to be a salesperson, but you should be confident enough to discuss a project naturally and professionally.



Who This Role May Suit



This position may suit:



Junior Architectural Assistants

Architecture Graduates

Architectural Technicians

Junior Architectural Designers

Junior Civil Engineers

Junior Quantity Surveyors

Junior Estimators

Construction Graduates

Design Coordinators

Working Arrangement

Remote / Work From Home

Full-time preferred

Monday to Friday

UK business hours

Long-term opportunity

Training provided

Opportunity to take greater ownership as you develop

Compensation



Starting rate: £3–£4 GBP per hour



The exact starting rate will depend on:



Technical ability

English communication

Drawing-reading ability

Relevant experience

Reliability

Performance during the assessment



This is intended as a long-term role, and performance/rate reviews may be considered once the successful candidate becomes more independent and capable of managing the Planning Intelligence workflow.



Please only apply if you are comfortable with the stated starting rate.



How to Apply



To apply, please send:



1. Your Updated CV



Highlight your relevant experience in:



Architecture

Construction

Engineering

Estimating

Quantity Surveying

Technical coordination

2. Portfolio / Work Samples



Please include examples such as:



Architectural drawings

Construction drawings

Drawing reviews

Quantity take-offs

Estimates

Technical documentation

Residential projects

Other relevant work



Please remove confidential client information where necessary.



3. Two-Minute Video Introduction



Please record a simple video of approximately 2 minutes.



A phone or webcam recording is perfectly fine.



Please briefly tell us:



Your name

Your professional background

Your experience reading architectural drawings

Your construction or engineering experience

Your experience communicating with clients

Your experience using software, AI or automation

Why you believe you are suitable for this role

Why We Require a Video



This position includes communication with UK homeowners and professionals.



The video allows us to assess communication ability early in the process and helps both the applicant and RCB avoid unnecessary 30–45 minute introductory interviews where the role may not be the right fit.



The video is an important part of the initial assessment.



Important Application Instruction



Please begin your application with:



RCB PLANNING A2Z

CV

Portfolio/work samples

Two-minute video

Current employment status

Notice period / earliest start date

Confirmation that you can work UK business hours

title: Creative Strategist — Supplement Brand — Direct Response — Full-Time Remote
description:
We run a supplement brand doing 8 figures a year on paid social. Every dollar of revenue traces back to an ad concept someone wrote. That someone is the Creative Strategist. We need one.



You don't edit. You don't design. You don't buy media. You write. Hooks, scripts, leads, briefs. That's your job. A team of video editors and a designer takes what you write and builds it. Media buyers launch it. You take the data back and write the next round.



You'll work directly with the founder. No layers. No committees. You write a concept, it goes into production, it's live within days. If it wins, you get paid for it. If it doesn't, you study why and write a better one.



What we care about:



You think in direct response. Awareness levels, hooks vs angles, mechanism, proof, offer. If those words don't mean anything to you, stop here.



You study ads on your own time. Not because someone told you to. Because you're genuinely curious about why things work.



You can spot patterns. You look at 100 ads and you see the 3 structural things they have in common. Then you write something original from that insight.



You produce at volume without quality dropping. One great concept a month doesn't help us. We need consistent output week after week.



You're self-directed. You don't need to be managed. You take a goal and you figure out how to hit it.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
--- Role Overview

The Project Coordinator owns the operational backbone of renovation projects from pre-kickoff through close-out. Where the Project Manager owns scope, budget, and the client relationship, you own the systems, documentation, schedule tracking, and vendor follow-through that keep every project moving.

This is an ownership role, not a task-taking role. You are expected to spot slippage before your PM does, chase answers without being reminded, and bring your PM a recommendation rather than a question. You will typically support two to four active projects at a time and maintain daily contact with contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to verify site activity, confirm schedule adherence, and document progress.



--- Key Responsibilities

** Project Systems & Documentation

1. Own project folder structure, Slack channels, and document filing so that links, drive folders, and templates are correctly filed and accessible without prompting.

2. Maintain project trackers and proposal decks as the single source of truth, updated from Matterport scans, floorplans, and vendor bids within 24 hours of new information.

3. Build and update backyard overlays and other visual documentation using survey data, drone photos, and site imagery.

4. Keep Buildertrend and all other project systems current. You are accountable for data integrity, not just data entry.



** Schedule & Site Accountability

1. Maintain daily communication with contractors and subcontractors to confirm on-site presence and active work at assigned projects.

2. Obtain photographic progress documentation no fewer than three (3) times per week, ensuring images are clear, time-stamped, and tied to specific milestones or ongoing construction activity.

3. Compare actual site progress against the baseline schedule and flag variance early, before it becomes a client-visible delay.

4. Escalate delays, missed updates, or contractor no-shows to the Project Manager within 24 hours, paired with a proposed recovery option.



** Vendor & Permitting Support

1. Run bid requests end-to-end: issue, track, chase, and close out estimates and compliance documents (W9s, COIs, licenses).

2. Prepare permit application packets to local requirements and submit to the appropriate portals or hand off to the permitting team as a complete package that requires no rework.

3. Submit vendor payment requests using the designated SOP.

Validate invoices and submit to Buildertrend.

4. Maintain vendor records and flag lapsed insurance or licensing before it blocks work on site.



** Client & Stakeholder Communication

1. Draft client recaps, kickoff materials, and bi-weekly updates by compiling inputs from the PM and vendor check-ins.

2. Monitor project Slack channels and surface urgent messages or requests to the PM with the context needed to act.

3. Schedule internal and client-facing meetings, including kickoff and proposal calls.



** Construction & Close-Out

1. Own punch list tracking from creation through sign-off and confirm completion with photo evidence.

2. Coordinate final photography, walkthrough scheduling, and close-out document packaging.

3. Collect final invoices from all contractors and audit each contract to verify that all agreed-upon work has been completed.

4. Support quality control from project initiation through close-out, ensuring all work meets established standards and specifications.



--- What Success Looks Like

- Day 30: Fully independent on project systems, trackers, and filing across all assigned projects.

- Day 60: Running vendor follow-up and permit packet preparation without PM prompting, with zero missed photo documentation cycles.

- Day 90: Your PM comes to you for project status rather than assembling it themselves. Punch lists and close-out packages are complete and audit-ready.



????‍???? Skills & Qualifications

** Required

- 2+ years in project coordination, operations, or administrative support in a fast-moving environment.

- Demonstrated follow-through. You close loops without being chased.

- Strong written English: clear, professional, and concise.

- Advanced Google Workspace skills, particularly Sheets (filters, lookups, conditional formatting).

- Comfort managing three or more concurrent projects with competing deadlines.

- Availability during US business hours, with reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace for calls.



** Preferred

- Experience with Buildertrend, Slack, ClickUp, Asana, or comparable project management tooling.

- Background in construction, renovation, design, real estate, or property operations.

- Exposure to permitting, inspections, or municipal processes.



--- This Role Is Not a Fit If

- You need step-by-step direction to make progress.

- You go quiet when you hit a blocker instead of escalating it.

- You are looking for a purely administrative, ticket-taking role.

title: Lead Platform Engineer — Internal Operations Platform
description:
Eagle Production Co. | Wall Township, NJ (Hybrid or Remote for the right candidate) | Full-Time



About Eagle Production Co.

Eagle Production Co. is a nationwide AV equipment rental and production company based in New Jersey, running for over a decade. 



We rent and support audio, video, lighting, rigging, and power equipment for events across the country — from corporate premieres to touring productions.



Over the past year we’ve built something most companies our size don’t have: a full custom operations platform that runs the business — CRM, quoting, invoicing, payments, inventory availability, COI compliance, crew staffing, payroll support, fleet logistics, and customer/freelancer/driver portals. It was built fast using AI-assisted development (Lovable + Supabase), it’s live, it processes real money, and it works.

Now it needs an owner.



The Role

You will take over our platform as its dedicated engineer and technical owner. This is not a greenfield job and it’s not maintenance-only — it’s both harder and more interesting than either. You’ll inherit a large, live, AI-built codebase (~700 files, 150+ Supabase edge functions, 100+ database tables) and be responsible for three things:

 1. Keep it stable. New features have historically broken existing ones. You’ll change that — with tests around the money logic, disciplined releases, and real code review of every change, whether written by you or by AI tools.

 2. Keep it moving. The feature roadmap doesn’t stop. You’ll ship new functionality weekly, working directly with the CEO, using AI-assisted development where it’s fast and hand-written code where it’s right.

 3. Lead the migration off Flex Rental Solutions. Our inventory and operations still run partly on Flex. Over the next phases of our roadmap, this platform becomes the single hub for all company operations. You’ll architect and execute that migration — inventory, scanning, availability, warehouse workflows — without disrupting live operations.



What You’ll Do

 • Own the full stack: React/TypeScript frontend, Supabase backend (Postgres, RLS, edge functions, storage, cron), and the integrations around them (payment processing, QuickBooks, Gmail, Flex API, HubSpot, shipping/logistics APIs)

 • Stabilize and harden the existing codebase: eliminate duplicate logic, add a test suite around pricing, tax, invoicing, and payment flows, and close security gaps (RLS coverage, endpoint auth, storage policies)

 • Build new features end to end from CEO-defined requirements — often same-week turnaround

 • Plan and execute the Flex migration in phases: data model, sync strategy, cutover plan, rollback plan

 • Establish engineering discipline that survives AI-assisted development: GitHub-based workflow, pre-change audits, batched changes, post-change verification

 • Support the team using the platform daily (sales, warehouse, finance, HR) — triage issues fast, communicate clearly with non-technical users

 • Document what you build so the company is never dependent on any one tool or person

What We’re Looking For



Required:

 • 5+ years full-stack experience with deep React + TypeScript

 • Strong PostgreSQL, including Row-Level Security, and hands-on Supabase (or equivalent: Firebase + SQL, Hasura, etc.)

 • Experience owning a production system that handles real money — payments, invoicing, or e-commerce — and the paranoia that comes with it

 • Fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Copilot or similar) AND the judgment to review, constrain, and correct what those tools produce. We work AI-first here; we don’t work AI-blind.

 • Experience integrating third-party APIs (payment gateways, accounting,
)

 • Ability to work directly with a fast-moving, hands-on CEO: translate business requirements into working software quickly, push back when something is a bad idea, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain English

Strongly preferred:

 • Experience inheriting and stabilizing a large existing codebase (rescue/refactor work)

 • Migration experience: replacing a legacy system of record without downtime

 • Testing discipline: Vitest/Jest, and knowing what’s worth testing in a business app

Nice to have:

 • Rental, events, AV, or logistics industry exposure

 • Flex Rental Solutions, QuickBooks API, or Cardknox/payment gateway experience

 • Mobile/PWA experience (our warehouse runs barcode scanning on the platform)

What This Job Is Not

 • Not a junior role with AI doing the thinking — AI writes a lot of first drafts here; you own correctness

 • Not a big-company pace — decisions happen in hours, not sprints

 • Not siloed — you’ll talk to warehouse staff, salespeople, and the CEO in the same day

Compensation & Details

 • Salary: based on experience,

title: PROJECT MANAGER / INTEGRATOR FOR FOUNDER-LED BUSINESS
description:
PROJECT MANAGER / INTEGRATOR FOR FOUNDER-LED BUSINESS

Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term

20 hours/week to start | $10-$15 USD/hour depending on experience



ABOUT THE ROLE

I am Bari, the founder of a growing relationship coaching and education company with multiple marketing, sales, content, launch, website and client projects moving at the same time.



I am looking for a strong Project Manager / Integrator / Operations Coordinator who can take ownership of the entire operating picture.



This is NOT a task-based VA role.

This is NOT a role where I tell you what to do every day.

This is NOT primarily a social media role.



I need someone whose job is to know what is happening so I do not have to.



I am a fast-moving, creative founder and thought leader. I generate ideas, content and opportunities quickly. Your strength should be turning that vision into an organized, executable plan and making sure the work actually gets across the finish line.



WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS IN THIS ROLE

If we have a launch six weeks away, you know what needs to happen this week, next week and the week after - and who owns every piece.



If a team member misses a deadline, you notice and follow up.



If a social post is scheduled and fails, you notice before I do and make sure it gets resolved.



If a banner, link or page is outdated, you notice before I do.



If I owe the team an article, video, approval, client story or decision, you tell me clearly what you need, why you need it and by when - and make sure it is on my calendar.



If something is blocked, you solve what you can and escalate only what genuinely requires me.



I should not have to ask, "What happened with that?"



Your operating standard should be:

See it -> own it -> communicate it -> solve it -> close the loop.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own and maintain the master project plan and one source of truth for the business.

- Turn meetings, conversations, WhatsApp messages and founder ideas into clear tasks, owners, priorities and deadlines.

- Build realistic project plans and backward-plan launches from the launch date.

- Track dependencies, deadlines and deliverables across multiple team members.

- Follow up without waiting for me to ask.

- Maintain a simple weekly priorities process.

- Keep a highly visible "Founder Owes" list and put my deadlines on my calendar.

- Coordinate writers, designers, social media support, technical contractors and VAs.

- Identify gaps and risks before they become emergencies.

- Verify that completed work is actually live, tested and working.

- Make sure important work is fully closed out, not simply marked complete.

- Give me a concise weekly executive update: wins, priorities, risks, what I owe, and no more than three decisions needed from me.

- Help protect my time so I can focus on thought leadership, content, relationships, sales, coaching and client delivery.



FOUNDER / THOUGHT LEADER EXPERIENCE

Experience working directly with a founder, thought leader, coach, consultant, educator or other fast-moving creative entrepreneur is a strong plus.



You should understand that your role is not to make the founder become the project manager. Your role is to create clarity around the founder, translate ideas into execution, and keep the rest of the team moving.



LAUNCH EXPERIENCE

Experience personally project-managing launches is strongly preferred.



Examples may include:

- Courses or coaching programs

- Workshops, webinars or live events

- Quiz or assessment funnels

- Websites or landing pages

-
 campaigns

- Product or service launches



You should understand how to work backward from a launch date, identify major workstreams and dependencies, establish approval deadlines, coordinate multiple contributors, flag risks early, and make sure everything is tested before launch.



THE PERSON I AM LOOKING FOR

You are naturally organized, proactive and accountable.



You do not just know project-management terminology. You have actually managed projects involving multiple people, deadlines and dependencies.



You are comfortable respectfully holding people accountable.



You do not assume that because someone said, "I'll do it," it got done. You check.



You communicate clearly, concisely and professionally.



You can work with a creative, ADHD founder without requiring the founder to become the project manager.



You understand the difference between:

"I completed my task"

and

"I made sure the outcome happened."



SYSTEMS

We currently use tools including:

- ClickUp

- Google Drive

- Google Calendar

- WhatsApp

- GoHighLevel

- AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude



ClickUp experience is strongly preferred, but I am NOT hiring based on who calls themselves a "ClickUp expert."



I care much more about whether you know how to build and run a simple project-management system that gives everyone clarity and keeps work moving.



The system should serve the business - not become another project.



HOURS + COMPENSATION

- Approximately 20 hours/week to start

- $10-$15 USD/hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability

- Consistent weekday availability required

- Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time required

- Long-term opportunity with the potential to increase hours and compensation as the role and company grow



I am open to discussing rate for an exceptional candidate.



IMPORTANT - HOW TO APPLY

Do not send me a generic cover letter.



To show me that you read this entire posting, begin your application with the exact words:



I OWN THE PLAN



Then answer ALL of the questions below.



WRITTEN QUESTIONS

1. Tell me about one real project you personally owned that involved multiple people and deadlines. What did you do when someone missed a deadline?



2. A social media post was scheduled to go out Monday. It failed to publish, and the founder discovers this on Wednesday. What should have happened?



3. You discover that an important social media banner is promoting an event that happened three months ago. No one assigned you a task to update it. What do you do?



4. Tell me about your experience with ClickUp or other project-management systems. What did YOU personally build or manage inside the system?



5. Have you worked directly with a founder, thought leader, coach, consultant or creative entrepreneur? If yes, what did you own and how did you help keep that person focused while the business moved forward?



6. Have you ever personally managed a launch? Tell me what was being launched, how many people were involved, how far in advance you built the plan, the major workstreams/dependencies, and what you did when something fell behind.



7. What is your hourly rate?



8. What are your normal working hours and time zone?



9. How many hours per week are you currently available?



10. When could you start?



VIDEO REQUIRED - 2 TO 3 MINUTES

Please include a Loom or other short video introduction. No special production or editing is needed. I want to see how you think and communicate.



In your video, please answer:



1. Tell me briefly about your experience working directly with a founder, thought leader, coach, consultant or fast-moving entrepreneur. What did you personally own?



2. Tell me about one launch or complex project you personally managed. What were the major moving parts, and what happened when something fell behind?



3. Give me one example of something important you noticed or solved BEFORE the founder/client had to ask you about it.



4. If I give you ideas through meetings, WhatsApp messages and voice notes, how would you turn those into a clear plan without requiring me to become the project manager?



Please include the link to your video in your application.



APPLICATION FILTER

If your application does not begin with "I OWN THE PLAN," does not answer ALL of the written questions, or does not include the requested video, I will not consider it.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Strong candidates will be invited to a short interview focused on real project-management scenarios.



Finalists may be invited to complete a paid working test using a realistic founder-led business situation. The purpose is to see how you prioritize, create clarity, communicate, identify risks and take ownership - not simply how attractive your ClickUp board looks.



I am looking for a long-term team member who wants to help build something meaningful and become a trusted operational partner to the founder.

title: Inside Sales Advisor — Consultative Closer (Phone-Based)
description:
About Us:

Access Computer Training is a Florida-based, CIE-licensed technical training school with 12+ years in operation and 700+ graduates who have launched careers in IT, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Office Admin, and Project Management. Most of our students train through workforce grant funding, Vocational Rehabilitation, or VA benefits — so they don't pay out of pocket. Students who don't qualify for funding can self-pay in full or finance their training through Fortify, so there's a path for nearly every applicant we talk to.





Job Summary:

> We're hiring a closer, not a coordinator. You'll be on the phone with US-based leads who've already raised their hand for career training — your job is to qualify them fast, walk them through their funding options, handle objections, and get the enrollment agreement signed. 

> This is a sales role with a script foundation, not a scripted read-and-recite job — we need someone who can hear resistance and work it, not just push through a call flow.





What you'll actually do:

> Outbound and inbound calls to warm leads (not cold prospecting — these people already inquired)

> Qualify leads against 4 funding paths in the first 5 minutes of a call

> Run consultation calls and close on a signed enrollment agreement

> Handle real objections — cost, timing, "I need to think about it," "I already talked to someone else" — without going off-script into guesses

> Log every call and follow-up in our CRM (GoHighLevel) same-day, no exceptions





How we actually run a call:

We're not a hard-sell operation. Every real ACT call starts the same way: find out where this person actually is — their current skills, education, work history — and where they genuinely want to go, before naming a single program. Funding options get matched to their situation, not pitched as a one-size script. You'll still need to close — get to a signed enrollment agreement, handle real objections, keep a deal from going cold — but the close has to sit on top of real listening, not replace it. If your instinct is to pitch first and ask questions later, this isn't the right role, no matter how good you are at closing.





You're a strong fit if:

> You lead with genuine curiosity about a stranger's situation before you pitch anything — and you can still close once you understand what they actually need

> You have real phone-sales closing experience — outbound sales, telemarketing, insurance sales (not claims/service), timeshare, solar, BPO sales campaigns, or similar

> You're comfortable being told "no" multiple times a day and staying warm anyway

> Your spoken English is clear and confident on a live call, not just written English

> You've worked with a CRM before and you update it without being chased

> You can commit to a graveyard shift — this is a US Eastern-time role





This is not a fit if:

// Your background is customer service, data entry, chat support, or general VA work with no sales/closing component

// You've done appointment-setting but have never actually closed the deal yourself

// You're looking for a quiet admin role — this is a talk-to-strangers-on-the-phone-all-day role





To apply — this step is required, not optional:

>> Send a 60-second voice recording (phone memo is fine) responding to this exact objection, as if you were on a live call:

"I already talked to another school and I'm not sure yours is any different."

>> We're listening for how you actually sound on a call, not for a perfect script (and your way of handling the objection stated above)

>> Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.





Compensation:

$7.00 USD/hour base + performance bonus per enrollment, paid once your enrolled student reaches 40% course completion:

== Enrollments 1–5 each month: $25 flat, each

== Enrollments 6–9 each month: 2% of base tuition, each (programs range $5,000–$7,500, so roughly $100–$150 per enrollment at this tier)

== Enrollments 10+ each month: 5% of base tuition, each (roughly $250–$375 per enrollment at this tier)



*Bonus tier is locked in once you reach it that month — it doesn't drop if a student later withdraws for reasons outside your control

*Enrollment count resets every calendar month





*HOURS: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (this is a 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippines time shift)

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper



Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM HKT (Monday to Friday) including 1-hour lunch break and 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM HKT (Saturday)



JOB SUMMARY



We are seeking a highly skilled and organized Bookkeeper with strong hands-on experience with Xero to manage our financial records and ensure accurate bookkeeping practices. The Bookkeeper will work as a Contractor and play a key role in maintaining financial transactions, reconciling accounts, preparing financial statements, and assisting in financial reporting. This position requires strong attention to detail, proficiency in Xero, and the ability to work independently.



With a high level of attention to detail and a focus on delivering accurate work on time, you should be able to transform a conversation into high-quality documents and instructions.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Financial Data Management:

o Record day-to-day financial transactions, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, and general ledger entries.

o Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, ensuring proper classification and coding of transactions.

o Track and manage petty cash to ensure accurate recording of small expenditures.

o Categorize and allocate expenses to the appropriate accounts.

o Perform bank reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of financial data entries.

o Track financial transactions by building up accounts, completing the posting process, and ensuring compliance with legal requirements.



• Financial Reporting and Analysis:

o Prepare and analyze monthly Profit and Loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.

o Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

o Provide insights into financial performance to support decision-making processes.



• Payroll and Benefits Administration:

o Process payroll, ensuring accurate calculations of salaries, deductions, and benefits.

o Maintain employee payroll records.

o Coordinate with HR to ensure compliance with payroll regulations and timely submission of required reports.



• Compliance:

o Assist in the preparation of financial data for audits, ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulations.

o Collaborate with external auditors, providing necessary documentation and support during the auditing process.

o Ensure alignment with tax laws, reporting requirements, and tax filing deadlines.

o Stay updated on changes in accounting standards and regulations to ensure ongoing compliance.



• Inventory and Purchase Order Management:

o Monitor incoming, outgoing, and shipped products.

o Coordinate with the supply chain department to track inventory levels, purchase orders, and reconcile received goods.

o Collaborate with the supply chain team to resolve any discrepancies or issues related to inventory or purchase orders.



• Financial Systems and Process Improvement:

o Set up bookkeeping policies and procedures.

o Help lessen control risk in the inventory process by suggesting policies.

o Identify opportunities for process improvement in financial systems and procedures, recommending and implementing changes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.



QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS



• Minimum three (3) years of relevant experience in Bookkeeping or Accounting roles.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Strong hands-on experience with Xero software is a must.

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and bookkeeping practices.

• Experience in integrations (e.g., DEXT) is a plus.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high attention to detail.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

We are looking for a results-driven TikTok Shop Manager to oversee and grow our TikTok Shop operations. Key Responsibilities

* Track affiliate performance and develop strategies to increase affiliate engagement.

* Monitor competitor activity and identify market trends and opportunities.

* Process orders, monitor fulfillment, and resolve customer service issues related to the TikTok Shop.

* Analyze reports and provide recommendations to improve conversion rates, average order value, and overall shop performance.

* Ensure compliance with TikTok Shop policies and marketplace standards.

* Collaborate with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure inventory accuracy and timely order fulfillment.



Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience managing TikTok Shop or other e-commerce marketplaces.

* Strong understanding of TikTok Shop Seller Center and platform features.

* Experience with affiliate marketing and livestream commerce.

* Knowledge of digital marketing, social media, and content strategies.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and performance data.

* Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

title: SENIOR GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER / HEAD OF GROWTH
description:
# SENIOR GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER / HEAD OF GROWTH



**Full-Time | Remote | Singapore-Based Company | Singapore, Malaysia & Asia Markets**



We are looking for an **exceptional marketer — not an average marketing executive.**



This role is for someone who genuinely understands how to **build, grow and scale a brand**.



You should be able to look at a business, understand the products, customers, competitors and numbers, then build a clear marketing strategy to increase **traffic, conversion, revenue, customer retention and brand growth**.



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for tasks, schedules posts or follows instructions.



We want someone who can **think, strategize, execute, analyse and improve.**



## WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will take ownership of our overall marketing and growth across:



* Shopify

* TikTok Shop

* Shopee

* Lazada

* Meta /
 / Instagram

* TikTok

*
 / CRM

* Affiliate & Creator Marketing

* Influencer Marketing

* Product Launches

* Paid Advertising

* Organic Content

* Promotions & Campaigns

* Customer Retention

* Singapore, Malaysia and expansion into other Asian markets



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be expected to:



* Build the monthly, quarterly and annual marketing strategy.

* Create a proper marketing calendar months ahead.

* Plan campaigns, launches, promotions and sales periods.

* Develop paid advertising strategies across Meta and TikTok.

* Understand creative testing, hooks, offers, audiences and funnels.

* Analyse ROAS, CAC, AOV, CVR, CTR, retention and other key growth metrics.

* Identify why sales are increasing or declining and know what action to take.

* Improve Shopify conversion and customer journey.

* Grow TikTok Shop, Shopee and Lazada performance.

* Build strong affiliate and creator programs.

* Identify new marketing opportunities before being asked.

* Research competitors and market trends across Singapore, Malaysia and Asia.

* Work closely with designers and video editors to produce high-performing creatives.

* Write strong creative briefs rather than simply saying, “We need more content.”

* Plan product launches from pre-launch to launch and post-launch.

* Build strategies for customer acquisition, repeat purchases and retention.

* Track marketing performance and provide clear recommendations based on data.

* Test aggressively, learn quickly and continuously improve.

* Take responsibility for results.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are someone who:



* Has a strong track record in **e-commerce and growth marketing**.

* Understands both **brand building and performance marketing**.

* Can show examples of brands, campaigns or businesses you have helped grow.

* Understands numbers and makes decisions using data.

* Knows how Meta Ads and TikTok Ads actually work.

* Understands Shopify and e-commerce conversion.

* Understands TikTok Shop, Shopee and/or Lazada.

* Knows how to build campaigns around major sales periods and product launches.

* Has excellent marketing instincts.

* Can identify problems without waiting for management to point them out.

* Is highly resourceful and learns fast.

* Can work independently while leading and collaborating with a team.

* Communicates clearly.

* Takes ownership instead of making excuses.

* Thinks commercially — not just creatively.



Most importantly, you should be able to answer:



**“If I gave you a good product today, how would you turn it into a successful brand?”**



## THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



You mainly:



* Schedule social media posts.

* Wait to be told what to do.

* Depend completely on AI to create your strategies.

* Cannot interpret marketing data.

* Have never been responsible for revenue or growth.

* Only know one marketing channel.

* Copy competitors instead of developing original strategies.

* Need constant supervision.

* Send reports without explaining what the numbers actually mean.



We use AI extensively within the company, and we expect you to use AI intelligently too — but **AI should amplify your talent, not replace your ability to think.**



## WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



Within your first few months, we expect you to:



* Understand the business and customer deeply.

* Establish a clear growth strategy.

* Build a structured campaign calendar.

* Identify major opportunities and weaknesses.

* Improve our advertising and creative testing process.

* Establish clear marketing KPIs and reporting.

* Generate new ideas for customer acquisition and retention.

* Build systems that allow the company to scale.



We want someone who eventually knows the marketing side of the business so well that management does not need to constantly chase, remind or micromanage.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please do **not** send us a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



**“I BUILD GROWTH.”**



Then send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your strongest marketing achievement.

3. Actual numbers/results from a campaign or brand you worked on.

4. Which platforms you are strongest in.

5. A brand or e-commerce business you personally helped grow and exactly what you did.

6. An example of a marketing campaign you created from strategy to execution.

7. Your experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Shopee and Lazada.

8. Your current availability and expected monthly salary.

9. Portfolio, case studies or supporting screenshots where available.



**Final question:**



Imagine you join a sports, nutrition and performance lifestyle brand selling in Singapore and Malaysia.



You have **90 days to significantly grow revenue.**



**What are the first 5 things you would do, and why?**



We will prioritise applicants who give a thoughtful, commercially strong answer backed by real experience.



### THE PERSON WE WANT



We are not hiring someone simply to “do marketing.”



We are looking for someone with the potential to become a **key growth leader in the company** — someone who understands the vision, owns the numbers, builds the strategy and helps take the brand to the next level.



If you are genuinely exceptional at marketing and want the opportunity to prove what you can do, we want to hear from you.

THE MONEY

WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance (
) is an ABN-registered Australian business finance company. We connect Australian business owners with a panel of major non-bank lenders — and we’re growing fast. We need an experienced closer to join our remote team ASAP.

- Call warm, pre-generated leads — Australian business owners who have already shown interest in funding. No cold calling. No lead generation. No scraping lists.

- Qualify them, guide them through the loan process, handle objections, negotiate, and close — all the way to settlement.

- Full training on our products, lenders, and sales process is provided.

- Clear progression: your first 4 weeks are structured training and ramp-up on smaller loan facilities (up to ~$30K). You graduate to larger deals as you hit clear quality and settlement milestones.





HOURS — DAY SHIFT



- 45 hours/week, Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm PH time (1-hour lunch)

- Australian business hours = no graveyard shift. Finished by late afternoon, evenings free with your family.

- Fully remote.





WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’re a proven closer. Ideally you’ve worked in one of these:

- US merchant cash advance (MCA) / business lending campaigns

- Australian or US mortgage, asset finance, or business loan campaigns

- Debt solutions, insurance, or other financial products sales

- Loan/finance experience is strongly preferred — but we’ll consider exceptional closers from other industries who can show hard numbers.



Non-negotiables:

- 2+ years outbound sales experience with demonstrable results (targets hit, revenue closed — bring numbers)

- C1/C2 English — fluent, neutral accent

- Reliable internet plus backup power/internet solution

- Available 45 hrs/week on the schedule above

- A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts: Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives). Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.

title: Experienced California Legal Assistant
description:

title: Appointment setter
description:
B2B Appointment Setter



Part-Time Pilot | Remote | US Market | Education / Childcare |Gohighlevel



Enroll & Shine is a US-based company that helps independent preschools, childcare programs, and Montessori schools become easier for families to find online and turn visibility into enrollment opportunities.



We are looking for a **part-time B2B Appointment Setter for an initial pilot project** to help us determine whether outbound appointment setting is an effective way for us to connect with school owners and directors across the United States.



This is a **consultative appointment-setting role**, not a high-pressure telemarketing position.



The initial engagement is designed to **test the channel and evaluate results**. If the pilot is successful, there may be an opportunity to continue working together, but ongoing work is not guaranteed.



Your primary goal is simple:



**Start genuine conversations with school owners and directors and schedule qualified consultations.**



What You Will Do



* Make outbound calls to independent preschools, childcare centers, and Montessori schools

* Speak with owners, directors, and other decision-makers

* Introduce the reason for the call in a natural, conversational way

* Ask thoughtful questions to understand the school's current situation

* Identify whether the school may have a need or interest related to online visibility and enrollment

* Follow a structured, consultative sales methodology based on NEPQ

* Schedule qualified appointments directly on our calendar

* Follow up with prospects who have expressed interest

* Accurately record calls, conversations, outcomes, and follow-ups in our CRM

* Maintain consistent activity and follow-up

* Communicate regularly with the owner regarding activity, results, and feedback



What This Role Is NOT



You will **not** be expected to:



* Close the sale

* Give a lengthy presentation

* Explain every Enroll & Shine service

* Pressure prospects into appointments

* Use aggressive sales tactics

* Pretend there is a problem when there isn't one



Your job is to determine whether there is enough interest or need to warrant a conversation with Megan, the founder of Enroll & Shine.



Our Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



* Naturally conversational and personable

* An excellent listener

* Curious rather than pushy

* Comfortable asking questions

* Confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers

* Comfortable making outbound calls

* Resilient when people say no

* Highly coachable

* Organized and consistent

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to follow a defined process without sounding robotic



 Experience



**Required:**



* Previous B2B appointment-setting, outbound sales, or business development experience

* Strong spoken English

* Experience communicating with US-based prospects strongly preferred

* Reliable internet and professional home-office setup

* Ability to work during US business hours



**Strongly preferred:**



* Experience selling to or setting appointments with schools, childcare organizations, education companies, or other organizations in the education sector

* Experience speaking with owners, directors, administrators, or other decision-makers

* Experience selling services, SaaS, technology, marketing, or other consultative solutions

* Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM

* Experience using a sales dialer or outbound calling platform

* Demonstrated appointment-setting results



Education-sector experience is a strong advantage but not required. We would rather hire an excellent B2B communicator who is highly coachable than someone with education experience who is not a strong conversational salesperson.



What Success Looks Like



This pilot is about determining whether outbound appointment setting can become a viable acquisition channel for Enroll & Shine.



We will evaluate:



* Quality conversations

* Number of decision-makers reached

* Qualified appointments booked

* Appointment show rate

* Quality of appointments

* Prospect feedback

* Consistency of follow-up

* Overall results relative to the time and cost of the pilot



**Success is not simply making a high number of calls. We care about the quality and outcome of the activity.**



Pilot & Hiring Process



The initial engagement will begin with a **small paid trial** so both sides can determine whether the role is a good fit.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to:



1. Submit a brief voice recording

2. Participate in a short video interview

3. Complete a live appointment-setting role-play

4. Complete a small paid trial with real prospects



If the pilot produces strong results and the working relationship is a good fit, we may extend the engagement.



There is **no guarantee of ongoing work beyond the initial pilot**.



To Apply



Please include:



* A brief description of your B2B appointment-setting experience

* The types of businesses and decision-makers you have contacted

* Your experience calling US-based prospects

* Your typical daily call volume

* Any appointment-setting results or metrics you can share

* The CRM and calling systems you have used

* Your availability during US business hours

* A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a strong fit for this pilot



We are looking for a **real conversationalist, not a script reader**.



If you are curious, resilient, coachable, and genuinely enjoy talking with business owners, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Senior Instructional Designer / Curriculum & E-Learning Developer LMS
description:
About the Project



The National Association of Marine Vessel Surveyors (NAMVS) is developing a professional online training and certification academy at 
 for individuals pursuing careers, certifications, and continuing education in marine vessel surveying.



We are building a comprehensive professional training program designed to take students from foundational marine surveying concepts through advanced inspection, reporting, standards, systems, damage assessment, and professional practice.



We already have a separate LMS / WordPress Development Specialist responsible for building and managing the website, Tutor LMS platform, student dashboards, course delivery system, payments, certificates, and technical infrastructure.



This position is different.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Instructional Designer / Curriculum Developer / E-Learning Course Developer who will be responsible for actually designing and developing the educational program itself.



You will take marine surveying subject matter, technical references, industry standards, source materials, and guidance from subject-matter experts and turn them into a professional, structured, engaging online education program.



This is essentially the educational architect and course-development role for NAMVS.



Primary Responsibilities



You will be responsible for developing complete online training courses from concept through final instructional content.



Responsibilities will include:



Develop complete course curricula, modules, lessons, and instructional sequences.

Establish measurable learning objectives and competencies for every module and lesson.

Determine what students should know and be able to demonstrate before advancing.

Convert technical marine surveying information into clear, understandable professional instruction.

Write lesson content, instructor scripts, narration scripts, student reading materials, and study guides.

Develop PowerPoint/slide presentations, diagrams, illustrations, charts, inspection examples, and other instructional visuals.

Design and develop training videos, including storyboards, scripts, narration plans, demonstrations, and visual sequences.

Create interactive learning exercises and knowledge checks throughout each lesson.

Develop quizzes, examinations, practical assessments, and final module assessments.

Build professional question banks with multiple question types and appropriate difficulty levels.

Develop real-world marine surveying scenarios and case studies.

Create exercises requiring students to analyze vessel conditions, identify deficiencies, interpret findings, and make professional recommendations.

Develop photo-based inspection exercises where students identify defects, hazards, or compliance issues.

Create remediation content when students fail knowledge checks or assessments.

Establish passing standards and logical progression requirements.

Develop downloadable worksheets, inspection checklists, reference materials, and student resources.

Develop instructor notes and answer explanations where appropriate.

Ensure lessons progress logically from introductory concepts to advanced professional application.

Apply sound adult-learning and instructional-design principles throughout the program.

Ensure students are actively learning rather than simply watching videos or reading text.

Review and improve existing course materials for clarity, accuracy, consistency, and instructional effectiveness.

Work directly with marine surveying subject-matter experts to ensure technical accuracy.

Research unfamiliar technical subjects and convert SME information into effective instructional content.

Organize and maintain course source materials, references, scripts, graphics, assessments, and final instructional assets.

Work collaboratively with our LMS developer to ensure completed educational material is properly implemented into the online academy.

Course Development Philosophy



We do not want courses that simply consist of long videos followed by a quiz.



Each lesson should follow a professional instructional structure similar to:



Learning Objective → Instruction → Visual Explanation → Demonstration → Real-World Example → Interactive Exercise → Knowledge Check → Scenario/Application → Assessment → Remediation → Mastery



Students should understand not only what something is, but also:



Why it matters → How to inspect it → What can go wrong → How to recognize deficiencies → How to document findings → How to report them professionally



Marine surveying is a highly practical profession, so the training must continually connect theory to real-world vessel inspections.



Types of Content You Will Develop



The NAMVS curriculum will ultimately include subjects such as:



Marine surveying fundamentals, vessel construction, hull inspection, structural systems, propulsion systems, electrical systems, fuel systems, steering systems, plumbing systems, safety equipment, fire protection, navigation equipment, corrosion, moisture intrusion, damage assessment, valuation, sea trials, inspection procedures, photography, report writing, professional standards, ethics, client communication, and surveying business practices.



Courses will also incorporate applicable marine industry standards and accepted practices.



The instructional designer should be comfortable developing technically oriented education and working with source material involving organizations and standards such as ABYC, NFPA, NMEA, USCG, ISO, SAE, UL and other recognized marine industry references.



You are not expected to already be a marine surveyor. Marine-industry knowledge is beneficial, but we can provide subject-matter expertise.



What is essential is the ability to take expert technical knowledge and turn it into excellent education.



Training Video Development



A significant portion of the academy will use video-based instruction.



You should be capable of developing the educational side of video production, including:



Storyboarding, lesson scripting, instructor/narrator scripts, screen presentations, demonstrations, diagrams, animations, visual callouts, inspection photographs, captions, knowledge checks, and supporting instructional materials.



Experience with tools such as Camtasia, Adobe Premiere, Canva, PowerPoint, Articulate, Captivate, Synthesia, HeyGen, or similar e-learning/video-production tools is beneficial.



Professional-level video editing experience is an advantage but is not necessarily required if you are exceptionally strong in instructional design and course development.



Assessment Development



Assessments are extremely important to this program.



The successful candidate should understand how to develop assessments that measure genuine competency rather than simple memorization.



Students should encounter:



Knowledge checks, module quizzes, cumulative examinations, scenario-based questions, inspection photographs, deficiency-identification exercises, case studies, practical assignments, and final competency assessments.



Assessment questions should include explanations and remediation whenever appropriate so that testing also becomes part of the learning process.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone with professional experience in one or more of the following areas:



Instructional Design, Curriculum Development, E-Learning Development, Educational Technology, Adult Education, Online Course Development, Corporate Training, Technical Training, or Higher Education.



A degree in Instructional Design, Education, Educational Technology, Curriculum Development, Training & Development, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory if you have strong professional experience and an excellent portfolio.



Experience developing technical, vocational, professional-certification, safety, engineering, maritime, aviation, healthcare, industrial, or trade-based education would be particularly valuable.



Preferred Experience



Experience with instructional-design methodologies such as ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, Backward Design, competency-based education, adult learning theory, and scenario-based learning is highly desirable.



Experience with Articulate Storyline/Rise, H5P, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Canva, PowerPoint, SCORM, xAPI, Tutor LMS, LearnDash, Moodle, or similar tools is also beneficial.



You do not need to be a WordPress or full-stack website developer. We already have a team member responsible for that portion of the project.



What We Expect You to Produce



A completed NAMVS module should be much more than a collection of documents.



For each module, we expect a complete instructional package containing:



Curriculum structure, learning objectives, lesson plans, instructional content, presentations, graphics, diagrams, training-video scripts, narration, demonstrations, exercises, scenarios, knowledge checks, quizzes, examinations, answer explanations, remediation materials, student resources, and final assessments.



Everything should be organized so our LMS developer can implement the finished material into the NAMVS training platform.



Collaboration



You will work closely with:



NAMVS Management / Marine Surveying Subject-Matter Experts — providing technical knowledge, standards, field experience, photographs, examples, and professional guidance.



LMS / WordPress Development Specialist — implementing completed educational materials into 
 and managing the technical learning platform.



Instructional Designer / Curriculum Developer — You — responsible for transforming the subject matter into a structured, professional educational experience.



You will effectively serve as the bridge between the marine surveying experts and the students.



Quality Standard



Our objective is not to create a basic online course.



We intend to develop a professional online academy comparable in quality and structure to established vocational schools, professional-certification programs, and continuing-education institutions.



Courses should be engaging, visually professional, academically structured, technically accurate, and practical.



Students completing the program should feel that they have completed a serious professional education—not simply watched a collection of videos.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is intended to become a long-term project.



The initial assignment will involve developing our core Marine Vessel Surveyor training curriculum. After the primary program is completed, NAMVS expects to continue developing:



Advanced marine surveying courses, specialty certifications, damage and claims surveying courses, yacht surveying courses, commercial-vessel courses, continuing-education programs, professional-development courses, refresher training, recurring certification programs, and additional maritime education.



For the right person, this could develop into an ongoing Senior Instructional Designer / Director of Curriculum Development position as NAMVS expands.



When Applying



Please include:



A brief description of your instructional-design and curriculum-development experience.

Examples of online courses or training programs you have personally developed.

Your experience developing assessments, examinations, and competency-based training.

Your experience developing video-based or interactive e-learning.

The instructional-design software and tools you regularly use.

Your educational background and/or relevant certifications.

A portfolio or examples of previous course-development work.

Your availability and preferred working schedule.

Your expected monthly compensation.



Please do not apply if your primary experience is only WordPress development, website design, or LMS administration. This position is specifically focused on curriculum, instructional design, educational content, assessment development, and course production.

title: Financial Controller (UK-based; Remote)
description:
We're hiring on behalf of an independent finance advisory practice that partners with a live portfolio of fast-growing, product-based and retail brands across the UK.



The practice is led by a fractional CFO who currently handles the bulk of the accounting personally, across every business in the portfolio. 



We're hiring a Financial Controller to take full, end-to-end ownership of that function so the founder can step back from the day-to-day numbers and focus on advising clients and growing the practice.



This is a senior, hands-on role built around real ownership: one person running the finance function across multiple client accounts at once, not a large team to work through, and not a narrow, single-client bookkeeping job.



Because the businesses in the portfolio vary in size, sector, and complexity, the scope of this role will shift as needs change. You'll need to be comfortable adapting to what each client requires rather than working from a fixed, unchanging list of tasks.



Important

This role isn't suited to a purely transactional bookkeeper or someone who needs close supervision to stay productive.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership of problems from discovery through to resolution, who's comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, and who can hold a confident, informed conversation with a founder about the numbers.



What You'll Be Responsible For

1. Financial Reporting & Accounting

- Month-end close and management reporting across multiple client accounts

- Maintaining accurate financial records and reconciliations

- Supporting year-end accounting

2. Inventory & Operational Finance

- Inventory and landed cost accounting

- Retail deductions and operational finance support

- Managing and reconciling large datasets across multiple systems

3. Forecasting & Analysis

- Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts and cash flow projections

- Investigating and resolving discrepancies and variances independently

- Ad hoc financial and operational analysis

4. Process & Relationship Ownership

- Improving finance processes and workflows across the portfolio

- Running the day-to-day finance function with minimal oversight

- Representing the numbers with confidence when speaking with founders and stakeholders



What We're Looking For

- Proven experience running a finance function independently, not just contributing to one within a larger team

- Experience managing the finance function across multiple client accounts or entities at once, comfortable prioritising and moving between businesses of different sizes and complexity

- Genuine hands-on experience building management accounts and forecasts from scratch

- Comfortable producing forward-looking analysis and insight, not only reviewing and flagging issues in bookkeeping

- Strong accounting background with real exposure to product-based or inventory-heavy businesses

- Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, landed costs, reconciliations and operational finance workflows

- Experience with Amazon or e-commerce accounting operations and large transaction datasets

- Fluent in tools such as Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online and BI or reporting platforms

- CPA preferred or other similar certifications

- A confident, articulate communicator who is comfortable pushing back and defending their analysis with sound reasoning

- Naturally investigative, someone who wants to understand a business well enough to question its numbers, not simply record them

- Retail or wholesale accounting experience is a strong advantage



Working Setup

This is a fully remote, full-time position working UK business hours. To be considered for this role, you must have:

- A reliable computer suitable for full-time remote work

- A fast, stable primary internet connection, with a backup option available in case of an outage

- A quiet, professional workspace free from background noise and interruptions

- A good quality headset for clear communication

- A dedicated work environment where you can attend meetings and work without distractions



Please note that these requirements are essential, and we will assess your remote work setup as part of the recruitment process.



What Success Looks Like In This Role

Success in this role means leadership can confidently rely on you to own the numbers, reporting, forecasting, and finance operations without needing constant oversight.

HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Please submit all of the following:

2. Voice Recording

Send a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at speaking with prospective immigration clients. Please do not simply read from a prepared script.

A prospective client calls and says:

Write exactly what you would say next.

Write exactly what you would say.

Write exactly what you would say next.

A caller asks:

Write what you would do or say.

Start the first line of your application with the exact words:



CLIENT FIRST

title: Full-Time Project Manager / Operations Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Project Manager / Operations Coordinator to keep projects moving and make sure tasks get completed.



You do not need to be an expert in every area. We care most about ownership, communication, follow-through, resourcefulness, and the ability to learn quickly.



Your main responsibility is simple: help make sure things actually get done.



Responsibilities



You will manage projects, priorities, deadlines, owners, and next steps, follow up with team members and freelancers, identify stalled tasks and help move them forward, provide clear progress updates, create Fiverr job postings, review and shortlist applicants, coordinate interviews, paid tests, and onboarding, research tools and solutions, maintain organized documentation, create basic SOPs, perform quality-control checks, use AI for research and problem-solving, and handle occasional administrative tasks.



Projects may include websites, landing pages, marketing, AI, automation, communities, social media, content, design, video, and lead generation.



How We Work



Be settled in, connected, and ready before meetings begin. Take ownership of tasks through completion, communicate progress without waiting to be asked, raise problems early, and do not disappear when something becomes difficult or unclear.



Before asking a question, research the issue and make reasonable progress. When you need help, explain what you tried, what you found, and what you recommend doing next.



Follow through on commitments, confirm when work is complete, identify the next action when something is stalled, and own and correct mistakes quickly.



We do not expect perfection. We do expect communication, progress, accountability, and follow-through.



What We're Looking For



Strong written English, excellent organization, reliable internet, attention to detail, consistent communication, comfort managing multiple priorities, ability to work independently, resourceful problem-solving, willingness to learn, and comfort using AI tools.



Experience with project management, Fiverr, Upwork, ClickUp, Trello, Asana, 
, GoHighLevel, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, digital marketing, hiring, websites, or funnels is helpful but not required.



Do not skip applying because you do not check every box. We would rather hire someone dependable and trainable than someone who claims to know everything.



What Success Looks Like



When something is not moving, think: What is the next step? Who owns it? What is blocking it? What can I do to move it forward?



Do not simply report that something is stuck. Show what you have already done, what you learned, and what you recommend doing next.



Working Relationship



This is intended to be a long-term freelance/independent-contractor relationship. Continued work depends on performance, reliability, communication, business needs, and mutual fit. Initial work may serve as a paid evaluation period. Either party may end the engagement at any time, subject to Fiverr's terms and applicable law.



To Apply



Please send a short introduction, your experience coordinating projects or people, tools you have used, Fiverr or Upwork experience if any, your experience using AI, your availability, your internet speed, and why you are interested in a long-term role.



Also answer:



You discover that a project assigned to another freelancer has not moved for five days. What do you do?



Start your application with "PROJECT READY."
