title: Roofing Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — Full Time
description:
Experienced Roofing/Construction Cold Caller – Predictive Dialer



RoofReach LLC is hiring an EXPERIENCED roofing/construction cold caller and appointment setter. This is not an entry-level position.



Applicants must have prior experience cold calling homeowners for roofing, construction, home improvement, insurance restoration, exterior remodeling, or a closely related industry, and must have experience using a predictive dialer.



You will be calling approximately 800 leads per day through a predictive dialer to book homeowners for free roof inspections.



You will NOT personally speak with 800 people per day. Based on typical answer rates, you will probably speak with approximately 75–150 homeowners per day.



We are looking for someone who can consistently book at least 2 qualified appointments per day on average.



10 qualified appointments per week is only 2 appointments per day over a 5-day workweek.



Starting Pay



Starting compensation is:



$4.00 USD per hour

+$7.50 bonus for every qualified appointment booked

Performance Raise



If you are able to consistently average 10 qualified appointments per week, your compensation will increase to:



$7.00 USD per hour

+$10.00 bonus for every qualified appointment booked



Again, 10 qualified appointments per week is only an average of 2 appointments per day over a 5-day workweek.



We are looking for someone experienced enough to hit that target consistently. If you perform at that level, both your hourly rate and your appointment bonus increase.



Required Experience



You MUST have previous cold-calling experience specifically in:



Roofing

Construction

Home improvement

Insurance restoration

Exterior remodeling

Or a closely related home-services industry



General customer service experience by itself is not enough for this position.



You should already understand how to speak with homeowners about:



Free roof inspections

Storm and hail damage

Roofing concerns

Scheduling inspections

Home improvement services

Handling homeowner objections

Asking directly for the appointment

Getting a firm appointment on the calendar



You must also have experience using a predictive dialer and be comfortable with high-volume outbound calling.



What You Will Be Doing



You will be responsible for calling homeowners, following our script, handling objections, and scheduling qualified free roof inspections.



You must be comfortable:



Making high-volume outbound calls every day

Speaking clearly and confidently with American homeowners

Using a predictive dialer

Following a script without sounding robotic

Handling objections confidently

Asking directly for the appointment

Accurately entering notes and call dispositions

Meeting daily and weekly appointment goals

Receiving coaching and improving based on call performance

Performance Expectations



The target is:



2 qualified booked appointments per day on average



That equals:



10 qualified appointments per week



You will typically speak with approximately 75–150 homeowners per day, so we are looking for someone who already has the cold-calling experience and ability to convert those conversations into appointments.



We are specifically looking for someone who already knows how to cold call and does not need to be taught the basics of outbound sales.



Schedule



This is intended to be a full-time position, approximately 40 hours per week, working during appropriate U.S. calling hours.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



How long you have been cold calling.

Your specific roofing, construction, home improvement, or home-services cold-calling experience.

Which predictive dialers you have used.

How many appointments you typically booked per day or per week in your previous position.

A short video recording of yourself introducing yourself and explaining your roofing/construction cold-calling experience. A voice-only or audio recording will NOT be accepted.

In the video, briefly explain why you believe you can consistently book at least 2 qualified roof-inspection appointments per day.

Put “ROOF INSPECTION” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job posting.



Applications without a video recording will not be considered.



Do not apply if you have never cold-called homeowners for roofing, construction, or a similar home-service industry.



We are looking for a long-term team member who is confident they can consistently produce 2+ qualified appointments per day.



If you perform, your pay increases.

title: Sportsbook Link Researcher — Remote, Pay-Per-Link
description:
Company: 

Type: Independent contractor, part-time / flexible

Location: Remote

Pay: $0.03 per approved link, paid weekly (cap of $100 per week)



About the work:


 is a sports betting information and analytics platform. We show users where to find specific bets across major online sportsbooks, and to do that we need the exact page URL ("deep link") for each bet on each sportsbook.



Our system automatically finds some of these links, but most still need a human. That's where you come in. Our dashboard shows a live list of missing links (we call them bounties). You pick one, find the correct URL on the sportsbook's website, and submit it. That's the whole job.



What you'll do:

- Log in to our web dashboard and choose an open bounty (a specific game, bet type, and sportsbook)

- Navigate the sportsbook's site to find the page that lands directly on that bet

- Copy the URL and submit it through the dashboard

- Repeat as many times as you like



How you get paid:

- You earn a fixed amount for every approved link

- Every submission is reviewed (by us, with help from automated checks) to confirm it actually opens the correct bet. Links that are wrong, duplicated, or don't open the bet are not paid

- There are no set hours and no minimum. Work whenever you want, as much as you want

- Pay covers all approved links that you submitted during the work week (Monday–Sunday). Payment is sent after the week closes.

- Weekly earnings are capped at $100. Once you reach the cap, you're free to stop for the week.

- Your dashboard shows a running count of your approved and rejected links so you always know where you stand



What we're looking for:

- Comfortable using web browsers and navigating unfamiliar websites

- Attention to detail — the link has to open the exact bet, not just the game page

- Basic written English (our dashboard and instructions are in English)

- Reliable internet connection

- You must be able to access US sportsbook websites on your own. Many of these sites restrict access outside the US. We do not provide a VPN or any access tools — if you can't load the sites, you won't be able to do the work

- Sports betting knowledge is helpful but not required; we'll provide a short guide covering bet types (moneyline, spread, total, props) and each sportsbook's layout



Good to know

- Some sportsbooks (for example BetMGM) use a different subdomain for each US state. You only need to find the link once — we handle the state variations

- Consistently submitting incorrect links will result in removal from the program

- This is a contractor role with no benefits and no guaranteed hours. You're responsible for your own taxes



How to apply



Send a short message with:

- Your name and location

- Your weekly availability (rough estimate)

- One sentence on any experience with sportsbooks, data entry, or web research

title: Per Project Wordpress Builder
description:
We are hiring a **per-project WordPress + Elementor website builder** to work with our website production team.



This position is ideal for someone who wants consistent project work, clear systems, and the ability to earn more as they prove they can handle projects independently.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to drag Elementor widgets onto a page.



We want someone who **thinks.**



You should be able to follow instructions, pay attention to details, troubleshoot problems, communicate well, and use tools like ChatGPT and Claude intelligently.



### What We Provide



Our production process is highly systemized.



For standard website builds, **the website content will already be provided and mapped into the build.**



You are not being paid these project rates to research and write an entire website from scratch.



Your primary responsibility is taking the assets, content, instructions, and systems we provide and turning them into a polished finished website.



### What You'll Do



Projects may include:



* WordPress website builds

* Elementor Pro

* Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile implementation

* Following approved designs or templates

* Implementing mapped website content

* Forms

* Images and image optimization

* Internal linking

* Basic on-page SEO implementation

* Rank Math

* ACF/dynamic content when required

* CSS adjustments

* Website QC

* Revisions

* Troubleshooting issues

* Following our build SOPs and documentation requirements



We will train you on our specific production system.



### Compensation



This is a **per-project position**, not a monthly salary.



#### Probation Period



During your initial probation/training period:



**$90 per completed standard website**



There is no bonus structure during probation.



The purpose of this period is to learn our process, understand our expectations, and demonstrate that you can consistently complete projects correctly.



Once you have proven yourself, you can advance into our normal production tiers.



#### Tier 1 — Production Builder



Standard 10-page website:



**$70 base**



Plus:



* $10 First-Pass QC Bonus

* $5 On-Time Completion Bonus

* $5 Clean Handoff / Documentation Bonus



**Up to $90 per standard 10-page website**



#### Additional Pages



Pages beyond the standard project are compensated based on complexity:



**Basic / cloned page:** $3 per page



**Enhanced page:** $4 per page



Advanced custom pages, functionality, or unusual project requirements are priced separately before work begins.



#### Tier 2 — Certified Builder



**$100 per standard 10-page website**



Tier 2 is earned through performance.



Typically, we want to see at least 5 successful builds demonstrating:



* Strong first-pass QC

* Reliable on-time delivery

* Good communication

* No recurring quality issues

* Understanding of our SOPs

* Ability to troubleshoot independently



#### Tier 3 — Advanced Builder



Typically:



**$125–$175+ per project**



These builders can handle more complex projects, troubleshoot independently, require less management, and consistently produce high-quality work.



Your earning potential increases as your value and capabilities increase.



### Who We're Looking For



Experience matters, but **how you work matters more.**



We would rather hire someone with 4 years of experience who is adaptable, hungry, and pays attention than someone with 10 years of experience who is stuck in their ways.



You should:



* Have solid Elementor Pro experience

* Understand WordPress

* Be comfortable using ChatGPT and/or Claude

* Follow instructions carefully

* Ask questions when something is genuinely unclear

* Be capable of working independently

* Communicate well with a team

* Notice mistakes before QC notices them

* Be willing to learn our processes

* Accept constructive feedback

* Take deadlines seriously

* Think critically

* Troubleshoot problems

* Look for solutions instead of immediately saying something cannot be done



We don't expect you to know our internal AI systems before joining.



If you already understand how to effectively use ChatGPT or Claude, we can teach you our specific workflows.



### The Mentality We're Looking For



When you encounter a problem, we don't want your first response to be:



**"What do I do?"**



We want you to first think:



**"What is supposed to happen here? What information do I have? What can I test? Can I solve this safely myself? If I can't, what information does the team need from me to help solve it?"**



There is nothing wrong with asking questions.



In fact, asking good questions is extremely important.



But there is a major difference between asking a thoughtful question after investigating a problem and requiring someone to think through every problem for you.



### How to Apply



Please complete everything below.



**Start your application with:**



**"I READ THE ENTIRE POST."**



Then answer:



**1. Portfolio**



Send 3 Elementor websites you personally worked on.



Tell us specifically what YOU did on each website.



**2. Experience**



How long have you been working with WordPress and Elementor?



What parts of a website build can you confidently complete independently?



**3. AI**



How do you currently use ChatGPT or Claude while building websites?



Give us a real example.



**4. Problem-Solving Scenario**



Imagine you are assigned a website.



The content has already been written and mapped.



You are halfway through the build and notice three things:



1. One section does not fit the content very well.

2. The mobile version looks significantly worse than the desktop version.

3. A form is not submitting properly.



The project manager will not be available for the next two hours.



**Explain exactly what you would do.**



Walk us through your thought process in order.



Tell us:



* What you investigate

* What you try yourself

* What you would change without approval

* What you would NOT change without approval

* What work you would continue completing

* When you would escalate something

* What you would send the project manager when asking for help



There isn't one perfect answer.



We want to see how you think.



### Growth



We want builders who become more valuable over time.



Someone who starts by following our SOPs but eventually becomes capable of independently troubleshooting difficult builds is worth considerably more to us.



If you're competent, reliable, efficient, willing to learn, and interested in getting better instead of simply getting projects done, this could become a very strong long-term opportunity.

title: TikTok Ops Specialist
description:
We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.

---





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

    [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

    [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

title: Social Listening and Media Analytics Manager
description:
Change Craft is a Sacramento-based strategic communications firm serving government agencies, nonprofits, businesses, and political campaigns across California. Design and own the measurement strategy across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels

Configure and run social listening tools to surface trends, sentiment, and emerging conversations

Translate raw data into clear insight briefs and recommendations for creative and growth teams

 teams to close the loop from insight to action

Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to make data compelling to non-analysts

Nice to Have



Familiarity with additional platforms such as Meltwater, Brandwatch, or Sprinklr

Experience authoring measurement plans

Experience presenting to executive audiences

SQL or advanced spreadsheet modeling experience

Experience with brand health or sentiment tracking programs

What Change Craft Offers



Competitive, experience-based compensation

A remote-friendly, flexible working environment

Real ownership over your area from day one

A small team where your work is seen and valued

title: Video Editor for Ongoing Short-Form Projects | CapCut, Part-Time (Growth Opportunity)
description:
We run a $100M apartment portfolio in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas. Your cuts show up on our Instagram, our TikTok, and on the listing page someone's looking at right before they d
 to move in. We're hiring a part-time Video Editor to

turn raw phone footage into the videos that make that decision easier.



This is ongoing work, not a one-off project. We want someone who grows with us, and we expect this role to expand.



10 to 20 hours per week, part time.



USD $250 to $500 per month depending on experience and speed. We review pay at 90 days.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY WEEK



- Cut 4 to 8 vertical short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from raw footage we send you

- Edit property tour and listing walkthrough videos and talking heads, usually 60 to 90 seconds, the kind that make a unit feel like somewhere you would actually want to live

- Add captions, text overlays, music, and simple transitions

- Trim longer talking-head recordings into shorter clips

- Keep files organized and named the way we ask



TOOLS YOU NEED



- CapCut. Not "used it once," fast in it, real muscle memory

- Vertical (9:16) formatting and auto-captions, including cleaning up the captions CapCut gets wrong

- Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is a plus, not required



You should be able to follow a written brief without a call, and have your own computer and reliable internet.



WORK SCHEDULE AND FLEXIBILITY



We'd like a few hours that overlap US Central Time mornings so we can hand off footage and answer questions the same day. We also know flexibility matters. For the right person, we're open to reasonable accommodations to fit your schedule in the Philippines.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here, it takes about 5 minutes:


 Editor&howDid=Onlinejobs.ph



In the "Which software/tools are you strongest in?" field, start your answer with the word CAPCUT.



In the portfolio field, link 2 to 3 vertical videos YOU personally edited.

Show us, don't tell us.



The form asks for a short Loom video introduction. That's your audition. Pick one edit you're proud of and walk us through the choices you made and why.



Finalists do one short paid test edit, about 1 to 2 hours, USD 25 flat. We don't ask anyone to work for free.

title: HR Specialist/ (Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.



Qualifications & Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

9. Shift arrangement: Day shift for the first month, then transfer to night shift permanently.



Application Guidelines

If you are interested in this position, please submit the following materials:

1. Your updated resume (resume link is acceptable).

2. Interested candidates please submit your application and fill out the questionnaire via the link below:


/share/base/form/shrlgzDguRc5jayVxeQLRnvW8Vc



Notice: Please mention in your application message that you have completed the questionnaire. We will conduct preliminary screening by combining your questionnaire information and resume. Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via
 for an interview invitation. Wish you all the best.



Company Information

Company 
/



Company Benefits

We provide a stable working environment and clear career growth. Your professionalism and dedication will be highly valued. Candidates with Chinese skills enjoy better development opportunities and priority in recruitment. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Solar Sales Consultant
description:
We are an established Australian renewable-energy company specialising in solar, battery storage and energy solutions.



We are looking for an experienced Sales Closer based in the Philippines to join our growing team remotely. You will speak with Australian homeowners and businesses, understand their requirements, recommend suitable solutions and manage opportunities through to signed contracts.



This is not primarily a cold-calling or appointment-setting role. You will receive inbound and assigned enquiries and will be responsible for following them up professionally and converting qualified opportunities into sales.



Key responsibilities:

• Contact inbound and assigned leads promptly by phone,
 and SMS

• Conduct professional sales consultations with Australian homeowners and businesses

• Understand customers’ electricity usage, objectives and budget

• Present suitable solar and battery solutions clearly and confidently

• Follow up quotations consistently and convert opportunities into signed contracts

• Handle pricing, product and competitor objections professionally

• Maintain accurate notes, activities and follow-up tasks in our CRM

• Work closely with our design, operations and installation teams

• Meet weekly activity, conversion and revenue targets

• Ensure all information provided to customers is accurate and compliant

• Maintain ownership of opportunities until the sale is properly handed over



Requirements:

• At least three years of phone-based sales or closing experience, preferably within the solar or renewable-energy industry

• Proven success converting warm or inbound leads

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Clear, professional communication suitable for Australian customers

• Confident objection handling and negotiation skills

• Strong follow-up habits and attention to detail

• Comfortable working with targets, KPIs and commission

• Reliable high-speed internet, quality headset and quiet home office

• Available full-time during Sydney business hours

• Experience selling solar, batteries, energy, finance, telecommunications or home-improvement products is highly regarded

• Familiarity with Australian customers or the Australian market is strongly preferred

title: Social Media Copywriter & Content Strategist
description:
We're a fast-growing marketing agency creating content for luxury medical aesthetic practices, including doctors, nurses, providers, and hairstylists, along with other high-end brands. We already have a strong team in place and are scaling quickly, so there's real room to grow with us, including bonuses and raises as you prove yourself.



We're looking for someone with excellent written English who knows how to make words sound good, whether that's a caption that stops the scroll, a content concept our videographers can shoot, or a teleprompter script that sounds natural coming out of a client's mouth on camera. This is a writing-first role.



Please do not apply without writing samples. Applications without samples will not be considered.



What You'll Be Doing

Content concepts and ideas for our videographers to film

Teleprompter scripts for clients to read on camera

Captions for Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms

Market research to inform messaging, trends, and content angles

Understanding brand voice and adjusting tone across different clients

Promotional and campaign copy

Working closely with our creative team to align writing and concepts with visuals



What The Role Looks Like

High volume, consistent output across multiple clients each week

Speed matters as much as quality, we need someone who writes fast without sacrificing polish

Clear path to growth, bonuses, and raises as the company scales



Requirements

Writing samples demonstrating strong, natural, high-end copy (required to apply)

Excellent command of written English, tone, grammar, and flow all matter

Ability to generate original content concepts, not just write from a brief

Experience with market research or understanding audience psychology is a plus

Comfort writing for luxury medical, aesthetic, or high-end lifestyle brands

Familiarity with Google Sheets for organizing scripts and content calendars



Schedule & Compensation

Full-time, Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM (8 hours/day)

$350/month, paid every two weeks via Wise, with room for growth and performance-based bonuses



How to Apply

Send writing samples along with your application. Applications without samples will not be reviewed.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

arbitrage leads for our store. Must already be comfortable with SellerAmp 

and Keepa — this is not an entry-level/training role.

warning, then pay adjustment, then termination if it continues

- Amazon's restricted categories, gated brands, and common IP-risk red

title: Job Title: Video Editor + Thumbnail Designer for B2C Info-Business YouTube, Ads & VSLs
description:
About Us

We work with B2C info businesses (coaches, course creators, and education-based brands) to grow their YouTube channels and paid acquisition. Our focus isn't chasing viral views — it's building watch time, trust, and conversions that turn viewers into customers, leads, and buyers. We're looking for a long-term editor who understands that difference and can move fluidly between content types.



The Role

We need a versatile video editor who is genuinely strong across styles — long-form YouTube, short-form clips, paid ad creatives, and VSLs (Video Sales Letters) — plus can design scroll-stopping YouTube thumbnails. You'll take raw footage (talking-head, screen recordings, interviews, UGC-style clips) and turn it into whatever format the project calls for, always built around retention and conversion, not vanity metrics. This is a combined editing + graphic design role — we're not looking to hire separate specialists for each format.



Heads up on how this starts: we're beginning with a small, low-volume workload as a trial run. This isn't a red flag on the role — it's how we bring everyone in. Once we see the quality and reliability of your work and more trust is built, expect to receive more work on a consistent basis.



What You'll Be Doing



Editing long-form YouTube videos (typically 10-25 minutes) for pacing, clarity, and retention

Cutting short-form content (Shorts/Reels/TikTok-style clips), often repurposed from long-form footage

Editing VSLs — structuring hooks, pain points, proof, and calls-to-action to move a viewer toward a buying decision

Editing paid ad creatives (Meta/YouTube/TikTok ads) built to convert, not just entertain

Designing custom YouTube thumbnails for every long-form video (high-CTR, on-brand)

Adding b-roll, captions/subtitles, sound design, music, and motion graphics where it serves the content — not for flash

Following brand guidelines and keeping a consistent visual style across formats and channels

Organizing and managing project files/assets so nothing gets lost between revisions

Taking notes/feedback and turning revisions around quickly and without back-and-forth



What We're Looking For



Proven range across long-form YouTube AND short-form content — please only apply if you're genuinely strong at both, not one with the other as an afterthought

Real experience editing VSLs and/or direct-response ad creatives — you understand hooks, pacing toward a CTA, and structuring for persuasion, not just aesthetics

Graphic design skills for thumbnails (Photoshop, Canva, or similar) — this is not optional

Strong sense of pacing and storytelling for content meant to build trust and drive action, across every format

Comfortable with captions, basic color correction, audio cleanup, and motion graphics/text animation

Understanding of what makes B2C/coaching/course-style content convert (clarity, credibility, calls-to-action) vs. what makes it "viral" — we care about the former

Reliable communicator, meets deadlines, takes direction well on revisions

Strong English communication skills

Comfortable starting with a lighter initial workload that grows as trust and consistency are established



Nice to Have



Experience editing for coaches, consultants, course creators, or other info-business/education-based brands specifically

Experience with AI tools for editing efficiency (transcription, rough cuts, etc.)

Basic understanding of YouTube SEO (titles, descriptions, tags)

Direct response / performance marketing background (you know what a good ad "feels" like, not just what looks good)



To Apply

Please send:



A portfolio/demo reel that shows range — long-form YouTube, short-form, at least one VSL or ad example, and thumbnail examples. We want to see all of it, not just your best format

Your typical turnaround time per video/project

Your rate (open to proposals — tell us how you'd structure it: per video, hourly, or monthly retainer). Note that we're starting with a lower volume and scaling based on quality, so flexibility on early workload is a plus



We're looking to build a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Full-Time WFH Customer Success and Retention Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

description:
ROLE SUMMARY:



We are hiring a TikTok Project Manager / Content Operations Manager who will act as the central organizer and coordinator of all TikTok-related workflows, brand collaborations, and content production schedules.

This role is part project manager, part brand manager, and part personal assistant to the creator. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — deadlines, contracts, samples, content plans, posting schedules, brand communications, and follow-ups.

You will work closely with:

-The creator

-Video editor(s)

-Bookkeeper

-Chief of Staff



This role will start part-time with the intention to scale to full-time within ~3 months, depending on workload and performance.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

-Content Planning & Production Management

-Create and manage weekly and daily content schedules for:

-TikTok Shop product videos

-Personal brand content

-Organize filming days by content type (e.g., skincare days, makeup days, fashion days)



Assign due dates to:

-Raw footage

-Edited videos

-Posting deadlines



Ensure editors receive content on time and deliver edits on schedule

-TikTok Shop Sample & Deadline Tracking

Monitor TikTok Shop backend for:

-Sample requests

-Accepted samples

-Video due dates



Track:

-Products received

-Videos still pending

-Extensions (when needed)

-Ensure creator is reminded before deadlines, not after

-Maintain ethical review timelines (allowing enough product testing time)

-Brand Collaboration Management

-Screen inbound brand
s and collaboration requests both in
 inbox, Lark, Slack and in all TikTok inboxes multiple times a day



Filter out:

-Scams

-Low-quality offers

-Brands that do not meet criteria



Respond to qualified brands using approved templates:

-Send rate cards

-Enforce non-negotiable pricing

description:

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.

ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

title: Moving Consultant
description:
Moving Sales Consultant | Fully Remote



Elevate Moving Sales is growing and looking for motivated Moving Sales Consultants to join our remote sales team.



We work with moving companies across the United States, helping them follow up with leads, build estimates, and turn more opportunities into booked moves.



What You’ll Be Doing



* Calling and following up with inbound moving leads

* Speaking with customers about their upcoming move

* Gathering move details and building accurate estimates

* Following up with leads by phone, text, and

* Handling objections and closing moves

* Keeping customer information and follow-ups organized in the CRM

* Working alongside our sales team to hit individual and company goals



Who We’re Looking For



Previous moving sales experience is strongly preferred.



We’re looking for people who are:



* Confident and professional on the phone

* Comfortable having a high volume of customer conversations

* Competitive and motivated by sales

* Reliable and consistent

* Comfortable working remotely

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Experienced with moving CRMs or moving estimates is a major plus



Fully Remote, But You’re Still Part of a Team



This isn’t the typical remote job where you work alone all day.



Our team works together inside a virtual office, where you’ll have your own virtual workspace that you can decorate and personalize. You’ll be working alongside the rest of the team throughout the day, making it feel much more like an actual office while still getting to work completely remotely.



Elevate Moving Sales is a fast-growing company with a competitive, rewarding team environment. We’re looking for people who want to grow with us and become a long-term part of the team.



How to Apply



Send us a message with:



1. A brief description of your sales experience, especially any moving industry experience

2. A voice recording introducing yourself and telling us about your experience

3. Your availability and preferred working hours



Please include all three when applying.



If you have moving sales experience and know how to turn leads into booked moves, we’d love to hear from you.

Our focus isn't chasing viral views — it's building watch time, trust, and conversions that turn viewers into customers, leads, and buyers. We're looking for a long-term editor who understands that difference and can move fluidly between content types.



The Role

We need a versatile video editor who is genuinely strong across styles — long-form YouTube, short-form clips, paid ad creatives, and VSLs (Video Sales Letters). You'll take raw footage (talking-head, screen recordings, interviews, UGC-style clips) and turn it into whatever format the project calls for, always built around retention and conversion, not vanity metrics.



Heads up on how this starts: we're beginning with a small, low-volume workload as a trial run. This isn't a red flag on the role — it's how we bring everyone in. Once we see the quality and reliability of your work and more trust is built, expect to receive more work on a consistent basis.



What You'll Be Doing



Editing long-form YouTube videos (typically 10-25 minutes) for pacing, clarity, and retention

Cutting short-form content (Shorts/Reels/TikTok-style clips), often repurposed from long-form footage

Editing VSLs — structuring hooks, pain points, proof, and calls-to-action to move a viewer toward a buying decision

Editing paid ad creatives (Meta/YouTube/TikTok ads) built to convert, not just entertain

Adding b-roll, captions/subtitles, sound design, music, and motion graphics where it serves the content — not for flash

Following brand guidelines and keeping a consistent visual style across formats and channels

Organizing and managing project files/assets so nothing gets lost between revisions

Taking notes/feedback and turning revisions around quickly and without back-and-forth



What We're Looking For



Proven range across long-form YouTube AND short-form content — please only apply if you're genuinely strong at both, not one with the other as an afterthought

Real experience editing VSLs and/or direct-response ad creatives — you understand hooks, pacing toward a CTA, and structuring for persuasion, not just aesthetics

Strong sense of pacing and storytelling for content meant to build trust and drive action, across every format

Comfortable with captions, basic color correction, audio cleanup, and motion graphics/text animation

Understanding of what makes B2C/coaching/course-style content convert (clarity, credibility, calls-to-action) vs. what makes it "viral" — we care about the former

Reliable communicator, meets deadlines, takes direction well on revisions

Strong English communication skills

Comfortable starting with a lighter initial workload that grows as trust and consistency are established



Nice to Have



Experience editing for coaches, consultants, course creators, or other info-business/education-based brands specifically

Experience with AI tools for editing efficiency (transcription, rough cuts, etc.)

Basic understanding of YouTube SEO (titles, descriptions, tags)

Direct response / performance marketing background (you know what a good ad "feels" like, not just what looks good)

Basic graphic design skills (not required, but a plus if you can also help with simple visual assets)



To Apply

Please send:



A portfolio/demo reel that shows range — long-form YouTube, short-form, and at least one VSL or ad example. We want to see all of it, not just your best format

Your typical turnaround time per video/project

Your rate (open to proposals — tell us how you'd structure it: per video, hourly, or monthly retainer). Note that we're starting with a lower volume and scaling based on quality, so flexibility on early workload is a plus



We're looking to build a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounting Clerk / Bookkeeper for Event Management Company
description:
Do You Notice When the Numbers Don’t Make Sense?



Are you the person who spots the missing transaction, questions an unusual charge, and keeps working until every number has an explanation?



H+A is looking for a full-time, virtual Accounting Clerk who takes pride in accuracy, organization, and follow-through. You will support H+A's financial operations and multiple association clients. Your work will include account reconciliations, expense management, accounts payable and receivable, client invoicing, and financial reporting.



This position is a strong fit for someone who enjoys detailed work, manages recurring deadlines without constant reminders, communicates problems early, and understands that accurate financial records protect both our clients and our reputation.



We value people who take ownership, think ahead, solve problems, support their teammates, and continually look for ways to improve their work.



How to Apply - Attention to detail is essential in this position, so please follow these instructions carefully.



Send an
 with the subject line:  Every Number Has a Story | Accounting Clerk Application



Please include:

Your current resume.

A video with the following:

           A brief introduction explaining why your experience prepares you for this position.

           The H+A core value that resonates most with you and a brief explanation of why.

           Your location, time zone, and the hours you can consistently work in the U.S. Central Time Zone.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



We are looking for more than someone who can enter transactions. We want a dependable accounting professional who asks thoughtful questions, protects confidential information, and helps us trust the story our numbers are telling.



The Accounting Clerk supports our company's and clients' financial operations. They will maintain accurate financial records, reconcile bank, credit card, and payment-processing accounts, prepare client invoices, track reimbursable expenses, and produce timely financial reports. This position requires exceptional accuracy, strong follow-through, confidentiality, and the ability to manage financial information for multiple organizations.



Responsibilities:



BANK AND ACCOUNT RECONCILIATION

Reconcile company and client checking, savings, and investment accounts each month. 

Reconcile company and client credit card statements. 

Reconcile merchant-processing accounts, including registration payments, credit card deposits, processing fees, refunds, chargebacks, and bank deposits. 

Research and resolve discrepancies, duplicate transactions, missing deposits, and uncategorized expenses. 

Confirm that account balances agree with bank statements and supporting documentation. 

Maintain separate and accurate records for each H+A client. 

Prepare monthly reconciliation reports for the Owner/CEO's review. 

Escalate unusual transactions, unreconciled balances, or suspected errors promptly. 



EXPENSE MANAGEMENT

Manage financial activity within Expensify. 

Review submitted expenses for receipts, appropriate coding, business purpose, client assignment, and approval. 

Import approved expenses into the accounting system. 

Identify missing receipts, incomplete descriptions, duplicate expenses, and incorrect client allocations. 

Track reimbursable expenses paid by H+A on behalf of clients. 

Maintain documentation that supports every reimbursement request. 

Assist employees and team members with expense-report questions. 



CLIENT INVOICING AND ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE

Prepare accurate and timely client invoices for management fees, project fees, event-related charges, and reimbursable expenses. 

Attach supporting documentation when required. 

Confirm that expenses appear on the correct client invoice. 

Track outstanding invoices and accounts receivable. 

Prepare aging reports and identify overdue balances. 

Send approved payment reminders or provide follow-up information to the Owner/CEO. 

Apply client payments accurately within the accounting system. 

Research short payments, overpayments, duplicate payments, and unapplied credits. 

Maintain records of deposits, credits, refunds, and adjustments. 



ACCOUNTS PAYABLE

Review vendor invoices for accuracy, proper authorization, and correct company or client coding. 

Enter approved bills into the accounting system. 

Match invoices with contracts, purchase approvals, receipts, or other supporting documents. 

Prepare payment schedules for review and approval. 

Track vendor due dates and help prevent late fees. 

Maintain current vendor records and payment documentation. 

Assist with gathering W-9 forms and year-end 1099 information. 

Identify duplicate invoices, unexpected charges, or changes in vendor pricing. 



FINANCIAL REPORTING

Prepare monthly financial reports for H+A and assigned clients. 

Generate profit and loss statements, balance sheets, accounts receivable reports, budget-to-actual reports, and other requested reports. 

Prepare clear summaries that identify discrepancies, outstanding items, and areas requiring management attention. 

Assist with event-specific financial reports, including registration revenue, sponsorship revenue, exhibitor income, vendor expenses, refunds, and final event results. 

Maintain spreadsheets or tracking reports used for client reporting. 

Provide accurate supporting schedules to the Owner/CEO, client leaders, CPA, or tax professionals. 



MONTH-END AND YEAR-END SUPPORT

Follow a documented month-end closing checklist for each organization. 

Confirm that all bank, credit card, merchant, and expense accounts have been reconciled. 

Review uncategorized transactions and outstanding reconciliation items. 

Verify that client reimbursements and management fees have been invoiced. 

Organize reports and supporting documentation for monthly client review. 

Assist the CPA with year-end close, tax preparation, audits, and requested documentation. 

Help prepare records for 1099 reporting and other annual financial requirements. 

Maintain organized electronic files according to the company’s document-retention standards. 



INTERNAL CONTROLS AND CONFIDENTIALITY

Protect confidential company, client, employee, vendor, and banking information. 

Follow established approval procedures for bills, reimbursements, refunds, credits, and account changes. 

Never release payments, change vendor banking information, or process unusual refunds without proper approval. 

Maintain a clear audit trail for financial entries, corrections, and adjustments. 

Immediately report suspected fraud, phishing attempts, irregular transactions, or security concerns. 

Follow company password, multifactor authentication, and data-security requirements. 



GENERAL SUPPORT

Respond promptly and professionally to internal and client accounting questions. 

Communicate missing information and upcoming deadlines clearly. 

Document recurring accounting procedures. 

Recommend ways to improve accuracy, efficiency, and reporting. 

Participate in regular meetings with the Owner/CEO. 

Complete other accounting and administrative duties as assigned. 



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

At least three years of bookkeeping, accounting-clerk, or accounting-assistant experience. 

Experience supporting a U.S.-based company or clients. 

Practical knowledge of bank, credit card, and merchant-account reconciliation. 

Experience preparing invoices and tracking accounts receivable. 

Experience reviewing vendor invoices and maintaining accounts-payable records. 

Proficiency with QuickBooks Desktop and Quickbooks Online. 

Prefer experience moving files from Quickbooks Desktop to Quickbooks Online platform. 

Experience with Expensify or a similar expense-management system. 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills, including filters, sorting, formulas, and reconciliation worksheets. 

Ability to understand a profit and loss statement, balance sheet, general ledger, and accounts-receivable aging report. 

Strong written and spoken English. 

Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy. 

Ability to manage multiple organizations, accounts, and deadlines without mixing financial information. 

Strong judgment and willingness to ask questions when information appears incomplete or incorrect. 

Proven ability to handle confidential financial information. 

Reliable computer, secure internet connection, and a professional remote workspace. 

Ability to maintain regular working-hour overlap with the H+A team in the Central Time Zone. 



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field. 

QuickBooks Online certification. 

Experience working with association-management, event-management, or professional-services companies. 

Experience handling books for multiple clients or business entities. 

Experience reconciling Stripe, PayPal, 
, event-registration platforms, or other merchant processors. 

Experience with deferred revenue, event deposits, registration refunds, sponsorships, and reimbursable client expenses. 

Familiarity with U.S. GAAP and accrual-based accounting. 

Experience supporting a CPA or assisting with month-end and year-end close. 

Experience with Gusto or another U.S. payroll platform. 

Experience gathering W-9 information and supporting 1099 preparation. 



H+A seeks someone who:

 Notices when numbers do not make sense. 

 Enjoys detailed, repetitive work and completes it consistently. 

 Meets deadlines without repeated reminders. 

 Documents their work so another person can follow it. 

 Communicates problems early. 

 Takes ownership of researching discrepancies. 

 Respects approval boundaries. 

 Can shift between several clients while maintaining accuracy. 

 Remains calm when deadlines overlap. 

 Understands that accuracy and confidentiality directly affect H+A’s reputation. 



H+A's Core Value Competencies:

Fanatical attention to details and deadlines, and takes ownership of tasks and projects

Continually exceeding expectations and hungry for achievement

Innovative and resourceful problem-solving by staying curious, relentless, and unstoppable

Team player: fun, humble, and authentic

Anticipate needs, understand long-term objectives, and act with the clients’ success in mind

Exhibits professionalism in all things

Honors the value of reputation of individual and company

title: Australian Insurance Claims Support Officer
description:
Claims Support Officer



Remote | Philippines-Based | AEST Hour

 

**To Apply**  

 

The Claims Support Officer will provide administrative support to the Claims Consultant and help progress insurance claims accurately and promptly. Working under the Claims Consultant’s direction, the role will assist with claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, record maintenance, and general claims administration for an Australian insurance broking firm.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 



Claims Lodgements 

- Assist the Claims Consultant with lodging new insurance claims 

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge claims accurately and promptly in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions 

- Record claim details and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM 



 Insurer and Claims Follow-Up 

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims 

- Make follow-up calls and remain on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps 

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue 

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes 

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant 



 Documentation and Information Requests 

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant 

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, and repair or replacement information 

- Follow up outstanding documentation and report progress to the Claims Consultant 

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system 



 Claims Administration 

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records 

- Diary and action follow-ups to help keep claims progressing 

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultantz

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly 

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant 





REPORTING STRUCTURE AND ROLE BOUNDARIES 



The Claims Support Officer reports directly to the Claims Consultant and performs all duties under their direction. This is primarily an administrative and support-based role. 



- The role does not independently manage client relationships, provide claims advice, or make decisions on behalf of the broker or Claims Consultant 

- All client-facing matters and substantive claims discussions remain the responsibility of the Claims Consultant 

- Client or third-party follow-ups must be limited to the specific tasks and instructions provided by the Claims Consultant 



 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 



You Must Have 

- Previous experience in administration, claims support, insurance support, or a similarly process-driven role 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling claim information and documentation 

- Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to monitor multiple follow-ups and deadlines 

- Clear and professional communication skills, including confidence contacting insurers and other parties for factual updates and outstanding information 

- Ability to follow detailed instructions, work within defined authority, and escalate issues appropriately 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and confidence learning CRM and claims-management systems

- Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and work full-time during Australian business hours, Monday to Friday 



Nice to Have 

- Experience working for an insurance brokerage or general insurer 

- Previous exposure to insurance claims lodgement and claims administration 

- Experience communicating with insurers, claims teams, loss assessors, or repairers and using insurance, claims, or CRM systems 

- Basic understanding of the general insurance claims lifecycle and its common documentation





**To Apply**

title: Sr Ops Virtual Assistant — Detail-Focused, Room to Grow
description:
Company: Opus Group Solutions



About Us



Opus Group Solutions is a growing digital marketing and lead generation company that connects consumers with businesses across several industries.



We move quickly, work with a variety of clients and partners, and manage many moving pieces every day. As we grow, strong execution, clear communication, and reliable systems matter more every month.



We're a startup that promotes based on performance, not tenure. People who prove themselves take on more, faster.



About the Role



We're looking for an Operations & SEO Virtual Assistant to support day-to-day execution across several active projects at once.



This role is built around accuracy and follow-through: SEO content work, cross-checking data, tracking deadlines across multiple workstreams, and catching small errors before they become real problems.



You'll start with a defined scope of work. As you prove you can execute reliably and flag issues on your own, you'll be given more ownership — this is a role with a real path to grow, not a fixed lane forever.



What You'll Do

Support SEO tasks — on-page optimization, keyword work, content formatting and uploading

Cross-check data, documents, and deliverables for accuracy

Track deadlines and task status across multiple active projects

Flag inconsistencies, errors, or gaps as soon as you notice them — even in things you weren't specifically asked to check

Maintain organized records and documentation

Coordinate follow-ups so nothing falls through the cracks

Handle other operational and administrative tasks as they come up



The exact mix of work may shift as we learn where you're strongest.



Who We're Looking For

Pays close attention to detail, especially across repetitive or high-volume work

Can manage several projects at the same time without losing track of any of them

Communicates proactively — tells us about a problem or risk as soon as they see it, not after

Follows through and makes sure tasks actually get finished, not just started

Is comfortable asking questions when something is unclear, rather than guessing

Wants to grow — this role rewards people who take initiative and prove they're ready for more

Communication Is Important



If something is wrong, a deadline is at risk, or you've noticed an error — we want to know right away, even if you don't have the full fix yet.



At the same time, you don't need to ask permission for every small task decision within your normal scope of work.



Requirements

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail

Strong organization and time management

Experience with SEO, content work, virtual assistance, or operations support

Comfortable learning new software and tools

Reliable and responsive



Experience with spreadsheets, project management tools, or AI tools is a plus.



Compensation & Working Hours

Starting Pay: $4.00 USD/hour

Performance Increase: Within first 3 months, Eligible for a $1.00/hour KPI-based bonus based on defined performance targets — accuracy, reliability, communication, and follow-through

We promote quickly when people prove themselves. One team member started at $3.50/hr and is at $6.50/hr within 12 months, based entirely on performance

Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

Working Hours: U.S. Pacific Time business hours

Position: Long-term, with room to grow into broader responsibility

Who This Role Is NOT For



This probably isn't the right fit if you:



Tend to sit on a problem instead of raising it early

Prefer to complete only what's explicitly assigned and stop there

Struggle with accuracy when handling repetitive or high-volume tasks

Avoid asking questions when something is unclear



How to Apply



Complete the application form below:






Please do not apply through DM. We will not review any applications through onlinejobs



Selected candidates will complete a short timed assessment, followed by two interviews. We're moving quickly and making decisions fast.
