title: Creative Strategist for Meta Ads – Fashion & Jewelry E-commerce
description:
We are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist / AI Ad Creative Specialist who understands how to create high-converting Meta 
 & Instagram) ads for fashion and jewelry e-commerce brands.



Our business operates with a dropshipping/e-commerce model, so we are specifically looking for someone who understands direct-response advertising, creative testing, winning angles, hooks, customer awareness levels, and how creative performance impacts ROAS.



What You'll Be Responsible For

You will be responsible for researching, developing, and producing Meta ad creatives from concept to finished creative.

This includes both video ads and static image ads.

For video creatives, you should be comfortable producing formats such as:

Native-style / organic-looking ads

UGC-style advertisements

Voice-over ads

Scripted talking-head videos

AI spokesperson/model videos

Two-person / two-model conversation ads

Storytelling ads

Product demonstration ads

Problem/Solution creatives

Testimonial-style creatives

Direct-response sales ads

Advertorial-style creatives

Different hooks and variations for creative testing



You should understand how to make an advertisement feel native to
 and Instagram rather than looking like a traditional polished commercial.



AI Creative Skills Are Essential

We actively use AI in our creative production process.

You must be highly comfortable with AI prompting and AI creative tools.

You should be capable of:

Writing advanced prompts for image and video generation

Creating super-realistic AI-generated female models

Producing realistic skin, hands, faces, clothing, jewelry, environments, and product interactions

Maintaining product accuracy when incorporating jewelry or fashion products into AI-generated scenes

Creating realistic lifestyle images

Creating AI UGC-style videos

Generating AI voice-overs

Creating talking AI characters/models

Writing scripts specifically for AI-generated video ads

Editing AI-generated assets into polished Meta advertisements

The final creative should look believable and professional enough that customers do not immediately perceive it as low-quality AI-generated content.

Creative Strategy

We are NOT simply looking for a graphic designer or video editor.

We need someone who understands why an ad converts.

You should understand concepts such as:

Hooks

Creative angles

Customer pain points

Desires and emotional triggers

Customer awareness levels

Native advertising

Direct-response advertising

Scroll stopping

Pattern interruption

Storytelling

Offer presentation

Social proof

Objection handling

Competitor creative research

Creative iteration

Creative fatigue

Testing multiple variations of winning concepts



You should be able to research competitors, identify successful creative patterns and develop new concepts rather than simply copying existing ads.

Previous Results



We strongly prefer applicants who have previously created winning Meta creatives for fashion, women's clothing, accessories, or jewelry brands.

Ideally, you have created creatives that:

Generated approximately 3–4+ ROAS

Became winning/scalable Meta ads

Maintained performance after meaningful ad spend

Helped e-commerce brands discover new winning angles or concepts

We understand that ROAS depends on the entire business—including the product, offer, landing page, media buying, pricing, and market—so we are not asking anyone to guarantee a specific ROAS.

However, applicants should be able to demonstrate that their previous creative work contributed to profitable Meta campaigns.

Portfolio Requirement



Please DO NOT apply without relevant examples.

When applying, send us:

Your best 3–5 fashion or jewelry Meta ads

Examples of both video and static creatives

Examples of AI-generated creatives you personally created

Performance information for those creatives when available

ROAS / CPA / CTR / spend associated with your best-performing creatives, if available

A short explanation of what you personally handled on those projects

If you have worked specifically with women's fashion or women's jewelry brands, please highlight those examples.



Meta Media Buying – Big Plus

If you also know how to launch and manage Meta campaigns, that is a major advantage.

Experience with the following is valuable:

Meta Ads Manager

Sales campaigns

Advantage+ campaigns

CBO / ABO testing

Creative testing structures

Audience testing

Scaling winning creatives

Reading creative-level metrics

CTR, CPC, CPM, CPA, CVR and ROAS analysis

Identifying creative fatigue

Making creative decisions based on campaign data

Media buying experience is not mandatory, but candidates who understand both creative strategy and Meta campaign performance will receive priority.

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who combines:

Creative Strategist + Direct Response Marketer + AI Creator





To Apply

Start your application with the words:

"FASHION CREATIVE"

Then include:

Your experience with Meta ads

Your experience with dropshipping/e-commerce brands

Your fashion/jewelry experience

AI tools you currently use

Your portfolio

Your 3 best-performing creatives

Results from those creatives

Whether you also have Meta media-buying experience

Please also answer this question:

If we gave you a women's jewelry product today, what would be the first 3 completely different creative angles you would test on Meta, and why?

Generic applications or applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

Position

This can begin as a freelance / project-based position, with the opportunity to become a long-term collaboration if your creatives consistently perform.

We are looking for someone who wants to become deeply involved in our creative testing process and help us consistently develop the next generation of winning Meta ads.

title: Senior Accountant and Bookkeeping Specialist (Xero Expert)
description:
[IMPORTANT: Failure to follow the application instructions will result in automatic disqualification.]



We are looking for a Senior Accountant with strong bookkeeping expertise to join our growing international team.



This role is ideal for someone who not only manages day-to-day bookkeeping but also understands the bigger financial picture — someone who can maintain accurate financial records while supporting financial reporting, forecasting, and business decision-making.



You will play a key role in ensuring financial accuracy, maintaining compliance with Australian accounting standards, and helping leadership understand the financial health of the business.



If you are highly organized, analytical, and experienced in Xero and financial reporting, we want to hear from you.



This position is perfect for a detail-oriented accounting professional who enjoys both operational bookkeeping and higher-level financial analysis.



[What You’ll Do]

Financial Management

- Maintain and manage accurate financial records across all company accounts

- Oversee daily bookkeeping functions and ensure all financial transactions are properly recorded

- Maintain general ledger accuracy and integrity



Account Reconciliation

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial transactions regularly

- Investigate and resolve discrepancies



Financial Reporting

- Prepare and review:

• Monthly financial statements

• Profit & Loss reports

• Balance sheets

• Cash flow reports

- Provide financial insights and recommendations to management



Accounts Payable & Receivable

- Manage incoming and outgoing payments

- Track outstanding invoices

- Maintain positive vendor and client payment relationships



Payroll Support

- Assist with payroll processing

- Ensure accurate employee payments and financial records



Tax & Compliance Support

- Assist with BAS preparation and other tax-related documentation

- Ensure financial records remain compliant with accounting standards



Budgeting & Forecasting

- Assist management with:

• Financial forecasts

• Budget preparation

• Cost analysis



Xero Management

- Maintain and optimize the company’s accounting system in Xero

- Ensure proper account categorization and financial organization



Financial Data Organization

- Maintain well-organized financial documentation for reporting, auditing, and compliance



[What We’re Looking For]

Senior Accounting Experience

- 3+ years experience in accounting or bookkeeping

- Experience managing financial reporting



Xero Expertise

- Strong experience using Xero

- Experience reconciling accounts and preparing reports within Xero



Australian Accounting Knowledge (Highly Preferred)

- Familiarity with:

• BAS

• GST

• Australian financial compliance



Strong Analytical Skills

- Ability to interpret financial data and provide insights



Detail-Oriented

- High accuracy with financial records and reconciliations



Organization & Time Management

- Ability to manage multiple financial tasks and meet deadlines



Communication Skills

- Clear written and verbal English

- Ability to communicate financial information clearly to non-finance team members



Tech Proficiency

Experience with tools such as:

- Xero

- Google Workspace

- Excel / Google Sheets

- Accounting tools (QuickBooks experience is a plus)



[Bonus Points If You Have]

- Experience working with Australian companies

- Experience supporting growing startups or remote teams

- CPA / Accounting certification

- Experience with financial forecasting and management reporting



[Why Join Our Team]

- Work remotely with an international team

- Opportunity to grow into a Senior Finance Manager role

- Work in a fast-growing company where your input matters

- Long-term role with stability



[How to Apply]

If you believe you're the right person for this role, we want to hear from you.

Please submit:

1. Your CV

2. Portfolio / Sample Work

Create a Google Drive folder containing:

- Resume

- Any relevant financial reports

 experience. DTC, Shopify, or BigCommerce preferred.

 systems.

s or flows you built. Screenshots, Loom, or anonymized exports are fine. Label each one Klaviyo or Omnisend.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — Virtual Assistant Services
description:
We're hiring commission-based appointment setters to book qualified discovery calls for our virtual assistant services with US business owners. Your job is to get decision-makers on the phone, spark real interest in offloading work to a VA, and book them into our sales calendar.



Leads are provided. You'll work through company-supplied lead lists, and you're welcome to source your own if you want to expand your pipeline (and your earnings).



This role rewards quality bookings, not busy work. We're not looking for someone who slams the calendar with meetings that never happen. We want appointments that turn into real conversations with real prospects.



What You'll Do

Work through company-provided lead lists by phone

Source your own leads when you want to expand pipeline

Cold call US business owners in English — live, without a script to hide behind

Qualify prospects against our criteria before booking anything

Book discovery calls, confirm them, and chase no-shows to a reschedule

Follow up on every warm lead until you get a clear yes or no

Log every call, every outcome, every note in our CRM cleanly enough for someone else to pick up cold

Report daily on activity: dials made, conversations had, meetings booked

What We're Looking For



Required:



Tremendous spoken English. You'll be calling US business owners live. Clear accent is fine — hesitation, filler, and broken phrasing are not.

Real cold calling experience — proven dials, proven bookings

Honesty about your numbers. We track everything on our side — dials, connects, show-up rates. Padded activity ends the engagement immediately. If you report it, it needs to be real.

Self-driven. You don't need a manager standing over you to keep dialing. You already know what needs to happen when the phone goes quiet.

Comfortable with rejection and picking the phone back up

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, clean-audio headset

Availability overlapping US business hours



Nice to have:



Experience booking appointments for agencies, staffing firms, or B2B services

Experience with dialers (Ricochet, Quo, Aircall, or similar) and CRMs (GoHighLevel, Zoho, HubSpot)

LinkedIn outreach experience to warm up cold prospects

A track record with actual numbers attached — dials per day, connect rate, booking rate, show rate

Hours & Schedule

Full-time or part-time — you tell us your availability and we hold you to it

Minimum commitment: 4 hours/day during US business hours

If you commit to 4 hours, we expect 4 hours of real dialing — not 4 hours of logged-in time

If you commit to 8, same rule

Compensation

Commission-based — competitive structure, uncapped

Full details discussed during the interview

Payouts are tied to appointments that convert into real conversations with clients — quality over volume

Top performers earn significantly more than any fixed-salary equivalent

How to Apply



Send your application to: 



Include:



Updated CV

Short video intro in English — introduce yourself and walk us through the best appointment-setting or cold calling result you've ever produced, with real numbers (dials, meetings booked, show rate)

Your typical daily activity — how many dials you make, connect rate, booking rate

Your availability — full-time or part-time, and what hours you can commit to US time



Applications without a video intro will not be reviewed.

title: Creative Marketer Wanted – Join a Mission That Matters
description:
MARKETING VIRTUAL ASSISTANT

| REMOTE | PHILIPPINES | FULL-TIME



ABOUT ONE WAY UK



One Way UK is a Christian business and ministry dedicated to equipping churches, children's workers, ministries and Christian communicators with creative tools that help them share the message of the Gospel.



We design and manufacture puppets, provide training, create ministry resources and run events that equip people to communicate creatively and effectively.



At the heart of everything we do is a desire to see people equipped, encouraged and inspired to make a difference.



As we move into an exciting new season, we're looking for a Marketing Virtual Assistant to join our team and help us tell our story, grow our community and reach more people.



-THE ROLE-



We're looking for someone who's:



CREATIVE, DRIVEN AND ORGANISED



And most importantly, somebody who wants to make a difference!



You'll help take responsibility for the day-to-day marketing of One Way UK.



THIS ISN'T SIMPLY A SOCIAL MEDIA POSTING ROLE!



You'll work closely with the Managing Director to plan and deliver marketing campaigns across our products, resources, training and events. You'll help take ideas, priorities and content and turn them into consistent, engaging and measurable marketing activity.



A big part of the role will be establishing a strong rhythm of marketing throughout the year, nurturing our existing audience, reaching new people and building a stronger community around One Way UK.



-KEY RESPONSIBILITIES-




 MARKETING-



* Create, schedule and send marketing
s and newsletters.

* Build campaigns around products, events, training and resources.

* Segment audiences and repurpose existing content into engaging
s.

* Develop, build and manage automated
 nurture campaigns and customer journeys.

* Monitor results including opens, clicks, responses and conversions.



-MARKETING CAMPAIGNS-



* Work alongside the Managing Director to plan and develop marketing campaigns.

* Turn campaign ideas into coordinated activity across
, social media, graphics, video and other channels.

* Coordinate campaigns around product launches, events, training and ministry resources.

* Help maintain a consistent rhythm of marketing throughout the year.

* Monitor performance and identify opportunities to improve results.



-SOCIAL MEDIA & COMMUNITY-



* Manage and schedule content across One Way UK's social media channels.

* Turn ideas, photographs, videos, products and existing material into engaging content.

* Help build a genuine community rather than simply broadcasting adverts.

* Engage appropriately with comments and conversations.

* Identify opportunities for useful, engaging and shareable content.



-GRAPHIC DESIGN-



Create professional, on-brand graphics for social media, events, products,
 campaigns, promotions and ministry resources.



We currently use Canva and have our branding and existing designs set up there. However, if you have another preferred design tool or workflow, we're open to considering it.



-VIDEO & REELS-



We're not looking for a professional video editor, but you should be comfortable taking existing footage and turning it into simple, engaging content, including:



* Basic editing and uploading of videos such as podcasts and tutorials.

* Cutting longer videos into shorter clips and Reels.

* Adding captions, titles and simple graphics.

* Repurposing video content across different platforms.



-OUTREACH-



Outreach will occasionally form part of the role around particular campaigns and opportunities. This may include researching relevant churches or potential customers, creating targeted contact lists and supporting
 outreach campaigns.



This isn't primarily a lead-generation role, but outreach is one of the tools we'll use alongside our wider marketing activity.



-PAID ADVERTISING-



Paid advertising isn't currently a major part of our marketing activity, but it's an area we want to develop.



As our marketing grows, you'll have the opportunity to help us create, manage and optimise paid advertising campaigns to reach new audiences and generate measurable sales.



Previous experience with platforms such as Meta Ads or Google Ads would be an advantage, but isn't essential.



-YOUR FIRST CAMPAIGN-



Your first major project will be helping us market the EQUIP FESTIVAL, our Christian creative ministry event.



You'll work alongside the Managing Director on
 marketing, social media, graphics, video content, targeted outreach and other activity designed to drive registrations in the final weeks before the event.



Beyond Equip, you'll help us establish a consistent rhythm of marketing around our products, training, resources and events throughout the year.



The aim isn't simply to keep our marketing channels busy. It's to intentionally communicate the right things, to the right people, at the right time.



-WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR-



We're looking for someone who:



* Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership.

* Is creative, driven and organised.

* Has strong written English.

* Understands social media and digital marketing.

* Is confident creating graphics using tools such as Canva.

* Has good experience with
 marketing.

* Can perform basic video editing for social media.

* Pays attention to detail.

* Can take an idea and turn it into something practical.

* Contributes ideas rather than simply waiting to be given tasks.

* Is willing to learn new software, systems and marketing techniques.

* Understands that good marketing should produce measurable results.



Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL),
 automation, Canva, Shopify and paid advertising platforms would be an advantage.



-UNDERSTANDING OUR AUDIENCE-



Because One Way UK primarily serves churches, Christian ministries and Christian communicators, it's important that you're comfortable working within a Christian organisation and understand the audience we're communicating with.



An understanding of church ministry, children's ministry or Christian organisations would be particularly valuable.



-WORKING ARRANGEMENTS-



This is a FULL-TIME, FULLY REMOTE POSITION BASED IN THE PHILIPPINES.



We're happy to offer some flexibility around your working hours to accommodate the time difference between the Philippines and the UK. However, you'll need to be available for an agreed period each working day that overlaps with UK working hours so that we can communicate, collaborate and work on campaigns together.



As this is a remote position, you'll need your own reliable computer, a strong and stable internet connection and a suitable environment in which to work.



WORKING HOURS: [40 hours a week, with overlap with UK time]



We're looking for someone who wants more than simply another remote job. As One Way UK grows, there will be opportunities to take greater ownership, develop your marketing skills and grow with the organisation.



-HOW WE WORK-



At One Way UK, we're building more than just products. We're building a culture of excellence, purpose and Kingdom impact.



GREAT PEOPLE, DOING GREAT WORK, FOR A GREAT GOD.



JESUS AT THE CENTRE



Jesus is the focus of every plan, product and purpose. Our work reflects His love, our mission carries His message, and we serve with joy, for His name, not ours.



CREATIVE WITH PURPOSE



Our creativity is bold, innovative and impactful. Crafting creative tools that equip and inspire. We don't just make great things, we create for the Kingdom.



EXCELLENCE ALWAYS



We pursue excellence in every detail. We do great work, whatever the task, and refuse to settle for "it'll do", because how we serve reflects who we serve.



BE A GREAT PERSON



We're the kind of people you want on your team: humble, dependable, personable and always ready to go the extra mile. Not for ourselves, but for the mission.



BOLD FAITH, BRAVE STEPS



We think bold, dream big, pray bigger and step out in faith to fulfil the vision. We trust God to fuel the mission, because nothing is bigger than Him.



BRING LIFE



We bring energy, fun and a culture that feels alive, on the team and with every customer. Because when our work brings life, our mission comes to life too.



GET IT DONE. SERVE THE MISSION.



Every task moves the mission forward. We don't just think about it, we deliver! We take ownership, move with urgency and get stuff done. We're focused, fast and faithful.



-WHAT WINNING IN YOUR ROLE LOOKS LIKE-



Success isn't simply measured by how many posts have been published.



We want to see:



* Consistent, rhythmic marketing activity.

* Well-planned and executed campaigns.

* Measurable sales outcomes.

* Growth in our
 audience and social community.

* Increased engagement and website traffic.

* More qualified enquiries and opportunities.

* Increased registrations for events and training.

* Marketing activity that contributes directly to sales and ministry growth.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to take ownership of this area and grow with us as One Way UK enters its next chapter.

We'd love to hear from you.



TO APPLY, PLEASE SUBMIT:



* Your CV/resume.

* A short covering message telling us about yourself, why you'd like to work with One Way UK and why you think you'd be a great fit.

* Examples of relevant marketing, social media, graphic design,
 or video work you've previously created.

* And to show us you've read the whole advert, tell us WHICH OF OUR SEVEN ONE WAY UK VALUES RESONATES MOST WITH YOU AND WHY.

Successful candidates will then be invited to a video interview before we make our final decision.



SOUND LIKE YOU? WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU.

title: Marketing Video Editor
description:
H+A Events is seeking a talented and creative part time Marketing Video Editor to support our growing marketing team by producing engaging video content for multiple association and event clients. This remote, project-based position is ideal for an experienced video editor who understands both storytelling and marketing.



The ideal candidate can transform raw footage into polished, engaging videos that inspire audiences to attend events, become members, engage with educational content, and connect with our clients' brands. You'll collaborate closely with our marketing team to execute creative briefs while ensuring each project aligns with established branding, messaging, and marketing objectives.



This role offers flexible hours based on project demand and is ideal for someone who enjoys working across a variety of brands, conferences, and marketing campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

Video Editing & Production

--Edit engaging promotional and educational videos for multiple client accounts 

--Transform raw conference and event footage into compelling highlight reels and recap videos 

--Produce social media videos optimized for
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and other digital platforms 

--Create speaker, instructor, and testimonial videos that support event marketing and brand awareness 

--Edit educational and training videos into polished, easy-to-follow content 

--Develop multiple video versions and formats, including vertical and horizontal outputs



Creative Storytelling

--Execute video projects according to creative briefs and marketing objectives 

--Organize footage into engaging visual stories that create excitement and encourage audience participation 

--Select music, pacing, transitions, and visual treatments that strengthen the overall message 

--Incorporate stock footage when appropriate to enhance storytelling and production quality 

--Continuously seek opportunities to improve the quality and effectiveness of video content



Motion Graphics & Branding

--Create or incorporate simple motion graphics, animated titles, lower thirds, captions, and branded graphic elements when appropriate 

--Maintain visual consistency across all client brands and marketing campaigns 

--Ensure videos follow established branding guidelines and marketing standards 

--Communicate project status, questions, and timeline updates with the Marketing & Communications Manager 

--Meet agreed-upon deadlines while managing multiple active projects 

--Participate in creative discussions and contribute ideas as familiarity with client brands grows 

--Revise projects based on internal and client feedback



Typical Video Projects

Projects may include:

--Conference highlight reels 

--Event recap videos 

--Promotional marketing videos 

--Social media reels and short-form content 

--YouTube Shorts 

--Speaker and instructor promotional videos 

--Testimonial videos 

--Educational and training videos 

--Membership and event marketing campaigns 

--Additional marketing video projects as assigned



Required Qualifications

 -2–4 years of professional video editing experience preferred (portfolio strongly considered) 

 -Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, pacing, and polished editing 

 -Experience editing promotional, event, or marketing videos 

 -Excellent organizational and time management skills 

 -Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work 

 -Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities 

 -Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment 

-Excellent communication skills and responsiveness throughout projects 

-Ability to consistently meet deadlines while maintaining quality



Preferred Qualifications

-Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

--Conference and event highlight videos 

--Association or nonprofit marketing 

--Corporate marketing videos 

--Motion graphics and animation 

--Color correction and audio enhancement 

--Caption creation and accessibility best practices 

--Canva Pro, CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, or similar professional editing software 

--Experience sourcing and incorporating stock video assets



Position Expectations

-Approximately 5–20 hours per week depending on project volume 

-Remote contractor position 

-No travel required 

-Typical turnaround for most projects is 2–3 business days, depending on project scope 

-Work from creative briefs while becoming increasingly familiar with H+A Events' brands and creative style 

-Deliver finished videos in requested formats and aspect ratios for various marketing channels





What Success Looks Like

-A successful Contract Marketing Video Editor doesn't simply edit footage—they create videos that support measurable marketing objectives.

-Successful candidates understand how to:

--Capture the excitement and energy of live events 

--Tell compelling visual stories 

--Create videos that generate interest, engagement, and registrations 

--Produce content that makes viewers feel like they don't want to miss the next event 

--Maintain consistency across multiple brands while adapting to each client's unique personality



Application Requirements

Applicants should submit:

-Resume 

-Portfolio or Demo Reel showcasing recent work 

-Links to 2–3 completed video projects 



PLEASE NOTE:

1. Candidates should send a resume and portfolio.



2. This is a part-time position (5-20 hours per week) in the Central United States, and working Tuesday-Thursday between 8:00am-2:00pm Central Time Zone. Candidates who cannot work during these hours need not apply.



3. Candidates should only apply via this job posting, with the subject line, "Your Rockstar Content Marketing Video Editor" Included in your application, you should include which of our company’s core values you relate to the most.



4. We are only interested in working with individuals. No ad agency applications, or individuals who outsource work, please.

Position Summary



Our Company's Core Values

--The ideal candidate will embody our company's core values:

--Fanatical attention to details and deadlines, and takes ownership of tasks and projects

--Continually exceeding expectations and hungry for achievement

--Innovative and resourceful problem-solving by staying curious, relentless, and unstoppable

--Team player: fun, humble, and authentic

--Anticipate needs, understand long-term objectives, and act with the clients’ success in mind

--Exhibits professionalism in all things

--Honors the value of reputation of individual and company

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer — Remote, Long-Term Contract Role
description:
Our media agency helps business owners and leaders grow their online presence. We strategize, create, and manage videos, graphics, and social media content for our clients. Because every client is different, each piece of content should match their unique voice, style, and brand.



We are looking for a creative, dependable, and efficient Video Editor & Graphic Designer to join our growing team. This is a remote, long-term contract opportunity paid on a per-project basis. We want someone who is highly skilled and has experience editing long-form and short-term video. Each week we will need long-form and short-form videos edited, and graphics created for our clients.



This role is ideal for someone who produces excellent work, follows instructions carefully, responds quickly, meets deadlines consistently, and communicates proactively. We are looking for someone who is truly on top of their assignments and can deliver polished first drafts with strong attention to detail. Our goal is not to repeatedly request revisions for avoidable mistakes, missed instructions, or quality issues. We care about creativity, but excellence, reliability, ownership, and communication are equally important.



Responsibilities



- You will help create content for multiple client brands, including:

- Short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Long-form YouTube videos and podcast episodes

- B-roll and storytelling-style videos

- Talking-head videos

- Trend-based and educational content

- Social media carousels and static graphics

- YouTube thumbnails

- Branded graphics and other supporting social assets

- Revisions based on internal or client feedback



You will also be expected to:



- Review all instructions, references, and brand guidelines before editing

- Keep each client’s editing style distinct and consistent

- Add accurate captions, music, transitions, graphics, and relevant B-roll

- Organize and upload completed files correctly

- Keep project statuses updated in Notion

- Communicate immediately if footage, instructions, or other resources are missing

- Notify the team before a deadline if an assignment may be delayed

- Complete revisions promptly and apply previous feedback to future work





The ideal candidate:



- Has strong short-form and long-form video-editing experience

- Has great graphic-design experience

- Understands pacing, storytelling, hooks, retention, and current social media editing styles

- Pays close attention to spelling, captions, formatting, and client instructions

- Is highly organized and able to manage multiple deadlines

- Communicates clearly and proactively

- Responds quickly and acknowledges new assignments or feedback promptly

- Takes ownership without needing repeated reminders

- Consistently delivers excellent, polished first drafts that minimize unnecessary revision requests

- Checks their own work carefully before submitting it

- Is receptive to feedback, completes revisions efficiently, and applies that feedback to future work

- Stays ahead of deadlines and keeps the team informed without needing to be chased

- Has reliable internet, sufficient storage, and the equipment needed to edit consistently

- Is interested in a stable, long-term position with room to grow



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Canva, Photoshop, or similar editing and design software is preferred.



Experience working with personal brands, founders, podcasts, or social media agencies is a plus.



Turnaround Expectations



Unless otherwise agreed upon:



- Short-form first drafts should generally be completed within 48 hours

- Long-form first drafts should generally be completed within 3–5 business days

- Standard revisions should be completed within one business day

- Any potential delay must be communicated before the deadline, along with a revised delivery time

- Applicants should have the capacity to complete multiple short-form videos each week while also supporting long-form and graphic-design assignments.



Compensation



This is a contract role paid per completed deliverable.



Starting rates:



- $15 per short-form video

- $40 per long-form video

- Graphic-design rates will be agreed upon based on the type and complexity of the asset



There is an opportunity for consistent assignments and increased rates as the agency and the role grow.



Paid Trial



Final candidates will be invited to complete a paid trial project. The trial will evaluate:



- Editing quality

- Ability to follow instructions

- Turnaround time

- Communication

- Attention to detail

- Responsiveness to revisions

- The paid trial does not guarantee an ongoing contract.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



- A brief introduction and overview of your editing experience

- A link to your portfolio (A portfolio is required for consideration. If your application does not include a working portfolio link with relevant examples, we will not be reaching out or moving your application forward. Please make sure we can view your work without requesting access.)

- Examples of thumbnails, or other graphic-design work

- Your typical turnaround time for short-form and long-form videos

- How many short-form and long-form videos you can realistically complete each week

- Your current availability and expected working hours

- If you're available to attend our weekly Monday morning meeting at 10:00am



Please begin your application with the words “I'm your next level video editor” so we know you read the entire description.



We are looking to hire immediately and are excited to find someone who wants to grow with our team.

title: CREATIVE SOCIAL MEDIA VA
description:
CREATIVE SOCIAL MEDIA VA — CONTENT CREATOR BRAND



I'm a Hawaii-based content creator and entrepreneur running TikTok Shop affiliate, digital products, and UGC brand deals. My content is travel, luxury, lifestyle, and family — think ocean views, resort stays, good food, and financial freedom.



I'm not looking for someone who just follows instructions. I need a creative partner who watches trends, brings ideas, and can take a raw clip and know exactly what to do with it.



Long-term role. Room to grow.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Receive raw travel, lifestyle, and luxury video clips from me

• Independently d
 how to cut, caption, and position each video for maximum reach

• Research trending audio, formats, and hooks on TikTok and Reels — bring me what's working

• Create 5-10 second loops and text overlay videos that match the aesthetic

• Draft and schedule posts across multiple accounts

• Manage content calendars and keep the pipeline moving

• Pitch ideas — "this clip should be a 'send this to yourself' video" type thinking

• Set up basic ManyChat automations (training provided)

• Repurpose content across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts



THE VIBE YOU NEED TO UNDERSTAND:

• Travel + luxury + family + financial freedom

• The aesthetic is dark, cinematic, aspirational — think city lights, ocean views, resort pools

• The brand sells the lifestyle first, the product second

• You should be able to watch a trending video and say "we should do this version"



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR:

• You actively use TikTok and Instagram — you know what's trending right now

• Experience editing in CapCut or similar tools

• Strong creative instincts — you bring ideas, not just output

• Communicates proactively — you flag opportunities, you don't wait to be told

• Detail-oriented with captions, timing, and formatting

• ManyChat experience is a plus



HOURS & PAY:

• Part-time to start — 15 to 20 hours/week

• $300–$500/month depending on experience and creative output

• Grows as the brand grows



HOW TO APPLY:

Send a message with:

1. A trending TikTok or Reel format you've seen recently that you think would work for a travel/luxury/lifestyle brand — and why

2. Tools you use for editing

3. Examples of content you've created or managed

4. Why you'd thrive working independently with a fast-moving creator



Generic applications get ignored. Show me you think creatively.

title: AI Platform Developer – Voice, RAG, CRM & Clinic Booking Integrations
description:
I run an Australian AI business providing Digital Patient Concierge solutions to healthcare clinics.



I currently use CustomGPT.ai as the underlying platform for a website-based AI Digital Patient Concierge. I'm now looking for an experienced AI/API integration developer to help build the next stage of the product: a reusable, multi-clinic platform combining website AI, voice/telephony, clinic-specific knowledge, CRM integration and appointment booking.



For the right developer, there is potential for an ongoing technical role as the platform is deployed across additional clinic clients.



What I'm looking to build



The core platform should support:



AI conversations across both website chat and telephone

Deep, clinic-specific knowledge using RAG/vector-based retrieval

Natural multi-turn conversations with patients

Lead/contact capture and qualification

CRM integration via APIs/webhooks

Appointment/PMS integration

Real-time appointment availability and booking

AI-to-human escalation and call transfer

Human receptionist-to-AI handover

Conversation context maintained where practical during handovers

Multilingual conversations

Appropriate failure handling and fallbacks

Logging, reporting and operational monitoring

Multiple clinic clients operating securely within the same underlying platform



The website concierge should also be capable of operating independently of voice while using the same underlying clinic knowledge, CRM and booking integrations.



Existing platform and RAG



The existing website concierge currently runs on CustomGPT.ai.



However, I'm open to replacing this with a proprietary RAG/knowledge architecture as part of the new platform, provided we can maintain or improve the quality of the existing concierge.



Each clinic will have its own private knowledge environment, trained on substantial clinic-approved information such as services, practitioners, treatment information, processes, fees and FAQs.



The objective is not simply to build a basic AI receptionist that answers a small number of FAQs and books appointments. The concierge needs to be capable of having detailed, grounded conversations using each clinic's approved information before guiding appropriate patients towards enquiry or booking.



Reusable and scalable architecture



This is important: I'm not looking for a one-off integration for a single clinic.



The platform needs to be designed so that the same core infrastructure can support multiple clinics, with individual configuration for:



clinic knowledge

phone/telephony

CRM

PMS/booking system

qualification and escalation rules

business hours and call routing

integrations and credentials



Once an integration has already been developed, I'd like onboarding another clinic using that integration to become primarily a configuration process rather than another custom development project.



I also want the core platform, code, workflows and infrastructure developed specifically for +Plus AI to be owned and controlled by +Plus AI.



Where practical, third-party services should be implemented modularly so that voice, telephony, AI/model, CRM or booking providers can be changed or expanded later without rebuilding the entire platform.



Data minimisation and privacy



The platform will handle patient enquiries, so privacy and sensible data handling are important.



My preference is to minimise the amount of identifiable patient information retained within the +Plus platform.



Where practical, the platform should process the interaction, transfer the relevant patient details, summary and outcome into the clinic's CRM/PMS, and automatically delete identifiable transcripts and recordings after a short configurable operational retention period.



Longer-term platform reporting should preferably rely on de-identified operational data wherever possible.



I'd like the architecture to clearly account for where information is processed and retained, including by third-party services.



Reliability and monitoring



Because clinics will rely on the platform operationally, reliability and failure handling are important.



Actions such as appointment bookings and CRM updates should only be confirmed once they have successfully completed, with appropriate fallback/retry behaviour where integrations fail.



The platform should also provide sufficient visibility to identify issues such as failed bookings, failed CRM writes, failed transfers, API/integration errors or interactions requiring human follow-up.



I'm not looking to over-engineer V1, but the underlying architecture should support reliable operation and appropriate monitoring as the platform grows.



Technical ownership



I'm not a developer, so I'm looking for someone who is comfortable taking technical ownership of the solution from architecture through to:



development

testing

deployment

documentation

troubleshooting

ongoing maintenance

future integrations



I'll manage the product, clinic relationships and commercial side of the business.



The platform should be documented sufficiently that it isn't dependent on undocumented knowledge held by one person.



Technology



I'm open to recommendations rather than being locked into a particular stack.



Technologies that may be relevant include:



ElevenLabs, Ultravox, Vapi or similar voice AI platforms

Twilio/SIP telephony

Supabase/Postgres/pgvector or similar

n8n or similar orchestration/workflow tools

LLM APIs

REST APIs/webhooks

CRM platforms

healthcare PMS/appointment systems



I'm particularly interested in developers who understand how these components fit together into a reliable production platform, rather than only having experience creating simple AI demos or workflows.



Commercial viability and costs



The solution needs to be commercially viable to deploy across multiple clinics.



Before development begins, I'd like us to agree on the proposed architecture, V1 scope, development milestones, estimated hours/costs, expected per-clinic implementation requirements, ongoing infrastructure/usage costs and ongoing technical support arrangements.



I'd prefer development to proceed in clear milestones with regular demonstrations of progress.



Ongoing opportunity



This isn't necessarily a one-off freelance project.



If the platform is successful, I would like to continue working with the same developer as clinics are onboarded, new integrations are required and the product evolves.



I'm therefore particularly interested in someone who is reliable, communicative and interested in understanding the product, as well as technically capable.



When applying



Please send me:



A brief introduction and your relevant experience

Examples of AI voice, RAG, telephony, CRM or API integration projects you've worked on

The technologies you are strongest with

Whether you've built multi-tenant or reusable SaaS-style platforms

Your hourly rate and general availability

A high-level estimate of the hours and/or total development cost you would expect for the V1 described above

An indication of the likely implementation/configuration cost for each additional clinic once the core platform has been developed

An indication of your expected ongoing monthly technical support/maintenance cost

Any significant third-party, hosting, telephony, AI or other platform costs you would expect

Whether you would be comfortable taking ongoing technical responsibility for the platform after deployment

Whether you're interested in an ongoing relationship if the initial project is successful



I understand that a firm quote would require further discussion, so I'm only looking for an indicative range at this stage. You don't need to design the complete architecture or provide a detailed technical specification as part of your application. I'd prefer to work through that with shortlisted candidates.

There will be **353+ videos**, so I am looking for someone who can handle a large volume of content while maintaining consistent quality.



2. Real Estate Media Reels



I also regularly create real estate media reels.



For these, I will provide you with a **reference video** and expect you to recreate the editing style as closely as possible using the footage and resources available to you.



The goal is not simply to make something that looks "similar."



**I need you to replicate the reference video as closely as possible.**



That includes the:



* Pacing

* Cuts

* Transitions

* Text/captions

* Timing

* Effects

* Music/sound design

* Overall visual style

* Flow and structure



3. IMPORTANT — Editing Test



Before being hired, you will be given a video and specific instructions for an editing test.



**The test will be unpaid.**



This is intentional because I need to see whether you can actually execute the editing style and follow detailed instructions before committing to a long-term working relationship.



If you are not comfortable completing a free test edit, **please do not apply.**



4. Requirements



You **must**:



* Have experience editing real estate media

* Have strong short-form/Reels editing experience

* Understand modern social media pacing

* Be highly proficient with captions and fast-paced editing

* Be able to replicate a reference video accurately

* Follow detailed instructions without improvising when exact replication is requested

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Be fluent in English

* Be able to clearly understand what is being said in the videos

* Be able to communicate effectively in English

* Be comfortable handling a large volume of videos

* Consistently meet deadlines

* Have examples/portfolio work that demonstrates your abilities



6. Please Do NOT Apply If:



* You cannot follow exact editing instructions

* You cannot understand spoken English in the videos

* You are not fluent enough in English to understand the content and instructions

* You are unable to replicate a reference video

* You are not experienced with real estate media

* You are not comfortable completing the required unpaid test edit

* You only do basic cuts and captions and cannot create fast-paced, professional reels



7. Long-Term Opportunity



This is not a one-off project.



There are **353+ homes/videos in the initial series**, along with ongoing real estate media reels that I will need edited regularly.



If you can demonstrate that you understand my style, follow instructions accurately, and consistently produce high-quality work, there is the potential for **ongoing, long-term work with a significant amount of content.**



When applying, please include:



1. Your portfolio

2. Examples of your **real estate editing**

3. Examples of your **short-form/Reels editing**

4. Your rate per video/reel

5. Your typical turnaround time

6. The editing software you use

7. Your availability



**Most importantly: I am looking for an editor who can follow my exact vision rather than someone who simply applies their own editing style.**



If you can do that, I want to hear from you.

title: **Social Media & Short-Form Video Editor — German holiday rental (Instagram / TikTok)**
description:
We run a small, deliberately exclusive holiday property in western Germany — one house, three apartments around a courtyard, near the Dutch border. Website: secretgarden.nrw



We want to build an audience on Instagram and TikTok and turn it into direct bookings.



How this works in practice: **we film, you make it good.** We are on site, so we shoot the raw footage on a phone — rooms, courtyard, breakfast, the light in the morning, the village. You edit it into short vertical videos, write the hooks and captions, pick the sound, and post on a regular schedule. You will never need to be here.



What we need:

- Short-form editing for Reels and TikTok (CapCut or similar), with a feel for pacing and hooks

- Caption and hook writing in natural English

- A posting schedule you keep to without being chased

- Simple graphics for stories and highlights

- Telling us what footage to shoot next, and how to shoot it



Two things worth knowing before you apply. Our guests are mostly German and Dutch — tell us how you would handle content for an audience that does not speak English as a first language. And this property is premium and quiet, not loud and trend-driven; we would rather grow slowly with the right tone than fast with the wrong one.



**How to apply.** Start your message with the word **COURTYARD** so we know you read this.



Then send us:

1. Two or three links to videos you personally edited, and the accounts they were posted on. Not an agency showreel — your own work.

2. For one of them: what were you trying to achieve, and what happened?

3. Which account you grew, from what to what, over what period. If you cannot cleanly attribute the growth to your own work, say so — we would rather read an honest small example than an impressive number nobody can trace.



Also tell us your rate expectation, your weekly availability and your time zone.



Shortlisted applicants get a small paid test: we send you raw footage, you send back one finished video.



---



Zwei Dinge, die ich bewusst so gesetzt habe: ein eigenes Codewort, damit sich die Bewerberpools nicht vermischen, und keine Honorarangabe — anders als in Anzeige 1, wo 5 $ pro Stunde steht und damit alle Bewerber verankert hat. Im Budgetfeld des Formulars tragen Sie „TBD / depending on experience" ein.



Der Testauftrag ist hier bewusst winzig: Rohmaterial rein, ein fertiges Video raus. Das kostet Sie fast nichts und zeigt sofort, ob jemand es kann.



Sagen Sie mir, wann Sie so weit sind, dann lege ich die Anzeige an — veröffentlicht wird erst auf Ihr ausdrückliches Ja.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

MORE DETAILS:

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support), as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

Barracuda DNS filter, AutoElevate, Cylance, Infocyte, Syxsense, IT Glue, SonicWall, Unifi, and more

title: EXPERIENCED AMAZON PRODUCT SOURCER | Competitive Pay + Bonuses + Career Growth
description:
You’ve proven you can find profitable products for Amazon. Now you want an opportunity where your results are recognized, your ideas matter, and strong performance creates room to advance.



We’d like to meet you.



ABOUT US



We are an established Amazon retail business generating low seven figures in annual sales. Our goal is to grow into the mid-to-high seven figures, and we’re looking for an accomplished Amazon product sourcer to help us get there.



We have more than 10 years of experience working with virtual team members. You’ll work alongside friendly, supportive colleagues and a fair, generous leadership team that values initiative, accountability, and results.



THIS ROLE IS FOR EXPERIENCED SOURCERS ONLY



You must have a proven track record of sourcing products that were purchased, sold, and generated profitable results. Completing a course or understanding sourcing basics is not enough for this position.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Source profitable products through online arbitrage for our Amazon FBA business.

• Use Keepa and other research tools to evaluate sales history, pricing stability, competition, and Amazon’s presence.

• Calculate profit and ROI accurately, accounting for Amazon fees and sourcing costs.

• Identify potential selling restrictions, intellectual property concerns, and other purchasing risks.

• Submit accurate, well-researched leads that meet our buying criteria.

• Identify replenishable winners with potential for repeat purchases.

• Track your work, communicate clearly, and contribute ideas that improve sourcing results.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• A proven Amazon product sourcer who can demonstrate and explain past results.

• Strong Keepa analysis skills and sound purchasing judgment.

• The ability to source efficiently without sacrificing lead quality.

• A dependable, organized person who takes ownership and follows through.

• A team player who welcomes feedback and helps colleagues succeed.

• Someone seeking a long-term career with opportunities for greater responsibility.



WHAT WE OFFER



• Very competitive pay based on demonstrated experience and ability.

• Performance bonuses that reward meaningful results.

• Opportunities to advance into greater responsibility and leadership as your performance and company growth support them.

• Friendly colleagues and a supportive remote working environment.

• Fair and generous leadership that recognizes excellent work.

• An opportunity to help grow an established seven-figure business.



We want someone who is excited to help build a bigger business and grow with it. Advancement is earned through proven performance, reliability, initiative, and contributions to the team.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:

Experienced Amazon Sourcer – [Your Name]



Please include all of the following:



1. YOUR EXPERIENCE

   Summarize your hands-on Amazon sourcing experience, including the sourcing methods and marketplaces you have worked with.



2. YOUR TOOLS AND BUYING CRITERIA

   Tell us which tools you use and how you d
 whether a product is worth purchasing.



3. YOUR PROVEN RESULTS

   Share specific results from your previous work, such as qualified leads submitted, purchasing approval rates, actual profitability, or successful replenishable products. Clearly distinguish actual results from estimates.



4. A SHORT LOOM VIDEO

   Introduce yourself and walk us through how you evaluate a product using Keepa. Explain what you look for and what would cause you to approve or reject the opportunity.



5. YOUR TYPICAL DAILY SOURCING FLOWCHART

   Outline an average workday as a simple flowchart, from starting your day to submitting your final leads. Show how you find opportunities, analyze products, reject or qualify leads, and organize follow-up. Include approximate time spent at each stage and the number of qualified leads you typically submit per day.



We want to understand your actual workflow and how you maintain both productivity and quality. A simple text flowchart is fine.



6. PAY AND AVAILABILITY

   Include your desired pay, available working hours and time zone, and earliest start date.



Please protect previous employers’ confidential information. Anonymized examples are welcome.



Applications must include the Loom video and daily sourcing workflow to be considered.



If you have the experience, results, and ambition to grow with us, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Luxury Automotive Reels & Instagram Stories
description:
Supreme Wraps Orlando is a premium automotive customization and protection company specializing in paint protection film (PPF), window tint, vehicle wraps, commercial wraps and other automotive services.



We regularly work with Ferrari, McLaren, Lamborghini, Porsche, Tesla and other premium vehicles.



We're looking for a long-term short-form video editor who can take raw iPhone footage from our shop and transform it into polished, high-retention Instagram Reels and Stories.



This is not simply a cutting-and-trimming position.



We want someone who understands social-media storytelling and viewer retention and can look at raw footage, identify the story, create a strong opening hook, select the best clips and turn them into content people actually want to watch.



What you'll be responsible for

- Editing 15–45 second Instagram Reels

- Creating Instagram Stories from existing footage

- Finding the strongest 1–3 second opening shot

- Developing text/video hooks when appropriate

- Creating alternate hooks for Trial Reels

- Selecting the strongest clips from raw footage

- Color correcting and grading automotive footage

- Working with Apple Log footage when supplied

- Creating clean animated captions and typography

- Music selection

- Automotive sound design

- Speed ramps and transitions when appropriate

- Creating before/after transformations

- Creating educational and talking-head content

- Exporting everything ready to upload to Instagram

- Maintaining a consistent Supreme Wraps visual identity



Our goal is premium—not over-edited.



Ferraris and McLarens should look cinematic and sophisticated. We do not want every video filled with unnecessary transitions, effects or giant animated captions.



You'll receive footage involving:



Ferrari • McLaren • Lamborghini • Porsche • Tesla • BMW • Mercedes-Benz • Corvette • luxury/exotic vehicles • PPF installations • window tint • color-change wraps • commercial vehicle wraps • customer testimonials • before/after transformations • behind-the-scenes footage



You'll also receive footage of the owner speaking directly to camera.



Your job is to turn those assets into compelling social content.



Software

Experience with one or more of the following is required: Adobe Premiere Pro • DaVinci Resolve • After Effects • CapCut



Experience properly grading Apple Log footage is strongly preferred. 



What we're looking for:

You should understand that a successful Reel isn't simply a beautiful video.



It needs to make someone stop scrolling.



You should understand concepts such as:



Hooks → curiosity → retention → payoff → CTA



For example, instead of starting a video with:

“Today we're installing PPF on this Ferrari…”



You should recognize that something such as:

“You probably haven't seen one of these in person yet.” could be a substantially stronger opening.



We're looking for someone who thinks this way.



Compensation

Starting target: $6–$8 USD/hour



Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially, with the potential to increase hours and compensation if the relationship works well.



We're looking for a long-term team member, not someone to complete a few videos and disappear.



Application instructions

Please do NOT send a generic application.



Start your application with the words:

“PERFECTION HAS A FINAL STEP...SUPREME WRAPS”



Then answer the following:

1. Send links to your 3 best short-form videos.

2. Send your best automotive video, if you have one.

3. What do you think makes someone stop scrolling during the first 3 seconds of a Reel?

4. What software do you primarily edit in?

5. Can you properly color-grade Apple Log footage?

6. Do you use DaVinci Resolve?

7. How would you approach editing a Ferrari differently from an ordinary vehicle?

8. How many 20–40 second Reels could you realistically produce each week?

9. What is your hourly rate?

10. Are you willing to complete a paid editing test using our raw footage?



Applications that don't begin with “PERFECTION HAS A FINAL STEP...SUPREME WRAPS” will not be considered.

At the beginning of each month, you will receive the previous month's bank statement and supporting records.



Responsibilities will include:



* Review the bank statement and account for each business transaction

* Update the bookkeeping spreadsheet

* Categorize income and expenses correctly

* Attach or link receipts to the appropriate transactions

* Update mileage records based on information provided

* Identify missing receipts or transactions that need clarification

* Make sure the previous month is complete and organized for tax purposes



Training will be provided for our specific spreadsheet and bookkeeping process.







We are looking for someone who:



* Has bookkeeping experience

* Has experience using QuickBooks Online

* Is comfortable with Google Sheets or Excel

* Understands basic expense categorization and account reconciliation

* Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Communicates clearly in written English

* Is comfortable asking questions

* Does NOT guess when unsure about a transaction

* Can follow written procedures and training materials

* Can handle financial information confidentially



Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is strongly preferred.



Experience with real estate, Airbnb, property management, or service businesses is a plus, but not required.







We understand that every business handles its bookkeeping differently.



You will receive training and written/visual instructions explaining how we organize our records, categorize transactions, handle receipts, and maintain our real estate spreadsheet.



The first month will be used as a training period so we can make sure our processes are clear and that we are a good fit working together.







Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of bookkeeping experience do you have?

2. How much experience do you have with QuickBooks Online?

3. Have you handled bookkeeping for U.S.-based businesses?

4. Have you worked with real estate, Airbnb, property management, or service businesses before?

5. Tell me how you normally handle a transaction when you are unsure which category it belongs in.

6. What other clients or jobs are you currently working with?

title: Accounting Manager — Month-End Close & Job Costing (US Construction, Night Shift)
description:
Republic Homebuilding and Renovations is a design-build residential

construction and remodeling firm in Webster, Texas, USA, serving

homeowners across the Greater Houston area. We run about ten active

jobs at a time, ranging from $20,000 to $300,000. We use QuickBooks

Online for accounting and JobTread for project management and job

costing.

 

We are hiring one Accounting Manager. This is a fully remote role for

someone based in the Philippines, working United States Central Time

hours.

 

 

READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

 

We would rather you rule yourself out now than at offer stage.

 

- This is a night shift, permanently. 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine

  time, Monday to Friday, with one hour unpaid lunch.

- This is a direct engagement with a US company. You would work as an

  independent contractor, not as an employee under Philippine labor

  law. You are responsible for your own taxes and government

  contributions.

- We do NOT provide SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, or HMO. Our pay is set

  above the local market rate specifically because of this. Please

  factor it into your decision.

- This is exclusive and full time. You may not hold another job or

  client engagement while working with us. You will be asked to list

  every current engagement in your application.

- We use screenshot monitoring software on work computers.

 

Pay is $9.00 to $12.00 per hour depending on experience, 40 hours per

week. At today's rate that is roughly PHP 95,700 to PHP 127,500 per

month. Because pay is in US dollars, the peso value moves with the

exchange rate. We also pay a year-end bonus equal to one month's pay,

prorated by month of hire.

 

 

THIS IS NOT A DATA-ENTRY JOB

 

You will own the accounting function.

 

We have separate staff who enter bills, send invoices, chase

documents, and track purchase orders. Your job is to own the close,

own the reconciliations, own the job cost data, and review their work

- not to do it yourself.

 

We are also going to be straightforward about something most job posts

leave out: our historical books need cleanup. Costs have not been

consistently coded to the right jobs, and some accounts need to be

reorganized. Your first ninety days include a defined cleanup project

alongside normal monthly work. You will not be inheriting a clean

system and we are not pretending otherwise.

 

If that is the kind of problem you enjoy, we want to hear from you. If

it sounds like a headache, this is not the right role for you, and

that is fine.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS - ALL FOUR ARE REQUIRED

 

- Bachelor's degree in Accountancy

- 3+ years of accounting experience, including at least one year where

  you were personally responsible for closing the books every month.

  Not assisting someone else who closed them.

- Experience assigning costs to specific projects or jobs, including

  d
 which job a cost belongs to at the time you record it

- QuickBooks Online experience

 

 

STRONGLY PREFERRED

 

- Construction, remodeling, or contracting experience, especially US

  residential

- Experience with a project management or job-costing system alongside

  the accounting system (JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore, CoConstruct,

  or similar)

- Experience producing a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule using

  percentage-of-completion

- Experience closing books for more than one related entity, including

  intercompany transactions

- QuickBooks Online Advanced Certification / ProAdvisor

- CPA (PRC) license

 

If you do not have every item on the preferred list, apply anyway. The

four requirements above are what matter.

 

 

WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS

 

- Reliable high-speed internet AND a reliable backup connection

- Backup power supply

- Reliable computer plus a backup device

- Willingness to use screenshot monitoring software

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 

Monthly close

- Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts every month

- Produce the monthly financial package: profit and loss, balance

  sheet, cash flow statement

- Produce a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule

- Prepare monthly reporting packages required by outside parties

- Close on a published schedule, not "when it gets done"

 

Job costing

- Ensure every cost is coded to the correct job and correct cost type

  at the time it is recorded

- Maintain a clean separation between job costs and company overhead,

  and apply it consistently

- Reconcile job cost data in QuickBooks against JobTread and resolve

  the differences

- Produce per-job cost reporting the project team can rely on

 

Bank feed and payables

- You are the only person who touches the bank feed. Bank feed items

  must be matched to existing bills before they are categorized, never

  entered as new expenses when a bill already exists

- Maintain accounts payable and review vendor bills entered by admin

  staff

- Weekly review for duplicate or miscoded transactions

 

Other

- Run payroll and maintain payroll records

- Maintain the chart of accounts. You are the only person who may add

  or change an account

- Review the work of the admin staff who enter bills and prepare

  invoices

- Reconciliation work extends to two affiliated partnerships in

  addition to the main company

 

 

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

 

We measure this role on deliverables, not on time served.

 

- By Day 21: a written month-end close procedure, in your own words,

  that someone else could follow

- By Day 45: first complete set of reconciliations across all bank,

  credit card, and loan accounts

- By Day 75: first complete monthly financial package, delivered on

  schedule

- By Day 90: agreed cleanup milestones met, and job cost data usable

  for estimating

 

 

WHY YOU WILL LIKE WORKING HERE

 

- Real ownership. You are the accounting function, not a task-taker

- A defined problem with a defined finish line, and a company that

  already knows what is broken

- Admin support, so you are not buried in data entry

- Clear hours, clear expectations, deliverables you can point to

- Direct access to the company President. No layers

- Genuine US construction accounting experience: job costing, WIP,

  percentage-of-completion

 

 

OUR HIRING PROCESS

 

1. Application review

2. Short introductory video call

3. Paid two-hour work sample - a real reconciliation and job-costing

   exercise. We pay you at the role's hourly rate for your time

   whether or not we make an offer. Finalists only.

4. Reference check with a direct supervisor from a recent role

5. Offer

 

We do this because we would rather see how you work than hear about

it.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY - FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY

 

Please apply at our consolidated application form located here: 



Mark

title: JOB TITLE: Experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer — Long-Term VA
description:
LOCATION: Remote

HOURS: 8-5 PH 

PAY: Completely dependent on your skill level 



ABOUT THE ROLE



An established e-commerce business is hiring an experienced Amazon online arbitrage product sourcer for a long-term position.



We’re looking for someone dependable who can identify profitable opportunities, document research accurately, and apply feedback consistently.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Find profitable products from legitimate online retailers for resale through Amazon FBA.

• Use Keepa to evaluate price history, sales activity, competition, and Amazon’s presence.

• Verify exact product matches, including size, color, quantity, and variation.

• Calculate expected profit and ROI using purchase costs, discounts, Amazon fees, and our cost guidelines.

• Flag potential selling restrictions, intellectual-property concerns, and purchasing risks.

• Submit organized leads with retailer links, Amazon links, costs, calculations, and supporting notes.

• Follow our sourcing criteria and use feedback to improve your submissions.



REQUIREMENTS



• Hands-on Amazon online arbitrage sourcing experience.

• Strong Keepa skills beyond checking current sales rank.

• Experience with RevSeller or a comparable profitability tool.

• Comfortable using Google Sheets and documenting research.

• Reliable internet and clear written English.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



After onboarding, our working target is 8–10 well-researched leads per full sourcing day, with approximately 80% meeting our approval criteria.



Quality and accuracy matter. Every submission should be supported by sound research and realistic calculations.



Access to the required sourcing tools will be provided.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line: AMAZON SOURCER — [Your Name]



Please include:



1. A brief summary of your Amazon online arbitrage sourcing experience.

2. The tools you use and how you evaluate a potential product.

3. Your typical daily lead output and approval rate, if tracked.

4. Your availability, time zone, and expected pay.

5. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining how you use Keepa to accept or reject a sourcing opportunity.



Please do not share a previous employer’s confidential product lists or account information.



We value reliable follow-through, thoughtful research, and a willingness to improve. We’re looking for someone interested in a steady, long-term working relationship.

title: AI UGC Video Editor + Ad Creative Designer (Direct Response)
description:
About the role



We're a small performance marketing agency running Meta ads for e-commerce brands. We need a high volume of ad creative — short-form UGC-style video and statics — produced fast.



This is not a brand design job. No logos, no brand guidelines. Every asset has one job: stop the scroll and sell. If you enjoy testing ten hooks to find the one that wins, you'll like this role.



We use Arcads for AI UGC generation, so you don't need to solve AI actor consistency. What we need is someone who can write scripts that perform in that format and turn the raw output into ads that convert.



Heads up on our client mix: we work in regulated categories including CBD, nicotine alternatives, spirits, and supplements. If you're not comfortable making ads in those categories, this isn't the right fit and that's completely fine.



What you'll do



Produce 15–25 new ad creatives per week (mix of statics and 15–30 second videos)

Write UGC scripts and hooks, generate videos in Arcads, then edit them into finished ads

Post-production: cutting, pacing, captions, b-roll, screen recordings, sound design

Design static ads — product on background, comparison charts, testimonial cards, before/after

Composite real client product photos into AI-generated scenes so labels and packaging stay accurate

Build modular creative — multiple hooks, bodies, and CTAs that recombine into variants

Iterate on winners based on performance data we send you weekly

Keep a clean, organized asset library and naming system



You must have



Real experience editing short-form UGC-style ads. Portfolio required.

Strong hook writing — you can take one product and write ten different opening lines

CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects fluency: captions, jump cuts, pacing, sound

Photoshop or equivalent for compositing and retouching

Understanding of direct response fundamentals: pattern interrupts, social proof, CTA placement

Fast turnaround — same-day or next-day on most requests

Conversational written English and clear daily communication

Willingness to track hours with time tracking software



Nice to have



Direct Arcads experience (if not, you'll pick it up in a day — but tell us what you've used instead)

AI image tools: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Seedream

Familiarity with Meta ad policy and what gets creative rejected

Experience with restricted or regulated verticals

Experience reading ad metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CPA)



What we offer



Long-term, stable work with a small team

Paid twice a month, on time, every time

No micromanaging — clear briefs, clear deadlines, you own the output

Rate increases based on results, reviewed at 3 and 6 months



How to apply



Applications that don't follow these steps will be ignored.



Put AI PIXEL as the first two words of your application

Send links to 3 short-form UGC-style video ads you personally edited. For each, tell me what tools you used and how long it took.

Send 2 static ads you made for an e-commerce product

Write 3 different hooks (first 3 seconds, spoken lines) for a fictional magnesium sleep supplement

Tell me your hourly rate in USD and your available hours in Philippine time



Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a small test project before we hire.
