title: AI Developer
description:
We're looking for an AI-first developer who genuinely loves building and shows up with the plan. If you light up when you talk about wiring agents together, shipping internal tools fast, and using AI as a daily working partner, and you'd rather drive the build strategy than wait for a spec, we'd love to hear from you.



The Role



This is a gig-based, project-driven build role focused on internal tooling. Here's what you'd actually be doing:



- Building agents and automations from the ground up, including wiring up MCP servers and Claude Code workflows

- Building a range of internal tools for the team, the kind of things that remove manual work and speed up how we operate

- Working across APIs and integrations, including GoHighLevel, to connect the systems we run on

- Partnering with the team on what gets built and why. We work as a team to win, and you'd own the technical thinking on your side of it



Within the first 30 to 60 days, success looks like you showing up with the plan. You should be telling us what we should build next, how to approach it, and in what order. You should have a clear point of view on what's worth automating, what isn't, and what you want to ship first. The bar here is strategic ownership of the build, not waiting for a backlog to be handed to you.



Schedule



Work hours are flexible but need to overlap with our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST during active project work. Just want to make sure you can meet inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before shipping anything.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be building, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort with Claude Code, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, working with APIs, and the GoHighLevel API. We're also genuinely interested in whatever else you've built your workflow around.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need:

   - Claude Code    /10

   - GitHub    /10

   - Supabase    /10

   - Vercel    /10

   - Working with APIs    /10

   - GoHighLevel API    /10



   Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with /10. Include AI tools, frameworks, automation platforms, niche services, spreadsheets you've built, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts:

   - What size was the company or account when you started (team size, what they were running, what was manual before you came in, whatever metric fits)?

   - What did you build for them?

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those projects today?



   We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a build task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you came on next week and we asked you to build out our internal tooling, walk us through your first 30 days. What would you want to look at, what would you build first, and how would you d
 the order?

2. We hand you a vague request like "we need something to make X less painful," with no spec. Walk us through how you go from that sentence to a shipped tool.

3. An automation you built has started silently failing in production. Walk us through what you check first and how you track it down.

4. Why do you love building this kind of thing? Tell us about a recent tool or automation you shipped that reminded you why you do this work.

5. What's something about building with Claude Code, MCP, or agentic workflows that's changed in the last year that you've actually adjusted your approach around?

title: Reverse Recruiter / U.S. Technical Job Search & Application Specialist
description:
Part-time, ongoing. Starting target: US$3.50–$5.00/hour, depending on demonstrated experience and quality. Initial hours: 8–10 hours/week; increases require approval and demonstrated value.



ABOUT THE ROLE

I am a U.S.-based telecommunications/RF/wireless engineer seeking an experienced reverse recruiter to manage a broad, high-quality professional job search. Your work will uncover strong direct-fit opportunities and credible career pivots, tailor truthful ATS-aligned resumes, submit approved applications after hire, and maintain an accurate application pipeline. Research judgment and factual integrity matter more than application volume.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Search LinkedIn, Indeed, Google, employer career sites, and other reputable sources using Boolean/X-ray searches, synonyms, adjacent job families, competitor research, and company-site searches.

• Find non-obvious opportunities beyond titles containing “RF” or “telecommunications.” Read full job descriptions and distinguish required qualifications, preferred qualifications, learnable gaps, and fatal gaps.

• Search California first, credible U.S. remote roles next, and exceptional U.S. opportunities elsewhere. Prioritize approximately $150,000+ base salary or strong total compensation for the job seeker, while considering strategically valuable roles with compelling benefits, pension, growth, or pivot potential.

• Verify that postings are open and actionable. Use official employer application links whenever available; flag alternative sources for verification.

• Classify opportunities as Direct Fit, Adjacent Growth, Strategic Stretch, or Do Not Apply and explain the evidence behind each recommendation.

• After hire, present opportunities for approval, tailor supported resumes and requested cover letters/application answers, perform quality checks, and submit only approved applications.

• Work accurately with Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, and similar systems.

• Maintain a centralized Google Sheets/Excel tracker, prevent duplicates, preserve resume versions, and log submissions the same day.

• Identify relevant recruiters or hiring managers for priority applications and prepare outreach drafts for approval. Track follow-ups and outcomes.



SEARCH AREAS

Telecommunications, public-safety communications, LMR, RF/wireless, spectrum/FCC, microwave, systems engineering, integration/validation, technical project/program management, solutions/customer engineering, field applications, utilities/energy, critical infrastructure, OT/industrial communications, satellite/space and defense communications, IoT/edge/sensing, wireless hardware and semiconductor systems, and credible network/data-center/cloud/AI infrastructure pivots. Discover additional job families through research. Do not imply unsupported specialist experience.



REQUIRED SKILLS

• Demonstrated U.S. professional job-search support, reverse recruiting, recruiting, sourcing, or career-services experience; engineering/technology experience is strongly preferred.

• Strong technical job-description reading, transferable-skills analysis, Boolean/X-ray research, and employer-site sourcing.

• Excellent written English and careful factual checking.

• ATS resume tailoring without inventing experience, credentials, technologies, metrics, responsibilities, or job titles.

• Application-system experience and disciplined Google Sheets/Excel tracking.

• Ability to work independently, explain recommendations, follow written approval rules, and maintain confidentiality.

Two or more years of relevant experience and examples of client interviews generated by your work are preferred. AI tools may support research and drafting, but all output must be verified and sensitive information must remain within approved tools.



SELECTION PROCESS

1. Application review and shortlist.

2. Shortlisted applicants complete a small, unpaid 3-opportunity competency screen, explaining why each opportunity fits. This is an assessment only; no applications, employer outreach, or account access are involved.

3. Only the top 2 finalists receive a paid 20-opportunity research trial. Trial payment terms and any time cap will be agreed in writing before work begins.

4. One specialist is selected for ongoing part-time work based on research quality, technical judgment, factual integrity, communication, tracking, and cost/availability.



The paid trial includes 8 Direct Fit, 6 Adjacent Growth, 3 Strategic Stretch, and 3 Do Not Apply opportunities with reasoned explanations. At least 6 of the 20 must be credible discoveries beyond simple “RF Engineer” or “Telecommunications Engineer” searches. No applications or employer outreach may be submitted during the trial.



For each trial opportunity, record company, title, location/remote status, advertised compensation, official job URL, posting date/age and deadline when available, classification, fit score with explanation, 3–5 supported matching qualifications, learnable versus fatal gaps, career value, and recommended action. Clearly mark unavailable information.



ACCURACY, ACCESS, AND PRIVACY

The provided Master Career Record is the factual source of truth. Every major resume claim must be traceable to it or separately approved information. Ask about ambiguous experience. Do not add unsupported keywords or automatically advertise total years of experience. Employer-facing positioning and any salary expectations require approval.



The operation uses one dedicated Gmail account owned by me. Trial candidates receive no Gmail or LinkedIn access. After hire, only controlled, explicitly approved access is granted. I retain ownership, recovery methods, and security controls. Do not change credentials, recovery details, forwarding, or permissions without authorization. LinkedIn work must follow the agreed access restrictions; any account access requires separate approval.



Keep resumes, career records, application answers, correspondence, and trackers confidential. Use them only for this assignment. Do not share with third parties, subcontract, upload to unapproved AI/services, or retain unnecessary copies. Never mass-apply, duplicate applications, fabricate claims, or act on unverified closed/stale postings. Escalate uncertain application answers for review.



PERFORMANCE AND CONTINUATION

Provide concise weekly reports covering qualified opportunities, approvals, accurate submissions, recruiter responses, screening calls, interviews, follow-ups, hours, and proposed search improvements. Evaluate interview conversion after sufficient application volume, alongside research quality and process accuracy. Raw application count alone is not a success measure.



Continuation depends on quality, reliability, truthful work, confidentiality, and compliance with approvals and budget. Repeated quality/process problems may lead to ending the engagement or replacement; fabrication, unauthorized applications, or security/privacy violations are grounds to end it. On departure, hand over current trackers, files, and outstanding actions; access will be revoked and personal copies of confidential material must be deleted. Approved work will be paid under the agreed terms.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your response with SIGNAL FOUND and answer:

1. What experience do you have applying to U.S. professional jobs for another person, particularly technical/engineering roles?

2. How do you assess actual qualifications and separate transferable skills, learnable gaps, and fatal gaps?

3. Explain your Boolean/X-ray process and give an example of a non-obvious technical career pivot you identified.

4. Which ATS/application systems have you personally used?

5. How do you tailor resumes for ATS alignment without inventing experience?

6. How do you track applications, resume versions, contacts, follow-ups, and outcomes and prevent duplicates?

7. Describe client interview results from your work, without disclosing confidential client information.

8. What is your hourly rate, weekly availability, and usual working hours/time zone?

9. Approximately how much time does a well-researched, tailored application take you, including quality checks?

10. Confirm that you understand the unpaid 3-opportunity screen, paid 20-opportunity trial for only the top 2 finalists, and prohibition on applications and Gmail/LinkedIn access during the trial.

title: UGC & Creator Manager
description:
About YY Nation



YY Nation is a sustainable sneaker brand from New Zealand. We make shoes from merino wool, cactus leather, hemp and other natural materials, because we think the shoe industry has leaned on plastic for far too long.



The Role



Video content powers our Meta ads, and we need a lot more of it. We're looking for someone to build and run our creator engine: finding the right micro influencers, getting them on board, and keeping a steady flow of great UGC and edited videos coming in every week.



You'll start by focusing on outreach and building the pipeline. As you learn the brand, you'll take on briefing creators and editors yourself, using our guidelines and creative strategy.



This is a long-term role with room to grow into a bigger part of our marketing team.



What You'll Do



*Creator outreach and management*



- Find micro influencers and UGC creators on Instagram and TikTok who fit our brand, mainly in New Zealand, Australia and the USA

- Reach out by DM and
, and follow up without being annoying

- Negotiate rates and usage rights within our budget and standard offer (a paid test video first, then ongoing work if it goes well)

- Coordinate product seeding: collect sizes and addresses and track shipments

- Keep creators on schedule and chase up late deliverables

- Manage creator platforms



*Briefing and quality control (once you're up to speed)*



- Write clear creative briefs for creators and editors using our brand guidelines, personas and angles

- Review incoming content against the brief before it reaches us

- Give clear, specific feedback and request revisions



*Organisation*



- Keep our creator and editor database up to date: contacts, rates, rights, status and performance

- Track usage rights and expiry dates so we never run content we don't have rights to

- Name and file all content according to our naming convention



What We're Looking For



- 2+ years in influencer marketing, UGC sourcing, creator partnerships or talent management

- Excellent written English. Your DMs need to sound warm and natural to people in New Zealand and the USA.

- You know what good UGC looks like and can spot a creator who fits a brand

- Highly organised and comfortable juggling lots of conversations at once

- Persistent and self-driven. Outreach is a numbers game and you don't mind hearing no

- Comfortable with Instagram, TikTok, Google Sheets and Notion



Bonus Points



- Experience with fashion, footwear, apparel or sustainable brands

- You've managed creators for paid social ads, not just organic posts

- Basic understanding of Meta ads and what makes a video convert

- You've written creative briefs before



What Success Looks Like



- A steady flow of new creators contacted every week

- A pipeline that delivers usable UGC videos per week

title: Full-Stack Next.js / TypeScript Developer – SaaS Platform
description:
We are building a new U.S.-based automotive marketplace platform and are looking for a hands-on full-stack developer to help build the product from the ground up.



This is not a front-end-only position. You should be comfortable working across the entire application, including the user interface, backend, database, authentication, APIs, webhooks, third-party integrations, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.



Our current stack is Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, GitHub and Vercel. The platform will include separate customer, business-user and admin portals, with a relational database, role-based authentication, payments, notifications, messaging, scheduling, and integrations with third-party software through APIs and webhooks.



We are looking for someone who can take a clearly defined business workflow and help translate it into reliable software—not simply someone who can build pages from a design.



You should be comfortable with:



• Next.js / React

• TypeScript / JavaScript

• Node.js and backend development

• PostgreSQL or similar relational databases

• REST APIs and webhooks

• Authentication and role-based permissions

• Git / GitHub

• Vercel or similar cloud deployment

• Integrating third-party SaaS products



Experience with Stripe, Twilio, Supabase, transactional
, scheduling systems, or marketplace applications is a plus.



AI development tools are encouraged. We want someone who knows how to use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor or similar tools to work faster and solve problems. However, you must understand, explain, debug and maintain the code you produce.



What we're looking for personally:



• Strong problem-solving ability

• Good written English and communication

• Willingness to ask questions when requirements are unclear

• Ability to think through workflows and edge cases

• Reliable and responsive

• Interested in working on one product long-term rather than completing a quick website project



This is an early-stage product, so the person we hire will have meaningful involvement in how the application is built. If the relationship works well, we are looking for someone who can continue developing and maintaining the platform as the company grows.



To apply, please include:



A brief description of the most complex full-stack application you have personally built.

title: Instagram DM and Phone Assistant for US Jewelry Brand (US Eastern Hours)
description:
Salary: $600 USD per month base, paid twice monthly via Wise, plus performance bonuses when the numbers are good. 13th month pay. Raise review at 90 days.

Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week, 5 days a week. Shift is 9am to 6pm US Eastern (9pm to 6am Manila) with a 1 hour break. Work days are Monday to Saturday with one weekday off, so you work 5 of those 6 days. Exact days agreed before start. Working all 6 days is optional at $700/month.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are an established custom jewelry brand in Florida, USA. We have been in business 6 years, we make everything in-house, and almost all of our sales happen inside Instagram DMs. We get around 35 to 50 new conversations a day plus customer phone calls, and the owner currently handles all of it himself. That is the job you are taking over. The brand name and full details are shared with shortlisted applicants.



You will:



- Answer customer DMs on Instagram fast, in a calm, human, professional voice, following a written playbook.

- Answer the business phone line during your shift ("Thanks for calling, how can I help you"), take messages, answer basic questions from the playbook, and pass sales and order questions to the owner.

- Quote prices straight from our website and answer product questions from a fact sheet. No guessing, ever.

- Follow up with every customer who asked for a price and went quiet, on a set schedule. This is the most important part of the job.

- Log every lead in a spreadsheet with what they want, what they were quoted, and the next follow-up date.

- Hand off ready-to-buy customers to the owner with all their details collected.

- Post a short end-of-day report.



You will not: handle money, negotiate prices, or make up answers. Anything outside the playbook gets escalated to the owner.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent written AND spoken English. Natural, casual, correct, with a clear phone voice. You will be talking to American customers aged 18 to 40 who buy gold chains. Corporate or stiff English will not work here.

- Quiet workspace and a headset. You will be on live calls.

- At least 1 year of customer support, chat support, or social media inbox experience. Ecommerce or Shopify support experience is a plus.

- Able to work US Eastern hours (night shift in the Philippines) reliably.

- Stable internet and a backup connection. Own laptop.

- Detail obsessed. If you are the type who logs everything without being asked, you will do well here.

- Comfortable being measured: response time, follow-ups sent, leads logged, handoffs closed.



Nice to have: Spanish reading ability, jewelry or fashion background, experience with Meta Business Suite or GoHighLevel.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with:



1. A short paragraph about your most relevant experience.

2. Your answer to this customer message, written the way you would send it: "how much for a 12mm cuban and does it fade"

   (Assume the 12mm is $1,180 for 22 inch and that our gold is real 14k gold bonded over silver, about 100 times thicker than plating.)

3. Your typing speed (any free online test).

4. A 30 to 60 second voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) of you answering the phone for a jewelry business and asking how you can help.

5. Confirm you can work 9pm to 6am Manila time.



Applications that skip the sample reply or the voice recording will not be read. The best 5 applicants will get a short paid test (10 real customer messages, 1 hour, paid $10) before a final decision.

title: Senior Local SEO & AI Search Manager
description:
We are not looking for someone who needs an SEO task list.



We are looking for the person who creates the task list.



Leap Windows & Doors is a family-owned replacement window and door company serving homeowners In North Carolina. Our owner has almost 30 years in the industry. We hold a 4.9 star Google rating and we are A+ rated and accredited by the Better Business Bureau. We operate from two offices and plan 1 to 2 new locations in the next 6 months.



We are bringing SEO in-house and want one experienced Local SEO professional to take ownership of our organic search growth.



You will own:

Local SEO

Both Google Business Profiles + new locations

Google Maps visibility

Website SEO

Technical SEO

On-page optimization

Location and service-page growth

Content map, content calendar, and AI-assisted drafts written to our brand knowledge base and approved before publishing

Internal linking

Citation management

Parasite SEO strategy and execution

Link strategy and local authority building

Digital PR opportunities

Competitor research

GA4, Search Console, call tracking, and CRM attribution reporting

AI-search, AEO, and GEO visibility, where we already get real leads from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity

SEO launch planning for new physical locations



You will make normal website changes yourself. Our site runs on a proprietary CMS, not WordPress, and we do not have an in-house developer, so template-level competence matters. This CMS uses a simple to use editor for quick changes and the CMS support staff is available for larger page builds and technical updates. Long term, we will be moving off of this CMS and you will be involved in that migration. 



We already have:

A real operating company with a physical HQ in Burlington, NC and a second office in Greensboro

Over 2,000 North Carolina homeowners served

Strong reviews

An established website with existing search visibility

Existing paid, direct mail, radio, and local events marketing

A written brand knowledge base for you to inherit

A budget for approved tools and outside resources



This role is about growing qualified leads measured in our CRM, not creating reports that only show activity.



We want someone who:

Has 4 to 7+ years of real, hands-on SEO experience

Has personally produced measurable Local SEO results for US service businesses

Understands Google Business Profile beyond posting updates

Can explain why one company outranks another

Understands technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO

Can work confidently inside a proprietary CMS (WordPress experience is a fine proxy)

Can build and improve normal website pages

Writes and validates schema by hand

Uses Search Console and GA4 at an advanced level

Understands local rank-grid tracking

Has built citations and quality links without chasing junk volume

Understands how SEO, Local SEO, and AI search fit together as one system

Uses AI heavily where it improves the work, and checks important output instead of accepting it blindly

Writes natural US English a homeowner would read without noticing it was written offshore

Notices problems without being told to look, and tells us early when something is wrong

Follows a brand rulebook exactly, and pushes back with data when a rule seems wrong

Can turn data into a clear action plan

Works independently and takes deadlines seriously

Keeps learning as search changes



Home-services SEO experience is a major plus. Multi-location, digital PR, advanced off-site SEO, third-party publishing, social-search strategy, or CRM attribution experience is also a plus.



AI use matters:



We do not care whether you prefer ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another strong AI system. We do care how you use it.

We are looking for someone who uses AI to improve work such as:



Keyword clustering and intent classification

Search Console analysis

Competitor research and content-gap analysis

Content briefs and first drafts against a written knowledge base

Internal-link analysis

Schema drafting and checking

Technical research

Large spreadsheet and data analysis

Reporting

Simple scripts and automations

Repeatable workflows



Using AI only to write blog posts is not enough for this role. You should know what data the model is using, what must be checked, what cannot be trusted without outside proof, and when AI is creating noise instead of useful work.



How we work:



You will have a weekly meeting with the marketing director and maintain a simple SEO scorecard.



Each week we expect you to tell us what changed, what you completed, what you learned, what needs attention, and what you are doing next.



We judge results measured in our CRM, not activity reports and not platform-reported numbers. We would rather hear a flat month explained accurately than a good-looking report we cannot trust.



We have strict, written rules about how certain facts about our company are worded. You will get the knowledge base. You will follow it exactly. You will never invent a statistic or a claim to fill a page.



You will have a budget for approved SEO tools, citations, memberships, PR, and link opportunities.



You are being hired for your judgment, not just your labor.



Schedule:



We need 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours every working day, agreed in writing and sustained. We do not need you awake all night. If a full US day shift is not realistic for you long term, tell us what is. We would rather agree on a schedule you can keep for years than one that collapses in month three.



Equipment and connection:



Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection or backup power, and a computer that can run crawls and screen-share without lag. You will be asked to show a speed test.



Compensation:



$1,400 to $1,700 USD per month depending on experience and verified results. Strong candidates may be considered above the listed range.



Also included:



13th month pay

Paid time off

Company-paid SEO tools and memberships

A 6-month performance review with a defined raise path

Long-term, full-time position with one employer



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid practical test before the final interview. Every finalist who completes it in good faith is paid.



How to Apply:



Do not send only a generic resume. Generic applications are deleted.



Use this subject line exactly: SEO - [Your Name] - Frog



Answer these seven questions. Short, specific answers beat long general ones. Links, screenshots, and proof are welcome.



1. Local SEO proof



Give us your two strongest Local SEO results. For each, include: business type, market, website URL if you are allowed to share it, what you personally did, starting situation, measurable result, and how you verified the result.



2. Google Business Profile proof



Give us one example where you materially improved Google Maps or GBP visibility. Tell us the problem, what you changed, what happened, and how you measured it.



3. AI use



Tell us how you currently use AI in your SEO work. Give us three specific workflows you actually use today. For each: which AI tool you use, what you give it, what it produces, and what you still check or do manually.



4. AI judgment



Give us one example of a time AI gave you an SEO recommendation, analysis, or output that was wrong or weak. How did you catch it? What did you do instead?



5. Independent thinking



Imagine you start Monday and nobody gives you an SEO task list. You have access to our website, both Google Business Profiles, Search Console, GA4, rank tracking, and SEO tools. What would you want to understand first before d
 what to work on?



6. Brand rules



While writing a page under a strict brand rulebook, you find a claim you cannot verify. What do you do? Two or three sentences.



7. Logistics



Desired monthly compensation, normal working hours, US Eastern Time availability, and whether you currently work for any other clients or employers.



We care much more about clear thinking and proven results than certifications. Applicants who follow these instructions exactly are reviewed first.

Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Central Time Hours

Industry: U.S. Freight Brokerage / Transportation

Liberty Freights is a U.S.-based freight brokerage company located in Houston, Texas. We are looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Freight Broker / Carrier Sales & Dispatch Specialist to join our team remotely.



Most communication in this position will be handled through
, text messaging, load boards, and online systems. Phone calls may occasionally be necessary, but calling is not a major part of the position.



We need someone who is comfortable working in the U.S. trucking and freight brokerage industry and can help manage loads from booking through delivery.



Previous U.S. freight brokerage, truck dispatching, or logistics experience is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities

Post available freight on DAT

Search for qualified carriers to cover customer loads

Communicate with carriers and dispatchers primarily through
 and text

Negotiate carrier rates

Book dry van and other truckload shipments

Send and obtain signed rate confirmations

Verify carrier information before booking

Review MC/DOT information, insurance, operating authority, and carrier qualifications

Assist with carrier setup and onboarding

Confirm pickup appointments and pickup numbers

Confirm that drivers successfully picked up freight

Obtain pickup and delivery ETAs

Track shipments while in transit

Communicate shipment updates to customers and carriers

Follow up on delayed trucks or missed appointments

Handle detention, layover, rescheduling, and other transportation issues

Obtain PODs immediately after delivery

Follow up on missing BOLs, PODs, and other shipment documentation

Maintain accurate notes on every shipment

Keep Google Sheets and internal tracking records updated

Flag loads or situations requiring management attention

Occasionally make or receive a phone call when an issue cannot be resolved through
 or text

DAT Load Board

ITS Dispatch

FMCSA SAFER Web

Microsoft Outlook / Microsoft

Google Sheets

Requirements



We are looking for someone who:



Has strong written English

Communicates professionally through
 and text

Understands U.S. trucking and freight terminology

Can negotiate freight rates professionally

Has strong attention to detail

Can manage multiple active shipments at the same time

Can work independently without constant supervision

Responds quickly when shipment problems occur

Keeps detailed and accurate notes

Follows company procedures

Is comfortable working with spreadsheets and transportation software

Has dependable high-speed internet

Has a reliable computer

Can work during U.S. Central Time business hours

Is comfortable occasionally speaking on the phone when necessary

Preferred Experience



Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



U.S. freight brokerage

Carrier sales

Truck dispatching

DAT Load Board

ITS Dispatch

SAFER Web

Dry van freight

Rate negotiation

Carrier vetting

Tracking and tracing

Rate confirmations

BOLs and PODs

Detention and layover situations

Microsoft Outlook

Google Sheets

What Success Looks Like



A successful person in this position should be able to help manage a load from beginning to end:



Load received → Post load → Find carrier → Negotiate rate → Vet carrier → Book carrier → Send rate confirmation → Confirm pickup → Track shipment → Communicate updates → Resolve issues → Confirm delivery → Obtain POD → Close load

How to Apply

A carrier is scheduled to pick up at 8:00 AM and has stopped responding to
s and text messages. What would you do?

Are you comfortable communicating primarily through
 and text?

Are you comfortable working U.S. Central Time hours from the Philippines?

End-of-life care is a $20B industry hiding in plain sight. It touches every family, yet remains fragmented, widely distrusted, and offline - all while the world around it has transformed. We believe families deserve a fundamentally better experience.



At Meadow, we're building the modern funeral home. In under two years, we've become California's largest independent, earning hundreds of 5-star reviews and an 80+ NPS along the way. Powered by a team that's built and scaled real-world businesses, we're expanding nationally with urgency, discipline, and plenty of meaningful work still ahead.



We believe great people live everywhere. Our team works across continents and time zones, grounded by shared values: high standards, deep empathy, and a drive to do work that matters.



Learn more about our global teams here: https://www.meadowmemorials.com/global

If this sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you.



About the Role

As an Inbound Sales Representative, you’ll be the first voice families hear when they reach out. You’ll guide them with clarity and compassion -  no cold calls or pushy tactics, just meaningful conversations that help people make one of life’s most important decisions with confidence.



This is a sales role: you're responsible for helping families make confident decisions and guiding them to a close - always with genuine care, never pressure. Depending on team needs and performance, this role may include a mix of inbound sales conversations, returning lead follow-up, and support work that helps the broader sales process run smoothly.



A quick note, because many candidates wonder about it: People often assume this work is emotionally heavy, but our team consistently finds it deeply meaningful and surprisingly uplifting. The role is rooted in hospitality, clarity, and human connection, not sadness. Rather than feeling heavy, the work offers a unique sense of purpose as part of a modern, compassionate company transforming an outdated industry and bringing dignity, transparency, and warmth to families across the country.



Grow Your Career

Most teammates begin in our Second Call Representative role, a customer-facing sales position where you'll build product expertise, close deals, and develop our consultative sales approach.



High-performing Day Shift reps may become eligible to join our First Call Representative team after approximately three months. First Call Reps receive more inbound opportunities and move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan tied directly to dollars sold, creating meaningful upside for top performers.



Eligibility for the First Call team is based on sustained performance, including strong conversion results, customer experience, workflow accuracy, and overall reliability.



What You’ll Do

- Handle warm inbound leads and support families through the sales process with clarity, empathy, and strong follow-through.

- Guide families through cremation options, helping them make a confident decision when possible and ensuring thoughtful follow-up when more time is needed.

- Manage returning leads and follow-up conversations across phone, text, and
 so no family falls through the cracks.

- Contribute to queue coverage, sales activities, and related support workflows that improve the overall customer experience.

- Hit performance targets while maintaining strong conversion outcomes and quality scores.

- Move fluently across our stack - HubSpot, Aircall, GSuite, Slack, and our case management system.



Requirements

- 2+ years of sales experience with a track record of meeting or exceeding individual targets -  managing the full sales cycle and closing, ideally consumer (B2C) sales over the phone.

- Strong sales instincts and phone presence: you can guide a live conversation toward a confident decision, handle objections naturally, and build trust with families while balancing sales conversations with follow-up and support work.

- Clear spoken and written English; you explain options simply and warmly.

- Self-driven and results-focused: you track where you stand against your target and adjust when you're behind. Emotionally steady and highly coachable

- Comfortable working independently and managing a consistent follow-up rhythm.

= Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRMs (Salesforce, Zoho, etc.).

- A home setup that supports the work - see our tech requirements for details.



Bonus Points

- Experience selling in high-trust categories (insurance, healthcare, travel, etc.).

- Spanish fluency — many of the families we serve speak it.



Details:

- Remote, full-time

- Compensation: $6-$9 USD OTE

- Competitive base pay plus monthly performance bonuses.

- The advertised OTE reflects expected earnings in your starting role. Top performers who advance to our First Call Representative team move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan with significantly higher earning potential.



- Tools: HubSpot (CRM), Aircall (phone), Slack, and our case management system

- Schedule:

- Full-time, 8-hour shifts on a consistent weekly schedule

- Days: Monday–Friday, Tuesday–Saturday, or Sunday–Thursday (weekend availability a plus)

- Available shift windows:

- AM (start 6–8am EST)

- PM (start 1–4pm EST)



Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

- We’re a real business, built to last. We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years.  We’re now going national. And plan to grow for years to come.

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

- Growth path: Tea
mbers may begin with a mix of inbound sales, returning lead follow-up, and support responsibilities, with opportunities to take on expanded first-call responsibilities based on performance. 

- People stay. Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our Glassdoor reviews.

- Fair compensation with real upside. Competitive globally benchmarked base pay, meaningful monthly bonuses, and a clear path to an uncapped compensation plan through eligibility to our First Call team.

- High care, high standards. Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.

- Benefits: PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid training, fully remote.

- Purpose-driven work: Real impact during one of life's most meaningful transitions.



Apply Now

We’re just getting started, and we’re looking for people who want to grow with us. If you’re excited about making an impact, building meaningful relationships, and launching a successful career in sales and tech, apply today. Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply - your passion and potential matter more than checking every box.

title: SEO Specialist
description:
About us: 



EMRG is an award-winning Digital Marketing Agency based in Los Angeles. With a team of experienced professionals for each service line, we offer a wide range of digital marketing solutions customized to meet the unique needs of each client. We are renowned for our outstanding customer service and ability to deliver exceptional results. As a leading agency in the industry, we have established ourselves as a reliable partner for businesses looking to grow and expand their online presence.

As our company continues to grow, we are also committed to expanding our philanthropic goals and supporting children in need worldwide.



Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven SEO Specialist to improve our clients’ organic visibility, website traffic, rankings, lead generation, and overall search performance.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in on-page SEO, technical SEO, keyword research, content optimization, local SEO, reporting, and call tracking. This person should be comfortable analyzing performance data, identifying opportunities, implementing recommendations, and coordinating with our web, content, PPC, sales, and account management teams.

Experience with CallRail is important, as this role will also help monitor call attribution, lead quality, and phone conversion performance across client campaigns.



As an SEO Specialist, your tasks will include, but not be limited to:

Conducting keyword research and identifying high-value search opportunities

Developing and executing SEO strategies to improve rankings, organic traffic, leads, and conversions

Performing on-page SEO optimization, including title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, images, and content structure

Conducting technical SEO audits and identifying issues related to crawlability, indexing, site architecture, page speed, mobile usability, and site performance

Working with developers to resolve technical SEO issues and implement recommendations

Reviewing and optimizing website content based on keywords, search intent, user experience, and conversion opportunities

Creating SEO content recommendations and briefs for writers and content teams

Monitoring keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, leads, and other SEO performance metrics

Analyzing website performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools

Identifying ranking drops, traffic changes, indexing issues, tracking problems, and other performance concerns

Conducting competitor research and identifying opportunities to improve client visibility

Supporting backlink analysis, link-building strategies, and off-page SEO initiatives

Performing local SEO optimization, including Google Business Profile optimization and local search strategy

Supporting website migrations, redesigns, launches, and major website updates from an SEO perspective

Monitoring search engine updates and changes in SEO best practices

Preparing weekly, monthly, and ad hoc SEO reports for clients and internal teams

Providing clear insights and recommendations based on SEO performance data

Maintaining organized documentation of SEO strategies, audits, tasks, recommendations, and completed work

Coordinating with Account Managers to provide SEO updates, priorities, and recommendations

Collaborating with PPC, web development, content, creative, and other departments

Managing SEO tasks and deadlines through company project-management systems

Ensuring assigned SEO tasks and recommendations are completed accurately and on time

Participating in internal and client meetings when SEO expertise is required



Call Tracking and CallRail Responsibilities:

Managing and monitoring client call tracking through CallRail

Reviewing inbound call volume, call sources, answered calls, missed calls, qualified leads, and other call-related performance metrics

Analyzing call attribution to determine which marketing channels, campaigns, landing pages, and traffic sources are generating phone leads

Monitoring dynamic number insertion and ensuring call tracking is functioning properly across client websites

Reviewing call recordings when appropriate to assess lead quality and campaign performance

Identifying tracking issues, attribution problems, or discrepancies in reported phone leads

Connecting call performance data with SEO, PPC, and overall digital marketing performance

Coordinating with PPC, SEO, Account Management, and Sales when call data identifies performance issues or opportunities

Preparing call tracking reports and including CallRail data in client and internal performance reporting

Identifying trends in phone leads and recommending optimization opportunities based on call data

Ensuring call tracking numbers, source attribution, and conversion tracking are properly configured

Helping identify whether calls are qualified leads, spam, existing customers, or unrelated inquiries when applicable



Additional Responsibilities

Conducting research and identifying new SEO tools, opportunities, and strategies

Staying informed on developments in search engines, AI-driven search, and digital marketing

Helping troubleshoot website and tracking issues related to organic search performance

Supporting client reporting and performance analysis

Handling special projects and other tasks as assigned



Qualifications:

Professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or a closely related role

Strong understanding of on-page, off-page, local, and technical SEO

Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, and organic search strategy

Experience conducting SEO audits and developing actionable recommendations

Experience using CallRail for call tracking, attribution, reporting, and lead-quality analysis

Experience interpreting call tracking metrics and connecting call performance to marketing results

Familiarity with dynamic number insertion and call conversion tracking

Experience with Google Analytics and Google Search Console

Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Moz, or similar platforms

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Ability to interpret marketing data and translate findings into actionable recommendations

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Strong attention to detail

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Ability to manage multiple websites, clients, and priorities simultaneously

Ability to work independently while collaborating with other departments



Nice to have:

Previous experience working at a digital marketing or SEO agency

Experience managing SEO campaigns across multiple client accounts

Advanced experience with CallRail reporting and attribution

Experience reviewing call recordings and categorizing lead quality

Experience with WordPress or other content-management systems

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, schema markup, and website structure

Experience with Google Tag Manager

Experience with local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization

Experience with website migrations and redesign projects

Experience creating SEO content briefs

Experience with backlink analysis and link-building campaigns

Understanding of Core Web Vitals and website performance optimization

Experience using 
, Asana, Trello, or similar task-management platforms

Familiarity with AI-powered search and changes in organic search behavior



Who We're Looking For:

We are looking for someone who does more than monitor rankings.

The ideal candidate understands that SEO performance should ultimately contribute to leads and business results. You should be comfortable analyzing both organic search data and call performance to determine whether marketing efforts are generating meaningful opportunities for our clients.

You should be proactive, analytical, accountable, and able to clearly explain what is working, what is not working, and what should happen next.



Application Requirements

To be considered for this position, all applicants must submit:

-An updated resume

A maximum 3-minute introduction video answering the following questions:

-Why are you interested in this position?

-What do you know about EMRG?

-What is your ideal work environment?

-What are your greatest strengths?

-Where do you see yourself in five years?

title: Onboarding Specialist (CSR)
description:

Ansible Health is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Onboarding Specialist / Customer Service Representative (CSR) to join our innovative team. As a key member of our patient-centric approach to healthcare delivery, you will play a crucial role in ensuring a smooth onboarding process for new patients and providing exceptional customer service.



What is AnsibleHealth?

AnsibleHealth unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We are looking for a top-tier Onboarding Specialist / CSR to become an integral part of our expanding team. This role is vital in delivering superior customer service, handling patient communications, and providing essential support to our clinical staff in their mission to offer exceptional care. The ideal candidate will demonstrate exemplary professionalism, excellent English language communication skills, and outstanding organizational abilities with meticulous attention to detail. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute significantly to our patient-centric approach in healthcare delivery.

Nice to have

Job Details

Full-time: A minimum of 40 hours a week

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work Pacific/Eastern hours)

Benefits:

Best of luck!

title: Lead Generation & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Part Time | 4 Hours Per Day | Monday to Friday | Potential to Become Full Time



Start Date: Week of September 21, 2026



We are a growing USA based web design business looking for a motivated and reliable Lead Generation & Digital Marketing Specialist to help us find new business clients and generate qualified leads.



This is a remote, part time position starting at 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday, with the potential to increase to full time hours as the business grows.



The ideal candidate is confident speaking with business owners, comfortable using AI and digital marketing tools, and able to independently identify potential customers and turn them into booked consultations.



Key Responsibilities



Lead Generation and Prospecting



- Use AI tools to research and identify potential business leads.

- Find businesses that could benefit from a new or improved website.

- Use social media platforms and other online resources to identify potential clients.

- Research businesses and identify opportunities for website design, redesign, or digital marketing services.

- Build and maintain lists of qualified prospects.

- Continuously develop new strategies for finding potential customers.



Cold Calling and Appointment Setting



- Make outbound cold calls to business owners and decision makers.

- Introduce our web design services and identify potential opportunities.

- Follow up with interested prospects.

- Qualify leads and schedule consultations for the sales and design team.

- Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, follow ups, and appointments.

- Cold calling will need to be conducted during USA business hours, so applicants must be comfortable working hours that may fall outside of normal local business hours.

- Earn a $100 commission for every website or service deal that closes from a lead you personally generated.

- There is no limit to the number of commissions you can earn. The more qualified leads you generate and the more deals that close, the more you can earn.



Social Media Management



- Manage social media accounts for the business.

- Create and publish engaging social media posts.

- Develop content ideas using AI and other tools.

- Monitor social media activity and identify potential leads.

- Use social media platforms to actively prospect for new business opportunities.

- Maintain a professional and consistent online presence.



Paid Advertising



- Set up, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

- Research audiences, keywords, and targeting opportunities.

- Monitor campaign performance and make adjustments to improve results.

- Assist with developing advertisements, offers, and marketing campaigns.

- Track leads and help determine which marketing strategies generate the best results.



Requirements



- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

- Confident speaking with business owners over the phone.

- Previous cold calling, telemarketing, lead generation, sales, or digital marketing experience is preferred.

- Comfortable using AI tools for research, prospecting, content creation, and marketing.

- Familiarity with social media platforms such as
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok.

- Basic understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks independently.

- Reliable, self motivated, and results oriented.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

- Stable, high speed internet connection.

- Quiet and professional workspace suitable for making cold calls.

- Must be available to make calls during USA business hours.



Hours



Monday to Friday, 4 hours per day.



The initial position is part time, with the possibility of increasing hours and transitioning to a full time position based on performance and business growth.



Because the role involves calling businesses in the United States, your working hours must overlap with USA business hours.



How to Apply



To be considered for this position, you must include both of the following with your application:



1. Cold Call Video



Record a 1 to 2 minute video of yourself demonstrating a cold call to a business owner.



Pretend you are calling a local business that has an outdated website and are trying to introduce website design services.



We are looking for:



- Clear and confident communication

- Professional phone manner

- Ability to quickly build rapport

- Ability to explain the value of a better website

- Ability to handle objections

- Ability to confidently ask for a consultation or next step



2. Internet Speed Screenshot



Include a screenshot of your internet speed test from the location where you will be working.



The screenshot should clearly show your download speed, upload speed, and ping or latency.



Applications that do not include both the cold call video and internet speed screenshot may not be considered.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is hungry to generate results, not someone who simply wants to complete a list of tasks.



If you are confident on the phone, enjoy finding opportunities, are comfortable with technology and AI, and want the opportunity to grow with a developing business, we would like to hear from you.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | U.S. Exterior Remodeling Company

Are you confident on the phone, organized, proactive, and great with customers?



We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our growing U.S.-based exterior remodeling company.



We work with homeowners across the U.S. and provide exterior remodeling services such as roofing, siding, windows, gutters, and other home improvement solutions.



This is more than just answering phones. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, stay organized, communicate professionally, and make sure every customer receives an excellent experience.



If you are someone who notices the details, follows through on tasks, and doesn't need to be constantly told what to do, we want to hear from you!



⭐ What You'll Do

Your main responsibility will be helping our customers and keeping our customer information organized and up to date.



You will:



📞 Answer inbound calls from homeowners in a friendly, professional manner.

📞 Make outbound calls when follow-up is needed.

💬 Respond to customer questions and provide accurate information.

📅 Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and update appointments.

📝 Enter customer information and call details accurately into our CRM.

💻 Keep customer records, notes, and project information organized.

🔎 Monitor incoming inquiries and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

🔄 Follow up with customers and leads when required.

🤝 Communicate customer requests to our sales and production teams.

🚨 Identify customer issues and escalate them appropriately.

📊 Maintain accurate data and complete administrative tasks.

💡 Look for ways to improve processes and customer experience.

✅ Take ownership of assigned tasks and make sure they are completed.

💎 The Person We're Looking For

We don't just want someone who can answer a phone.



We want someone who is:



Detail-Oriented

You double-check your work and understand that small mistakes in customer information can create big problems.



Proactive

You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You see something that needs attention and take action.



A Great Communicator

You can speak clearly and professionally with U.S. homeowners and communicate effectively with our internal team.



Customer-Focused

You are patient, friendly, helpful, and understand how important every customer interaction is.



Highly Organized

You can manage calls, appointments, follow-ups, CRM updates, and multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.



Reliable & Accountable

When you say something will be done, you make sure it gets done.



A Problem Solver

You try to find solutions instead of simply saying, "I don't know."



A Fast Learner

You are comfortable learning new software, systems, and company processes.



🎯 Requirements

Previous experience in customer service, call center, virtual assistance, receptionist, or administrative work.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Strong phone and communication skills.

Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers.

Good computer and internet skills.

Ability to work with CRM systems and spreadsheets.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to multitask.

Ability to work independently.

Reliable internet connection.

Quiet, professional workspace.

Professional headset and computer.

🏠 Industry Experience Is a BIG Plus

Experience in any of these industries will give you an advantage:



Roofing

Exterior remodeling

Construction

Home improvement

Windows

Siding

Gutters

Insurance restoration

Real estate

Property services

Don't have remodeling experience? That's okay!



If you have excellent customer service skills, strong English, a great attitude, and are willing to learn, we are still interested in hearing from you.



📈 What Success Looks Like

We want you to become someone our team can depend on.



A successful team member will:



Answer calls professionally and promptly.

Keep customer information accurate.

Follow up without being reminded.

Keep the CRM clean and organized.

Make sure appointments are properly scheduled.

Communicate important information quickly.

Catch mistakes before they become problems.

Provide customers with a positive experience.

Take responsibility and ownership of their work.

🚀 Why Join Us?

🌎 Work remotely with a growing U.S. company.

💼 Long-term opportunity for the right person.

📚 Training and support provided.

🤝 Work with a professional and supportive team.

📈 Opportunity to grow as the company grows.

🎯 Be part of a team where your work directly impacts customer experience and business growth.

⏰ Schedule

Full-Time



You must be available to work during U.S. business hours.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview.



💰 Compensation

Competitive salary based on experience and skill level.



Additional opportunities for growth and performance-based incentives may be available for the right candidate.



📝 How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



Resume/CV

Brief description of your customer service experience

Your experience handling inbound calls

CRM/software experience

Your internet speed

Your computer specifications

Your available working hours

Your expected monthly salary

A short answer to this question:

"What makes you an excellent customer service representative?"



⚠️ IMPORTANT

To show us that you read the entire job post, please start your application with:



"I'M READY TO HELP!"



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



🌟 Who We Want

If you're reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, confident on the phone, comfortable working independently, and serious about building a long-term career, we want to meet you.



We're not looking for someone who simply wants a job.



We're looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team.



👉 Apply today — we look forward to meeting you!

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant (U.S. Tax & Executive Operations)
description:
We are looking for a high-performance operator who understands numbers, financial data, and business operations and can work directly alongside a fast-moving, visionary leader.



This role is ideal for someone with a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, financial reporting, or business analysis who wants to move beyond traditional administrative work and become a strategic partner to executive leadership.



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, think analytically, and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do, keep reading.



Who We Are



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to solve problems—not simply complete tasks.



We value:



-Speed

-Accountability

-Precision

-Emotional maturity

-Ownership

-Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is



This role combines Executive Support, Financial Operations, Data Analysis, and Business Execution.



Your primary responsibility is to help leadership make better decisions by organizing financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights.



You'll support executive initiatives while ensuring critical business, accounting, and tax-related information is accurate, organized, and decision-ready.



You'll help:



-Organize and analyze financial, operational, and business data

-Prepare executive reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking

-Review accounting, bookkeeping, and U.S. tax-related reports for accuracy and completeness

-Assist leadership in monitoring financial performance and operational metrics

-Coordinate with accounting, finance, tax, and operations teams

-Protect your executive's time by managing priorities and follow-through

-Drive accountability across leadership initiatives

-Identify operational gaps and recommend process improvements

-Translate strategy into structured execution

-Solve problems before they become emergencies



You will work closely with executive leadership and have visibility into confidential financial and business information.



Professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment are essential.



Preferred Background



We're especially interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:



-U.S. Tax Preparation or Tax Operations

-Public Accounting

-Bookkeeping

-Accounting or Finance

-Financial Analysis

-Business Analytics

-Audit or Compliance

-Controller or Accounting Support

-Executive Assistant supporting Finance or Executive Leadership



Experience with tools such as QuickBooks, Excel/Google Sheets, financial reporting software, or tax software is highly preferred.



What This Role Is NOT



This role is not for someone who:



-Needs constant reassurance or supervision

-Struggles with direct feedback

-Prefers slow-moving corporate environments

-Gets overwhelmed by changing priorities

-Waits for instructions instead of solving problems

-Is uncomfortable working with numbers, financial data, or business systems

-Frequently changes jobs every year



We operate in a high-accountability environment where ownership matters.



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)



Within your first 90 days, you will:



-Organize and improve financial and operational reporting

-Build dashboards and executive reports that improve decision-making

-Support leadership with accurate accounting and tax-related insights

-Improve reporting processes across departments

-Run executive meetings with clear agendas and follow-up

-Anticipate leadership needs before they arise

-Track priorities and hold teams accountable

-Bring solutions, not just problems

-Operate calmly and effectively under pressure



The Profile That Thrives Here



You likely:



-Have experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, U.S. tax, or business analysis

-Understand financial statements, reconciliations, reporting, and business metrics

-Have supported a founder, executive, or finance leader

-Have remained in at least one meaningful role for three or more years

-Enjoy building systems and improving operational processes

-Are highly organized and analytical

-Communicate clearly and professionally

-Maintain composure under pressure

-Think in terms of business outcomes, not just completing tasks



You are someone who:



-Spots financial or operational issues before others do

-Brings clarity where others see complexity

-Takes initiative without waiting to be asked

-Uses data to support better business decisions



Compensation & Growth



This role offers:



-Competitive compensation based on experience and performance

-Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision-making

-The opportunity to influence business operations and financial processes

-Long-term career growth as DAP Brands continues to scale



At DAP Brands, we reward impact, ownership, and results, not simply tenure.



Final Note



This opportunity is for someone who wants to grow beyond a traditional Executive Assistant role and become a trusted business partner to executive leadership.



If you have a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, finance, or financial operations and enjoy solving problems, improving systems, and helping leaders execute at a high level, we'd love to hear from you.



If you're looking for a slow-paced, highly structured corporate environment, this probably isn't the right fit.



But if you're excited to work alongside leadership, make data-driven decisions, and help build something meaningful, apply through our careers page 
/careers and write "MAVERICK" before your name.

title: Senior Non-QM Mortgage Underwriter (Remote | Night Shift)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Senior Non-QM Mortgage Underwriter (Remote | Night Shift)

Php 70,000 – Php 188,179/month (based on experience)

Full-Time | Permanent Remote | U.S. Mortgage Company



>Why This Role is Different



We’re not looking for a basic underwriter.



We’re hiring someone who can confidently review and approve complex Non-QM loans — someone who understands risk, moves fast, and knows how to make solid credit decisions.



If you have strong Non-QM experience and want to work directly with a growing U.S.-based mortgage team, this is a long-term opportunity with real impact.



> What You’ll Be Doing



Underwrite Non-QM loans (DSCR, Bank Statement, WVOE, P&L)



Analyze credit, income, assets, and collateral



Review AUS findings and apply conditions or overlays



Issue decisions: Approve, Deny, or Suspend



Work closely with processors and operations to clear conditions



Maintain strong turn times while ensuring compliance



Support junior team members when needed



> What We’re Looking For



At least 5 years U.S. mortgage underwriting experience



Strong Non-QM experience (DSCR, Bank Statement, etc.)



Experience handling self-employed borrowers and complex files



Solid understanding of U.S. mortgage guidelines (TRID, ATR/QM, etc.)



Able to make independent credit decisions



Detail-oriented and reliable in a remote setup



Plus (but not required):



Experience with Encompass



Korean, Chinese, or Vietnamese language skills



> Work Setup



Remote (Work from Home)



Night Shift: 11:30 PM – 8:30 AM PH Time



Stable, long-term role with a U.S.-based company



> Basic Requirements



At least 16GB RAM



Intel i5 (4th gen or newer) or equivalent



Stable internet (minimum 100 Mbps)



>> How to Apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and follow the instructions below carefully:



1. All applicants must submit their application via
 sent directly through OnlineJobs.ph.

Updated Resume (PDF or link — Google Drive/Dropbox/OLJ profile)

If submitting a link, make sure it is set to “Anyone with the link can view”



Years of U.S. Mortgage Underwriting Experience



Years of Non-QM Experience (DSCR, Bank Statement, etc.)

Earliest Start Date / Availability



2. Answer This Question (Required)



In your application message, briefly answer:



What are the three main documents you review when underwriting a DSCR loan?



(Keep your answer short and direct.)

To confirm you have read the job post, please include this line at the beginning of your message:



“I have Non-QM underwriting experience.”



4. For Shortlisted Candidates Only



If you are shortlisted, you will be asked to complete a quick follow-up step, which includes:



Internet speed test (screenshot from speedtest.net)



Computer specifications (RAM and processor)



Short Non-QM scenario-based questions



>> Note



Only applicants who follow the instructions above will be prioritized for review.



>> Shortlisted Candidates



Qualified applicants will be invited to complete a short screening step, which may include:



Quick technical questions (Non-QM / DSCR)



Speedtest and computer specs



Brief experience validation



>> Final Note



We’re looking for serious underwriters who know how to assess risk and make confident decisions.



If that’s you, apply now — we review applications daily.

title: Remote Mortgage Funder
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

REMOTE MORTGAGE FUNDER (FRESH GRADUATES WELCOME | MORTGAGE EXPERIENCE PREFERRED)



Salary:

Php 19,700 - Php 28,600 per month (No Mortgage Experience)

Php 30,000 - Php 35,000 per month (With Mortgage Experience)



Location:

Remote (Work From Home)



Schedule:

Full-Time

U.S. Pacific Time (PST)

Philippine Graveyard Shift



ABOUT THE ROLE



Wholesale Mortgage Bankers is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Mortgage Funder to join our growing team.

We welcome fresh graduates who are eager to build a career in the U.S. mortgage industry. Candidates with mortgage funding, closing, post-closing, processing, setup, underwriting support, or related mortgage experience are highly encouraged to apply.



This position offers an excellent opportunity to learn the U.S. mortgage process, work directly with mortgage professionals, and develop valuable industry skills while working from home.



RESPONSIBILITIES

> Review loan documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance

> Verify that all funding conditions have been satisfied before loan disbursement

> Coordinate with title companies, escrow officers, processors, and underwriters

> Process funding requests and maintain funding records

> Review loan files and identify missing or incorrect documentation

> Perform quality control reviews prior to funding

> Maintain organized loan records and documentation

> Communicate funding requirements and issues to appropriate parties

> Follow company policies, investor guidelines, and regulatory requirements

> Participate in ongoing training and process improvement initiatives



QUALIFICATIONS



> Fresh graduates are welcome to apply

> Previous mortgage experience is preferred but not required

> Experience in mortgage funding, closing, post-closing, processing, setup, underwriting support, or related roles is an advantage

> Strong attention to detail and accuracy

> Excellent organizational and time management skills

> Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

> Ability to work independently and manage deadlines

> Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

> Experience with mortgage software or loan origination systems is a plus



WORK-FROM-HOME REQUIREMENTS



> Windows-based laptop or desktop computer

> Minimum 8GB RAM (16GB preferred)

> Reliable high-speed internet connection

> Backup internet connection preferred

> Quiet and professional work environment

> Dual-monitor setup is an advantage

> Willing to install company-required software and monitoring tools



WHAT WE OFFER



> Competitive salary based on experience

> Comprehensive training and exposure to U.S. mortgage operations

> Long-term career growth opportunities

> Work-from-home setup

> Supportive and professional team environment

> Performance and salary reviews based on performance and tenure



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: To show that you have read this job post carefully, start your application with:

"I have read the job post from beginning to end."



Please send the following:

> Resume using a Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox link with viewing access enabled

> Brief cover letter explaining why you are interested in the position

> Screenshot of your internet speed test

> Computer specifications (Processor, RAM, and Operating System)



Applications that do not follow the instructions above may not be considered.



We look forward to meeting motivated individuals who are ready to build a long-term career in the U.S. mortgage industry.
