title: TPA Estimator - Restoration
description:
About the Position



Summit Restoration & Construction is looking for an experienced Virtual Restoration & Construction Estimator to join our team full-time.



We are specifically looking for someone with previous U.S. restoration industry experience who understands both mitigation and reconstruction estimating, has strong Xactimate experience, and has worked with TPA programs and insurance claims.



This is a full-time position with set working hours. This is not a flexible-hours, freelance, or project-based position. You will be expected to be available and actively working during your assigned schedule.



The ideal candidate can review project documentation, understand the full scope of a restoration loss, prepare accurate estimates, identify missing information, and communicate effectively with our U.S.-based team.



Responsibilities



* Prepare detailed estimates using Xactimate

* Write estimates for both mitigation and reconstruction

* Estimate water, fire, mold, and other property damage losses

* Review photos, measurements, scopes, Matterport documentation, MICA documentation, notes, and other project information

* Understand the relationship between mitigation and reconstruction scopes

* Prepare accurate estimates based on the documented scope of work

* Apply appropriate Xactimate line items for labor, materials, equipment, demolition, mitigation, and reconstruction

* Work within TPA program requirements and guidelines

* Review carrier and TPA estimate requirements and make necessary revisions

* Prepare estimate revisions and supplements when additional work or documentation is identified

* Assist with responding to carrier or TPA estimate revisions and questions

* Review estimates for accuracy, completeness, and proper documentation before submission

* Communicate with Project Managers, Coordinators, Estimators, and other members of our U.S.-based team

* Maintain organized project files and documentation

* Meet estimating deadlines and communicate proactively when information is missing



Required Experience & Qualifications



Applicants should have:



* Previous restoration estimating experience

* Hands-on Xactimate experience

* Experience estimating both mitigation and reconstruction

* Experience working with TPA programs

* Understanding of insurance restoration claims and carrier requirements

* Knowledge of water, fire, mold, and other property damage losses

* Ability to interpret photos, measurements, floor plans, scopes, and project documentation

* Understanding of restoration and construction terminology

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines

* Reliable internet connection and a professional remote work environment

* Ability and willingness to work a full-time, set schedule aligned with Arizona business hours



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is highly preferred:



* XactAnalysis

* MICA

* Matterport

* CompanyCam

* TPA platforms and programs

* Insurance carrier estimating guidelines

* Estimate revisions and supplements

* Xactimate Level 1, 2, or 3 certification

* Previous remote experience working directly with a U.S.-based restoration company



What We're Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to enter line items into Xactimate.



We need an estimator who understands restoration and can look at a loss from both the mitigation and reconstruction sides. You should understand how restoration projects move through the insurance process, how TPA requirements affect estimating and documentation, and what is needed to produce a thorough and defensible estimate.



We are a process-driven company, so it is important that you are able to follow established procedures, communicate when something is unclear, meet deadlines, and consistently produce quality work.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term, full-time position and wants to become an important part of our team.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions with your application:



1. How many years of restoration estimating experience do you have?

2. How many years have you used Xactimate?

3. Do you have experience writing both mitigation and reconstruction estimates? Please explain.

4. Which TPA programs have you worked with?

5. What types of losses have you estimated (water, fire, mold, reconstruction, large loss, etc.)?

6. Have you worked directly for or supported a U.S.-based restoration company?

7. What other restoration software have you used?

8. Do you currently hold any Xactimate certifications?

9. Are you available to work full-time during set Arizona/U.S. business hours?

10. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



Please also provide a sample Xactimate estimate you have completed. All customer names, addresses, claim information, and other confidential information must be removed before submitting the sample.



Applicants without restoration, Xactimate, mitigation/reconstruction, or relevant TPA experience may not be considered.

title: Remote Accounting Coordinator (Work from Home)
description:
A growing North American facilities services organization is expanding its remote accounting support and is seeking dependable, detail-oriented professionals. This is a work-from-home independent contractor engagement supporting commercial and retail clients across Canada.

title: Customer Service Manager (E-commerce / Dropshipping)
description:
Job description

We are an e-commerce group running several Shopify dropshipping stores, selling

fashion and home decor worldwide. We ship thousands of orders a month and we are

growing.



We are looking for a Customer Service Manager to lead our support team. You will

manage four representatives, you will report directly to the owner, and you will

own the numbers your team produces.



This is a leadership role. We are not looking for our strongest ticket handler.

We are looking for the person who makes a team strong and keeps it that way.





What you will own

Your team. Four representatives on Manila hours. You set the schedule and

the targets, you review the work every week, you coach the people who are

behind, and you tell us early when someone is not going to make it. You hire and

you let go, together with the owner.



Response time. How fast customers hear back from us, across every store, is

yours. You hold it when volume spikes.



Customer refunds. When we pay a customer back, we lose the sale and we keep

the cost of the product, the shipping and the ad that won the order. You will

know exactly why customers ask for their money back, per store and per product,

and you will bring that number down.



Disputes. Chargebacks and payment disputes are part of this business. You do

not have to file every case yourself, but you own the result: no deadline is

missed, and the cases we can win, we win.



Root causes. In dropshipping, most complaints start upstream, with a

supplier or a product listing, not with your team. Your job is to find the

pattern, prove it with order numbers, and take it to the product and supply

chain teams until it is fixed. We would rather solve the cause than pay the

refund.



A team that runs without you. You will train a deputy and write down how

decisions get made, so a representative can act alone instead of waiting for

you. A queue that only moves when you are online is not a working team.





What we are looking for

You have managed a customer service team before. You have set targets, run

reviews, and turned an underperformer around or moved them on.



You have worked in dropshipping. You know how to run support when

fulfilment sits with a supplier overseas and transit times are long. This is

the one thing we will not compromise on.



You know your way around chargebacks and payment disputes well enough to audit

your team's work and coach them.



You understand consumer protection rules in Western markets, or you learn them

fast. We will teach you what we know.



You work in spreadsheets by instinct. You can match two lists, find the

pattern, and put it in front of us in a form we can act on.



Your written English is good enough that a European customer reads it as

professional.



You speak up. If a process is broken, we hear it from you first.



You are reachable and predictable, and you arrange cover before you need it.





What we offer

$6 per hour. Working towards flat fee + bonus.

Direct access to the owner, no layers in between

Real authority over your team and your process

Paid training while you learn our stores, tools and systems



Software we built ourselves that shows every ticket, refund and dispute across

all stores in one place, so you manage on facts



Our tools

Shopify, Gorgias, Chargeflow, Hubstaff, Google Sheets, Slack. Tell us which of

these you have used.





How to apply



Send us:

Your CV

A video of yourself, maximum 2 minutes, in English

description:
About The Ad Firm



Founded in 2009, The Ad Firm was born out of a mission to bring complete transparency, scientific performance, and high profitability to the digital marketing industry. We are seeking a versatile Web Developer & AI Automation Engineer to join our team. In this hybrid role, you will wear two hats. First, you will act as a core web developer, building high-performance, SEO-optimized websites, managing integrations, and maintaining clean codebase structures for our clients. Second, you will act as our junior AI specialist—helping us explore, build, and test Agentic AI Workflows that automate digital marketing pipelines (like automated content generation, ad auditing, and reporting loops).



This is the ultimate role for an established developer who wants to break heavily into AI and build hands-on experience with multi-agent systems, frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI, and frontier LLMs under the guidance of our strategic roadmap.

- Handle server environments, deployments, and infrastructure decisions

- Integrate APIs and third-party systems cleanly and reliably

- Own technical SEO implementation (crawlability, indexation, structured data)

- Manage DNS, CDN (Cloudflare), SMTP, and hosting configurations

- Work across Shopify and BigCommerce at the code level when needed

- Implement accurate tracking (GA4, GTM) without compromising data integrity

- Debug issues across the full stack (server, backend, frontend performance)



Agentic AI Workflows (Junior/Growth Role)



- Assist in constructing multi-step, dynamic agentic workflows utilizing the PTMRO framework (Planning, Tools, Memory, Reflection, Orchestration).

- Help connect AI agents to practical tools by writing scripts and utilizing web hooks to link LLMs with marketing APIs (Google Ads, Meta Graph API, analytics dashboards).

- Build and test simple evaluation loops, helping prompt engineering and agent behaviors self-correct or flag errors before output generation.

- Run experiments to optimize LLM token usage, latency, and agent reasoning structures for internal agency automation.



What We’re Looking For



Web Development Requirements (Mid-to-Senior)



- 5+ years of web development experience in agency or performance-driven environments

- Deep expertise in PHP (including WordPress core-level development)

- Strong JavaScript experience with modern frameworks and tooling

- Working knowledge of Python (automation, scraping, tooling)

- Proven experience building custom WordPress websites from scratch

- Strong understanding of technical SEO and its impact on architecture and performance

- Ability to diagnose and solve full-stack issues independently



AI & Automation Requirements (Junior / Entry-Level)



- Foundational AI Knowledge: A massive passion for AI agents and basic conceptual understanding of how LLMs process data, handle memory, and leverage external tools.

- Framework Exposure: Foundational exposure to or an eager willingness to learn agentic architectures like LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel (personal projects or bootcamps count!).

- Python Skills: Solid script-writing capabilities in Python to handle data manipulation and API calls.



What Sets You Apart



- You think in systems, not pages

- Experience working on large-scale or SEO-heavy websites

- Strong understanding of crawlability, indexation, and internal linking at scale

- Experience with schema and structured data implementation

- Exposure to programmatic SEO or dynamic page generation

- Experience handling real-world constraints (traffic spikes, broken deployments, legacy rebuilds)



Strong Advantages



- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows

- Familiarity with Docker or modern dev environments

- Experience with log analysis and advanced debugging

- Security hardening and site recovery experience

- Experience with multi-site or multi-location SEO builds





What We Don’t Want



- Heavy reliance on page builders

- Plugin-first approaches to performance and SEO

- Developers who need constant direction or step-by-step instructions



Why Join Us?



- High ownership with real technical decision-making

- Clean builds with no unnecessary bloat

- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

The ideal professional should have experience with **small-business taxation, trusts/estate planning, business entities, family employment, and investment/tax planning**.



### Scope of Work



I am seeking assistance with:



* Reviewing my existing LLCs/business entities and overall financial structure.

* Determining whether establishing a **revocable living trust, irrevocable trust, family trust, or another trust structure** would be appropriate for my goals.

* Coordinating with an estate-planning attorney, when necessary, to properly establish the trust and transfer/assign eligible ownership interests in my businesses to the trust.

* Developing a tax-efficient structure for income generated through my businesses.

* Reviewing available **business deductions, credits, retirement strategies, and other legitimate tax-saving opportunities**.

* Establishing proper bookkeeping/accounting procedures across my businesses.

* Advising me on legally **employing my minor children through Squeeze & Go Lemonade** for legitimate, age-appropriate work performed for the business.

* Establishing appropriate payroll, documentation, job descriptions, timekeeping, and reasonable compensation for my children while ensuring compliance with IRS and employment requirements.

* Advising on tax-efficient ways to save and invest income earned by my children, including whether **custodial Roth IRAs, UTMA/UGMA accounts, 529 plans, custodial brokerage accounts, or other investment vehicles** would be appropriate.

* Assisting with establishing investment accounts for both of my sons and developing a long-term investment strategy for them.

* Reviewing whether retirement accounts or other investment vehicles should be established through my businesses.

* Creating an overall **family wealth, business, tax, and asset-protection strategy** that can grow as my businesses expand.



Ideal Qualifications



I am specifically looking for someone with experience working with:



**Small-business owners and LLCs • Family-owned businesses • Trust and estate structures • Business succession planning • Tax planning and tax reduction strategies • Employing children in a family business • Payroll compliance • Custodial Roth IRAs • UTMA/UGMA accounts • Business retirement accounts • Multi-generational wealth planning**



CPA or EA credentials are strongly preferred. Experience working alongside **estate-planning and business attorneys** is also preferred, as I understand certain aspects of establishing and funding a trust require legal counsel rather than an accountant alone.



Primary Goal



My goal is not simply to prepare my taxes once a year. I am looking for a professional who can help me create a **legal, organized, tax-efficient financial structure** for my businesses and family.



I want to ensure that my businesses are structured properly, legitimate tax deductions and strategies are being utilized, my children can appropriately participate in the family business, and money is being invested for their future while I build long-term family wealth.



I am looking for someone interested in developing an ongoing professional relationship and who can provide proactive tax and financial planning throughout the year.

About YY Nation



YY Nation is a sustainable sneaker brand from New Zealand. We make shoes from merino wool, cactus leather, hemp and other natural materials, because we think the shoe industry has leaned on plastic for far too long.

- Exceptional written English and clear communication

Bonus Points



- Experience with fashion, footwear, apparel or sustainable brands

How We Work



- Communication through Slack / WhatsApp /

title: Operations Manager
description:
About West Coast Homestays



West Coast Homestays manages a portfolio of ~80 short-term rental properties across San Diego, California. We pair hotel-grade reliability with the warmth and character of a real local home — and we're growing fast. As we scale, the quality of every guest interaction is what sets us apart and drives our reviews, repeat bookings, and reputation.



We're building a team of operators who care deeply about hospitality and sweat the details. If that's you, read on.



The Role

We're hiring a Guest Operations Manager to run the back of house — the physical operations that make every stay possible. While our guest experience team handles what guests say, you handle what guests walk into: a spotless, fully stocked, fully functional home, every single time.



You'll be the coordination engine behind the portfolio — orchestrating turnovers, dispatching maintenance, managing vendors, tracking work orders to completion, and recovering costs through claims. When a booking ends at 11am and another begins at 4pm, you're the reason the home is ready. When something breaks, you're the reason it's fixed before the next guest ever knows.



This is a logistics-heavy, detail-obsessed role for someone who thrives on keeping a hundred moving parts in sync and never lets a ball drop.



What You'll Own



Turnover coordination — scheduling and dispatching cleaning teams around every check-in and check-out, including same-day turns, back-to-backs, early checkouts, and extensions



Cleaning quality control — inspection checklists, photo verification, and holding cleaners to a consistent standard of "guest-ready"



Maintenance and work orders — creating, assigning, and tracking work orders to resolution; triaging urgent, guest-impacting issues; and closing the loop before the next arrival



Vendor management — building and managing a bench of reliable vendors (handyman, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, pool, landscaping, pest, locksmith); sourcing quotes, scheduling work, verifying completion, and approving invoices within budget



Preventive maintenance — scheduling routine upkeep so small problems don't become guest-facing emergencies



Damage and claims — documenting damage, filing and managing claims (Airbnb AirCover, VRBO, security deposits, insurance), and tracking each one through to reimbursement



Inventory and supplies — maintaining par levels of linens, consumables, toiletries, and welcome items; coordinating restocks; and keeping supply costs in check



Property readiness — owning the standard that every home is clean, stocked, and fully functional before each check-in, with zero readiness failures



Systems and reporting — running operational workflows in our PMS/work-order tools, tracking SLAs and costs, and surfacing trends to leadership





What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

On-time turnover rate at or above 98% — no guest ever arrives to an unready home

Median work-order resolution time under [24 hours], with urgent/guest-impacting issues same-day

Guest-ready failures (dirty, unstocked, or broken at check-in) driven to near zero

A managed vendor bench with reliable coverage across every service category and submarket

Maintenance and cleaning spend tracked per property and held within [budget targets]

A measurable lift in claims recovery — more damage documented, filed, and reimbursed





What You Bring (Required)



4+ years in property operations, short-term/vacation rental operations, facilities coordination, or hospitality operations

Proven logistics and coordination ability — you can juggle dozens of simultaneous turns, work orders, and vendor jobs without losing track

Experience managing vendors and field teams, including holding them to quality and cost standards

Fluency with work-order and PMS systems (e.g., Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable, Breezeway, or similar) and comfort learning new tools fast

Exceptional organization and follow-through — nothing slips; every open item gets closed

Strong written English for clear vendor, team, and cross-functional coordination

Reliable availability during Pacific Time hours, plus ownership of after-hours coverage when urgent issues arise

Calm and decisive under pressure — especially when a same-day turn or emergency repair is on the line





Nice to Have



Experience coordinating operations across 100+ units or multiple submarkets

Familiarity with damage-claims processes (AirCover, host guarantees, insurance) and a track record of recovering costs

Working knowledge of basic home systems (plumbing, electrical, HVAC, appliances) — enough to triage and brief vendors accurately

Familiarity with San Diego / Southern California vendor markets

• Invoices are generated and sent automatically from Halaxy (
) — no manual invoice creation or sending required.

 reminders at 14 and 28 days overdue (additional 2 follow-up touchpoints).

3.3 Accounts Payable

• No inventory tracking or multi-currency requirements.

• The business runs an active fortnightly payroll (wages, superannuation, PAYG withholding) through a separate payroll process.

• Payroll processing and reconciliation is explicitly excluded from this engagement — it is handled entirely by another party.

• The bookkeeper is not required to touch payroll-related accounts or journals.

We do not want fantasy remodels, impossible floor plans, oversized kitchens/islands, or dramatic architectural changes simply because AI can create them.



The renovation can change the home — but it should still look like the SAME HOME.



Think like an interior designer/architect + video editor, not simply an AI prompt generator.



Required Skills



Strong experience with:



AI image generation and image-to-image workflows

Inpainting, masking, generative fill and compositing

Maintaining architectural and perspective consistency

AI image-to-video

Professional short-form video editing

Transitions, keyframing, motion graphics and visual effects

Color correction and sound design



Experience with real estate, interior design, remodeling, architecture, or architectural visualization is a major plus.



Software



Experience with several of the following:



AI: ChatGPT, Gemini/Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Firefly, Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, Seedance, Luma, Pika



Editing: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Pro, After Effects



You do not need to know every program. We care more about the quality of your work and your ability to control AI results.



We Are NOT Looking For

Basic CapCut template editors

Generic AI-generated videos

One-click AI video generation

Simple slideshows

Unrealistic luxury remodels

AI images that obviously change the property's architecture

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS — PLEASE READ



You MUST follow these instructions.



Send ONLY Your 3 BEST Sample Videos



Exactly 3 videos. No more.



Your three samples should represent your very best work and should demonstrate skills relevant to this position — especially AI visualization, interior/architectural work, real estate video, or sophisticated short-form editing.



If you send more than 3 sample videos, your application will NOT be reviewed.



Please do not send:



10–20 portfolio videos

A general portfolio containing dozens of projects

Multiple folders full of videos

A long list of unrelated work



I am specifically asking for your 3 best samples. Please follow the directions.





Dropbox Required If Hired



If you are hired for this position, you will be required to have and use your own Dropbox account for exchanging project files and video assets.



Dropbox will be our required file-sharing platform for ongoing work.



Include With Your Application

Exactly 3 of your best sample videos

Software you use

Your rate for a 45–60 second video

Typical turnaround time

Brief description of your AI video/image-generation experience

Brief description of your real estate, interior design, remodeling, architecture, or visualization experience, if applicable



Applicants who cannot follow these simple instructions will not be considered.



This can become a long-term recurring position for the right editor as we expand our AI-powered real estate video services.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
Part-time | 20 hours per week | Monday through Friday | 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time



ABOUT THE ROLE

Lawn & Land Marketing is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency built specifically for lawn care and landscaping companies. We are hiring an experienced
 Ads Manager who can confidently manage Meta advertising for multiple client accounts from end to end.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is not a social media posting position. We need someone who has personally built, launched, tested, analyzed, and optimized paid
 and Instagram campaigns that generate real leads for service businesses.



The role starts part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position and a leadership role within our Meta Ads department based on performance, ownership, and team fit.



YOUR SCHEDULE

You must be available and actively working Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

For applicants in the Philippines, this is an overnight schedule:

- Approximately 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time while the U.S. is observing daylight-saving time

- Approximately 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine Time while the U.S. is observing standard time

The U.S. Eastern schedule is fixed, so your local hours will shift when U.S. daylight-saving time changes. Please apply only if you can reliably maintain this schedule year-round.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Build
 and Instagram campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager from campaign setup through launch

- Manage campaign, ad set, and ad-level settings accurately

- Build Meta Instant Forms with the correct questions, fields, privacy details, and completion steps

- Coordinate and verify lead routing into our CRM and automation systems

- Submit and verify test leads before campaigns go live

- Research audiences, offers, competitors, and local markets

- Write clear ad copy and calls to action for lawn care, landscaping, tree care, and outdoor-living services

- Create and evaluate static ad graphics that are accurate, polished, and appropriate for each client

- Use ChatGPT image generation and other AI tools to develop original creative concepts and usable campaign assets

- Catch visual problems such as incorrect equipment, unrealistic plants or properties, distorted text, bad anatomy, obvious AI artifacts, and service details that do not match the client

- Review every campaign end to end before launch, including copy, creative, links, forms, targeting, tracking, placements, schedule, and approved budget

- Monitor spend and performance during working hours

- Optimize campaigns using lead quality and business outcomes, not surface-level engagement metrics

- Test audiences, copy, creative, offers, placements, and form approaches with a clear reason for each test

- Report performance clearly, including spend, lead volume, cost per lead, click-through rate, frequency, conversion issues, lead quality, and recommended next actions

- Communicate blockers early and follow tasks through to a verified finish



WHAT WE REQUIRE

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience managing
 and Instagram ads

- Proven experience with lead-generation campaigns, not only awareness, boosted posts, or organic social media

- Experience managing multiple client ad accounts, preferably in an agency environment

- Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Business Manager, audiences, retargeting, placements, Instant Forms, pixels and datasets, events, and campaign quality assurance

- Ability to explain campaign decisions using actual performance data

- Strong graphic-design judgment and a portfolio of ads you personally created or directed

- Hands-on experience using ChatGPT for image generation, including prompting, iterating, correcting, and quality-checking outputs

- Understanding of visual accuracy. A polished image is not good enough if it shows the wrong service, equipment, property, season, or customer

- Experience connecting Meta leads to GoHighLevel or another CRM, or enough technical understanding to coordinate field mapping, automations, and end-to-end testing confidently

- Strong written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan for outages

- High attention to detail and the ability to follow written instructions completely

- Availability for the full 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time shift, Monday through Friday



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Experience generating leads for U.S. local-service or home-service businesses

- Experience with lawn care, landscaping, tree care, outdoor living, or another green-industry service

- Experience working in GoHighLevel

- Experience with Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Figma, or similar design software

- Familiarity with ChatGPT, automation tools, spreadsheets, reporting dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows

- Experience mentoring another media buyer or helping establish campaign standards and documented processes



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED

- Campaigns are built correctly and launched without preventable mistakes

- Leads reach the correct CRM workflow and are verified before launch

- Creative is accurate, brand-appropriate, and strong enough to stop attention

- Campaigns receive consistent, evidence-based optimization

- Lead quality and cost improve over time

- Reporting is accurate, useful, and tied to clear next actions

- Tasks are completed end to end without repeated reminders

- Problems are raised early, with a recommended solution



HOW WE WORK

We care about ownership, clear communication, and verified results. You will receive direction and standards, but we expect you to think, catch problems, and finish the job completely.

If something is unclear, ask before spending money or publishing the wrong thing. If something breaks, own it, explain it plainly, and bring a solution.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH

- Starting schedule: 20 hours per week

- Long-term remote position

- Opportunity to grow into full-time work and Meta department leadership based on demonstrated performance

- Final candidates will complete a short paid skills assessment using a realistic campaign scenario



HOW TO APPLY

Do not send a generic application through OnlineJobs.ph.



Complete the full application here:





The application includes detailed experience questions. After submitting the first step, you will be directed to a second page with instructions for a short Loom video.

title: Customer Service Representative (Long-Term, Full-Time) - Pest Control Company in Colorado, USA
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



Guardian Pest Management is a locally owned and operated pest control company that has been serving residential and commercial customers throughout the South Metro Denver area of Colorado since 2000. We are known for reliable service, honest communication, and long-term customer relationships. You can learn more about us at 
.



We are a small, family-oriented team. That means the person in this seat is not a number in a call center. You will be one of the first voices our customers hear, and you will be trusted with real responsibility from the beginning.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for a friendly, motivated, detail-oriented Customer Service Representative with excellent spoken and written English to join our team on a long-term basis.



This is important, so we want to be direct about it: we are not hiring for a short-term project or a trial gig. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with one company for years, learn our business deeply, and eventually take on more responsibility and leadership. If you are looking for a few months of work or you are juggling several clients at once, this role is not the right fit. If you want a stable home with one employer who invests in you, please keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Answer inbound phone calls promptly and professionally during our business hours.



Explain our pest control services to prospective and current customers, and sell services over the phone.



Schedule appointments in our software and coordinate scheduling and routing details with our technicians.



Gather and record customer information accurately, and keep detailed, accurate notes in every customer account.



Take and process customer payments when needed.



Handle basic account questions and resolve customer concerns in a professional, solution-focused way.



Respond to voi
s,
s, texts, and online inquiries in a timely manner.



Track accounts receivable and follow up on past-due balances.



Assist with payroll processing and general office administrative tasks as needed.



Help make sure every new service is set up correctly from the very start.



REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent. You will be on the phone with American customers every day, so this is the single most important requirement.



Strong written English for
, text, and account notes.



One to three years of customer service experience preferred, ideally phone-based and with US-based customers.



Comfortable selling services over the phone. You do not need to be a hard closer, but you do need to be confident asking for the sale.



Strong computer skills and comfort learning new software. Experience with Excel, Word, Google Workspace, and any scheduling or CRM platform is a plus.



Pest control industry experience is a plus and will move your application to the top of the list, but it is not required. We will train the right person.



Highly organized with strong attention to detail, and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.



Honesty, integrity, and a strong work ethic. We check references and we mean it.



Availability to work full-time during US Mountain Time business hours, Monday through Friday. 



A reliable computer, a quality noise-cancelling headset, and a stable, fast internet connection with a quiet place to take calls. A backup internet source (mobile data or a nearby alternative) is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



Competitive monthly salary based on your experience. Please include your expected monthly rate in your application.



13th month pay.



Annual pay increases based on performance and tenure. We expect the person in this seat to be earning meaningfully more in year three than in year one.



Performance bonuses and commission opportunities on phone sales.



Paid time off and paid holidays.



Paid training and ongoing coaching. You will be trained on our services, our software, and our phone process, and you will get regular feedback so you can keep improving.



Long-term stability and a clear path to more responsibility as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



Step 1. Reply with a short message telling us why you are interested in a long-term role with our company, your years of customer service experience, whether you have any pest control or home services experience, and your expected monthly rate.



Step 2. Record a short video or audio recording, no more than three minutes total, answering these three questions in your own words. Please do not read from a script.



Question 1. Please introduce yourself and tell us about your customer service experience, especially any experience on the phone with US-based customers.



Question 2. Tell us about a time an upset customer called you. What was the situation, what did you say, and how did it end?



Question 3. Why are you looking for a long-term position with one company, and where do you want to be in three years?



Step 3. Upload your recording to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted), or Loom, and include the link in your application. Make sure the link is set so we can open it without requesting access.



We review every application that follows these steps, and we respond to the applicants we would like to interview. Thank you for taking the time to apply. We are looking forward to meeting you.

mbers

Responsibilities:

· Provide excellent customer service to new and existing clients.

title: Shopify & TikTok Shop Manager
description:
READ THIS ENTIRE AD BEFORE YOU APPLY.

If you skip this and send a generic application, you will be ignored.

Job title: Shopify & TikTok Shop Manager



We need someone who can fully manage and grow our Shopify store and TikTok Shop. This starts as a part-time role. It becomes bigger, and the pay goes up, as quickly as you grow sales and profit.



Pay



$70 per week to start.



Pay increases as quickly as you increase sales and profit.



You can work as many hours or as few hours as you need in order to grow the stores as quickly as possible. As it sits now there isn't a lot to do, so most of the hours you spend will be put towards building the stores. 



This is not a “wait to be told what to do” job. You will own both stores day to day and find ways to increase sales, margins and profits. 



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Shopify



-Run the store: products, collections, pages, apps, discounts, bundles, merchandising

-Find and create new products, write listings, set pricing, keep inventory accurate

-Manage orders, fulfillment issues, returns, and refunds

-Answer customers 
/chat/tickets)

-Improve the store so more visitors buy

-Promote the store on our social media channels

-Link the store to all sales channels (currently not linked to Meta and likely others)



TikTok Shop



-Run Seller Center: listings, pricing, promos, shop health, compliance

-Get any of our current products in the store that aren't already there

-Find and launch products that can sell on TikTok

-Build and manage creator/affiliate campaigns: find creators, outreach, briefs, samples, commissions, track who posted and       what sold

-Create and manage ads (GMV Max, Spark Ads, Product Ads). Test, kill losers, scale winners

-Handle customer messages, orders, and returns

-Promote TikTok Shop through our social channels and turn winning content into ads



Both stores



-Drive results, not busywork

-Work independently

-Make suggestions and implement them

-Keep Shopify and TikTok Shop aligned, as well as all of our social media

-Send a simple weekly recap: sales increase, what's selling, what you did, what you want to do



WHO SHOULD APPLY



You already know Shopify and TikTok Shop. You can show stores you have helped grow.



You can:

-manage both platforms without hand-holding

-run creator/affiliate outreach

-run small ad campaigns

-handle customers and orders

-research products and launch them

-promote products on social media



MUST HAVE



-Real experience with BOTH Shopify and TikTok Shop

-Proof: store links and screenshots (sales/GMV, orders, ads, creator/affiliate results) plus what you personally did

-Strong written English

-Willing to start part-time at $70/week and grow pay with results



DO NOT APPLY IF



You have only done product uploads or customer service

You have only posted on TikTok and never managed TikTok Shop

You cannot show proof

You need daily supervision

You send “I’m interested” with no details



HOW TO APPLY





Use this exact subject line:



I can fully manage and grow both Shopify and TikTok shop



Include:



3–5 sentences on Shopify and TikTok Shop stores you managed or grew

Links or screenshots as proof

What you personally owned

How many hours per week you can work

How soon you can start



No exact subject line and no proof = no reply.
